title: 🎮 Recurring Stream Overlay / Logo & Animation Designer
description:
We are looking for a **creative graphic designer + 2D animator** to work with us on an ongoing basis for our streaming brand.



The immediate project is our **animated “Starting Soon” screen and streaming overlays**, but we are specifically looking for someone we can continue hiring as the brand grows and the designs change.



### FIRST PROJECT



**Phase 1 — Logo Redraw | $25**



* Redraw/refine our existing logo into a cleaner, more professional version.

* You are NOT creating the brand from scratch. We already have the concept and direction.

* Must be able to actually draw and improve existing artwork—not simply use templates.

* We approve the finished logo before moving forward.



**Phase 2 — Temporary Animation | $25**

After the logo is approved, create a simple temporary animated version for our stream while the more detailed official animation is being developed.



This will include basic motion such as **animated/buffering lines and simple logo movement/effects**.



The official Starting Soon animation will be a **separate paid project with its own agreed price.**



### THIS IS RECURRING WORK



We want someone interested in becoming one of our regular designers/animators.



Our streaming graphics will change frequently. Think of it like a major brand changing campaigns and designs throughout the year.



🎃 Halloween = new variation

🎄 Christmas = new variation

🎉 Special events = new variation

🎮 New stream ideas = additions/changes

👕 Brand updates = new graphics or animation changes



Sometimes we may ask you to **add something, remove something, redraw an element, change a character/object, modify an existing scene, or create a new variation.**



Every new request will include the details and proposed price **before you accept the project.** You are always free to accept or decline.



If you decline a particular project, **you are NOT fired or replaced.** We may hire another animator to handle that specific request, while continuing to send you future projects that may fit your availability or skills.



Pricing will change depending on the complexity of each request.



### IMPORTANT REQUIREMENTS



You should be strong in:



* Logo drawing/redrawing and refinement

* 2D animation

* Logo animation

* Stream overlays and graphics

* Looping animations

* Working from references and detailed creative direction

* Editing and expanding your own previous work

* Keeping artwork visually consistent across future versions



**SOURCE FILES ARE REQUIRED FOR EVERY PROJECT.**



All editable/source files must be delivered with completed work. This is important because the artwork will continuously evolve and may need to be modified in future projects.



We value **communication, reliability, creativity, and consistency** more than fancy sales pitches.



When applying, please send examples of your **logo design/redrawing, 2D animation, logo animation, stream overlays, or similar work.**



You do NOT need to write a huge application. Show us what you can do.



Additional details about the Starting Soon screen, animation concept, branding, references, and future workflow will be explained to applicants we are interested in.



**If you have questions, ask. We would rather clear something up before starting than have someone guess our direction.**



If the relationship works well, expect **recurring paid projects as the streaming brand continues to evolve.**

title: Packaging & Brand Designer (E-Commerce / DTC)
description:
NOTE: DO NOT APPLY WITHOUT ADDING YOUR PORTFOLIO. APPLICATIONS WITHOUT A PORTFOLIO LINK WILL BE SKIPPED.



GENERIC AI-GENERATED DESIGN WORK WILL BE SKIPPED. AI can be used as part of your process, but we’re looking for someone with strong taste and real design ability who thoughtfully creates the final work.



JOIN MYSWATCHES



We’re looking for a talented Packaging & Brand Designer to help bring the MySwatches brand to life across our physical products and customer experience.



We’re looking for someone with a strong eye for branding, packaging, print design, typography, color, and physical presentation.



You’ll help us design everything our customers see when their MySwatches order arrives, from the box itself to inserts, thank-you cards, seasonal packaging, and future product packaging.



We want someone who can take our existing brand and make it feel more polished, recognizable, premium, and exciting to receive.



WHAT YOU’LL BE WORKING ON



Projects may include:



Designing our shipping and product packaging

Creating thank-you cards, inserts, instruction cards, and other printed materials

Designing special edition and seasonal packaging, including Christmas and holiday boxes

Working with dielines and adapting designs for different packaging formats

Creating mockups so we can visualize concepts before production



We’re not looking for someone who just places our logo on a box.



We want someone who thinks about the entire unboxing experience, what the customer sees first, how the packaging feels, where information should go, how everything works together, and what will make the package feel special when it arrives.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



You have strong taste and experience designing physical brand materials, ideally for DTC, beauty, fashion, lifestyle, cosmetics, or consumer products.



You should be comfortable taking a relatively open brief and developing several strong creative directions rather than needing every design decision explained to you.



Ideally, you have:



A strong portfolio of packaging and brand design

Experience designing packaging for physical consumer products

Strong typography, composition, color, and branding skills

Experience creating print-ready production files

Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, or similar professional design software

Experience creating realistic packaging mockups

Strong attention to detail

Strong written English and communication skills

The ability to take feedback and revise quickly



Experience working with DTC, beauty, fashion, cosmetics, gifting, or female-focused brands is a major plus.



Experience communicating with printers or packaging manufacturers and understanding production limitations is also highly valuable.



ABOUT MYSWATCHES



MySwatches is a personal color analysis brand helping women discover the colors that flatter them most.



Our professional color analysts determine each customer’s personal color palette, and we send them physical cards featuring their colors.



Our hero product, the Swatch Card, makes it simple for customers to know which colors to wear and look for while shopping.



As we grow, we want the physical experience of receiving MySwatches to feel just as special as the product itself.



ROLE DETAILS



This is a remote contract position with ongoing design opportunities.



We’re initially looking for help with several packaging and print projects, including thank-you cards, our standard packaging, Christmas boxes, and other branded materials.



There is potential for ongoing work as we launch new products and continue developing the MySwatches brand.



Compensation will be based on experience, portfolio, and scope of work.



Applications without a portfolio link will be skipped.



Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete a paid design test or small initial project.

description:
**PLEASE MAKE SURE TO ATTACH/LINK YOUR RESUME AND VIDEO INTRODUCTION BEFORE APPLYING OTHERWISE YOUR APPLICATION WILL BE IGNORED**



Senior Accountant / Controller







Job Type: Full-Time



Work Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM Central Time, with a 30-minute break







Job Overview:



We are seeking a highly experienced and hands-on Senior Accountant / Controller to take full ownership of the accounting function for a growing apparel decoration, manufacturing, and e-commerce company with approximately 50 employees. This is a hands-on role where the successful candidate will work directly in the books every day, managing the full accounting cycle, including AP, AR, reconciliations, journal entries, month-end close, inventory accounting, landed costs, and financial reporting.



The ideal candidate will bring strong QuickBooks Online expertise and the ability to independently maintain accurate financial records, identify and resolve accounting issues, and improve accounting processes and controls. The owners should be able to rely on this person to provide complete, accurate, and clearly presented financials while remaining accountable for the day-to-day accounting function without requiring constant oversight.







Key Responsibilities:



Take full ownership of the company’s books and daily accounting activities from start to finish.

Manage and monitor accounts payable and accounts receivable.

Perform bank, credit card, payment processor, and balance-sheet reconciliations.

Prepare, review, and post journal entries and adjusting entries.

Lead the complete month-end close process within five to seven business days.

Prepare accurate monthly financial statements and management reports.

Present the owners with clear, organized, and reliable financial information.

Review existing accounting records and correct inconsistencies, duplicate entries, and classification errors.

Complete and maintain the chart of accounts and account-mapping structure.

Establish clear accounting workflows for multiple team members who process transactions.

Oversee accounting across both the apparel-decoration business and the growing blank-headwear business.

Manage inventory accounting and ensure inventory transactions are accurately recorded.

Calculate landed product costs, including product cost, freight, customs duties, tariffs, and other import-related expenses.

Support monthly container imports from Bangladesh and properly allocate costs across inventory items.

Reconcile Shopify, production, billing, payroll, sales-tax, banking, and payment platforms with QuickBooks Online.

Maintain organized supporting documentation and a clear audit trail.

Identify process gaps and implement stronger accounting procedures and internal controls.

Coordinate with administrative staff while remaining personally accountable for the accuracy and completion of all accounting work.

Provide daily or regular progress updates and respond promptly during scheduled working hours.

Be fully available during the five-to-seven-day month-end closing period.





Required Qualifications:



A Bachelor of Accountancy degree is required.

At least five years of hands-on accounting experience, preferably as a Senior Accountant, Accounting Manager, Assistant Controller, or Controller.

Advanced, hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online.

Strong knowledge of U.S. accounting practices and financial reporting.

Demonstrated experience independently managing the full month-end close process.

Strong experience with account reconciliations, journal entries, AP, AR, and general-ledger accounting.

Experience with inventory, manufacturing, apparel, wholesale, product-based, or e-commerce accounting.

Understanding of landed-cost calculations for imported inventory.

Ability to review disorganized books, identify problems, and establish accurate accounting processes.

Ability to personally perform detailed accounting work without relying on the owners for daily direction.

Excellent attention to detail, organization, accountability, and problem-solving skills.

Strong written and spoken English.

Ability to maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive financial information.

Reliable computer, high-speed internet connection, and a professional remote workspace.





Preferred Qualifications:



CPA, CMA, or another relevant accounting certification.

Experience working with apparel decoration, screen printing, embroidery, headwear, or related manufacturing businesses.

Experience accounting for international inventory purchases and monthly container shipments.

Experience with Shopify and other integrated e-commerce platforms.

Familiarity with platforms such as Printavo, 
, Gusto, TaxJar, banking systems, and payment processors.

Experience supervising or coordinating accounting-related work performed by administrative or remote team members.

Cole Insure is a growing US independent Medicare agency, serving veterans and seniors in 30 states. We are hiring 2 elite Calling VAs, not ten, not twenty. You will be a named member of a small US team, working directly with our licensed agents, not a seat in a call center farm.

, minutes before you dial. Fresh, exclusive, never resold. Your talent goes into converting, not into surviving hang-ups from dead lists.



Your paycheck follows your skill. $5/hr base is guaranteed. Every qualified live transfer our agents confirm adds $1, uncapped. Strong callers run 8-12 confirmed transfers a day. Do the math on your own ability.



Real tools. Professional dialer, CRM, proven scripts, paid training starting September 8. You bring the voice, we bring everything else.



What you'll do: call brand-new leads within seconds, qualify with 2-3 simple questions, and transfer them live to a licensed agent while they're on the line. Book a firm appointment when a transfer isn't possible. Follow up no-answers and aged leads. Keep clean CRM notes. Plan details and coverage advice stay with licensed agents, we train you on exactly where that line is.



Schedule, be honest with yourself: US Central daytime hours 8:30am-5:00pm CST, roughly 8:30 PM to 6:00 AM Philippine time, Monday to Friday, permanent night shift. Our best applicants are natural night owls who want US hours on purpose. If that's not you, don't apply.



You: excellent spoken English with a neutral accent, a confident and warm phone presence seniors trust, unbothered by rejection, reliable fiber internet with backup power, full-time with no side clients, and appointment setting or call center experience strongly preferred.



How to apply. Incomplete applications are not reviewed.



To be considered, record a video of yourself on Loom or any platform and cover all of the following in detail:



Read this script exactly once, naturally, like a real call: "Hi John? I'm just getting back to you about your request for additional money back for Veterans. You responded to our post about getting up to $2,200 back. Are you still located in Texas? Perfect. And what branch did you serve in?"



Then answer these four questions on camera:



1. Walk me through your phone sales or appointment setting background. What did you dial, and what results did you put up?

2. This is a permanent overnight shift, 9 PM to 6 AM your time. Tell me honestly how that fits your daily life, and whether you've done it before.

3. Show or describe your work setup: internet speed, workspace, and exactly what happens on your end when the power or connection goes out mid-shift.

4. When you work for someone you never see in person, how do they know what you got done without ever having to ask?



Attach your resume, and start your application with the words NIGHT OWL so we know you read everything.



This team is small on purpose, and every seat on it matters. We want callers who show up sharp, treat scheduled hours as non-negotiable, and want to be paid for performance. If what you actually need is a side gig or something to hold you over for a few months, skip this one.



Interviews start within days. Paid training begins September 8. Two or three people are getting these seats. Make the recording the reason one of them is you.

You already play The Sims 4 on a PC not console, why a .ts4script has to sit near the top of the Mods folder, and what happens on patch day.  Experience managing communities and posting on multiple platforms.

 

You won't be on camera. You will be in the game most days: testing mods before they go out, shooting the screenshots using a Gshade we release them with, looking after the people who pay for this, and getting the work in front of everyone who hasn't found it yet.



WHO WE ARE

----------

Custom content and script mod studio for The Sims 4.



We build things that don't exist anywhere else in the modding scene. Recent releases include a Holy Bible object with 110 hand-made covers in English and Simlish, a group Bible study system that gathers multiple Sims around a reader and gets them studying together, narrative choice cards that interrupt a quiet moment and ask the player what their Sim does next, plus faith traits, aspirations, lot traits and custom scenarios.





Everything ships base-game compatible. No pack dependencies unless there's no way around it, because a mod that needs four expansion packs isn't a mod most people can play.





WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

Right now one person builds the mods, looks after the 49K+ patrons, writes every post, answers every install question, takes the screenshots and handles the re-uploads. That worked at a smaller size and it doesn't any more.





Patrons are the ones paying for this to exist, and they should never be the ones waiting longest for a reply. That's the first thing we want fixed.



WHAT YOU'D OWN



### 1. Patreon members — this is the priority



This comes before everything else on the list.



Patrons pay every month and they should feel looked after every month. You'd own their experience end to end: welcoming new patrons, making sure they can find and install what they paid for, answering their questions first and fastest, checking tier access is actually working, and telling us when someone is about to cancel and why.



 



If a patron is stuck, nothing else on this list matters that day.



 



 2. Getting the work found



Our mods need to exist where Simmers actually look for them. You'd create and maintain our listings on Curse Forge, The Sims Resource, Course forge and Pinterest — writing the descriptions, uploading the images, tagging properly, and keeping versions current when a mod updates.



A mod nobody can find is a mod nobody downloads.



3. Posting everywhere else



Publishing and scheduling across Patreon, Skool, Tumblr, Ko-fi, Pinterest, TikTok, YouTube,
, Instagram, X and Threads.



You'd write the copy, adapt each post to the platform it's going on, and keep the schedule moving. Video production stays in-house — you're publishing and captioning it, not filming it.





 4. Testing and screenshots



You play every mod before it ships, in a real save, with your own mods loaded — that's where the conflicts show up. Then you shoot the promotional images in GShade and edit them for the release.



 

5.The 



Moderating it, keeping it warm, welcoming people in, and making sure nobody's question sits unanswered overnight. We'd rather be the small community where you always get an answer than the big one where you don't.



 

 6. Documentation and support



Release notes, install guides and troubleshooting a player can follow without knowing what tuning is. Then answering the same install question for the fortieth time as patiently as the first most people who say a mod is broken have script mods switched off, or XML Injector missing, or a .ts4script buried four folders deep.





7. Bug triage



Reproduce it, collect the lastException.txt, narrow down which mod and which interaction, and write it up properly. A good bug report from you saves the developer an hour.



 

8. Translations and re-uploads



Coordinating community translators and keeping the string tables straight  including leaving the {0.SimFirstName} tokens intact, because a translation that strips those breaks every notification in that language.



 

And watching the file-dump sites. When our mods get copied around, players end up on old broken versions and we get the bug reports for a file we can no longer fix.



 





WHAT A WEEK ACTUALLY LOOKS LIKE



Every day — Patreon first: new patrons welcomed, patron questions answered, access problems fixed. Then 
. Then whatever came in overnight everywhere else.





Release weeks 



 Get the build early, play it, try to break it. Shoot and edit the screenshots. Draft the Patreon post, the 
 announcement, the install notes and the platform posts. Get the listings up on Curse Forge, TSR and Tumblr and other platforms. Publish and watch the first hour closely.





Patch weeks EA pushes an update and something breaks. Reports arrive in different words describing the same fault. You reproduce it, collect the exception file, write it up for the developer, and post the honest holding message so nobody thinks they've been abandoned.





Ongoing : Keep the posting schedule moving. Keep listings current. Coordinate translators. Tell us what the community keeps asking for that we haven't built.





WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

-----------------------

By day 30 — Patrons are getting same-day answers. You're handling most of 
 without asking. You've shipped screenshots for a release.





By day 60 — Our mods are listed and current on Curse Forge, TSR,  Pinterest and other platforms.



Posts go out on schedule across every platform without being chased. Bug reports reaching the developer are clean and reproducible.



 

By day 90 You own the community rhythm. Patron questions don't reach the founder. You're telling us what to build next because you hear it before we do.



HOW WE'D WORK TOGETHER



You draft, and posts go out once they're approved. The voice and aesthetics of it matters, so we'd rather get that right together early than hand it over cold. As you settle in and the voice becomes second nature, that gets looser.





You'll have direct access to the founder. Small team, no layers, fast answers.



WHAT YOU NEED



 • You love this game. Not "I've played it." You have opinions about the packs, you follow creators, and your Mods folder is bigger than you'd admit out loud

.

 • The Sims 4 installed on your own PC, with the packs you own. This job can't be done on a borrowed machine or a console.





 • GShade, installed and running. You'll use it to test mods and shoot every release image. This one isn't negotiable.





 • A computer that can run all of it — a heavily moded game with a shader on top.





 • Photoshop and Canva. Editing screenshots and building the graphics that go out with every release.

 • You've managed a paying membership before  Patreon, Ko-fi, Skool, a subscription community, anything where people pay monthly and expect to be looked after.





 • You can run a multi-platform posting schedule without being chased, and adapt one piece of news to eleven different places.





 • You can explain a technical thing simply. Walking someone through enabling script mods who has never opened their Mods folder is most of this job.





 • You write clearly and warmly in English. Nearly everything you produce here is writing.





You're comfortable representing a any type of mods community and speaking in that voice.





WHAT WOULD MAKE YOU STAND OUT

-----------------------------



Having published on Curse Forge or The Sims Resource yourself. Experience running a Patreon from the creator side. A scheduling tool you're fast with. Basic Sims 4 Studio. A second language. Having handled a DMCA or re-upload takedown. Your own Sims content, however small.





THIS PROBABLY ISN'T FOR YOU IF

------------------------------



If you've played sims 4 on a console and not a pc



 • You want to be the face of a brand. You won't be on camera here.

 • You've never used mods and were planning to learn on the job. The community will know.

 • You need everything spelled out. A lot of this is noticing what needs doing before anyone asks.

 • Repetition frustrates you. You'll answer the same three questions forever, and doing it warmly every time is the job.





HOW TO APPLY

------------



Send:



 1. A community or membership you've run, and what it looked like when you started

 2. Your Sims 4 setup — roughly how many mods you run, which creators you follow, and your PC specs

 3. Three screenshots you've taken yourself in-game with GShade. If you've edited them, or made a graphic out of one in Photoshop or Canva, send that too — we want to see your eye.





 4. A short task: pick any mod by any creator and write the release post you'd publish for it. 150 words. We want to see how you explain a technical thing to a player who just wants it to work. 





WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

We read every application, and the task carries more weight than the CV. If it's a fit, there's one call  a conversation about the game and the community, not a quiz. In the loom video share your mods folder, your graphic skills and your knowledge on Sims 4.

title: Senior Australian Public Practice Bookkeeper | Remote Independent Contractor – Philippines
description:
Senior Australian Public Practice Bookkeeper

Remote Independent Contractor – Philippines





Location: Philippines – 100% Remote

Engagement Type: Long-term Independent Contractor

Service Days: Monday to Friday

Reports To: Australian Client Manager

Client Contact: No direct client communication required



About the Role



We are an Australian accounting practice seeking an experienced Senior Australian Public Practice Bookkeeper based in the Philippines to support a portfolio of Australian clients.

This is a hands-on, non-client-facing role. You will work directly with an Australian Client Manager, who will manage all external client communication and provide instructions, priorities and review feedback.



You will be responsible for delivering accurate bookkeeping, payroll, BAS/IAS preparation, reconciliations, month-end work and accounting support across multiple Australian entities.

This opportunity is suitable only for candidates with substantial recent experience working within, or directly supporting, an Australian accounting firm, bookkeeping practice or public practice environment.



Key ResponsibilitiesBookkeeping and Reconciliations

· Manage end-to-end bookkeeping for multiple Australian clients.

· Complete bank, credit card, loan and merchant facility reconciliations.

· Reconcile payment platforms such as Stripe, Square, PayPal, Shopify and Wise.

· Process accounts payable and accounts receivable.

· Process supplier bills, sales invoices, credit notes, refunds and payments.

· Review aged receivables and aged payables.

· Process journals, accruals, prepayments and accounting adjustments.

· Reconcile director, shareholder, beneficiary and intercompany loan accounts.

· Maintain fixed asset registers and assist with depreciation schedules.

· Investigate unreconciled, duplicated, missing or incorrectly recorded transactions.



Account Code and GST Code Review



This is a senior-level role. You must be able to review the quality and technical accuracy of bookkeeping work.



You will be required to:



· Review and correct account codes.

· Review and correct GST tax codes.

· Identify incorrect use of GST on Income, GST on Expenses, GST-Free, Input Taxed and BAS Excluded codes.

· Review the GST treatment of overseas transactions, exports, reimbursements, disbursements, insurance payments and government grants.

· Identify personal, capital, private and non-deductible transactions.

· Review general ledger accounts for unusual balances and incorrect classifications.

· Review suspense, clearing and uncategorised transaction accounts.

· Self-review all work before submitting it to the Client Manager.

· Review work prepared by junior bookkeepers where required.



Australian Payroll



· Process weekly, fortnightly and monthly payroll.

· Set up and maintain employee payroll records.

· Process ordinary hours, overtime, allowances, bonuses, deductions and reimbursements.

· Process annual leave, personal leave and termination payments.

· Prepare Single Touch Payroll reporting and year-end STP finalisation.

· Calculate and reconcile PAYG withholding.

· Calculate and reconcile employer superannuation.

· Review superannuation clearing house payments and identify rejected or unpaid amounts.

· Reconcile payroll reports, payroll journals and payroll liability accounts.

· Assist with payroll tax, workers compensation and other payroll compliance requirements.



BAS, IAS and Compliance Support



· Prepare BAS and IAS workpapers for internal review.

· Reconcile GST, PAYG withholding and PAYG instalment accounts.

· Review GST reporting under both cash and accrual methods.

· Reconcile BAS figures to the general ledger.

· Identify prior-period errors and transactions requiring GST adjustments.

· Assist with PAYG instalment variation calculations.

· Assist with Taxable Payments Annual Reports.

· Prepare supporting documents and schedules for the firm’s accountants and tax agents.

· Monitor internal deadlines and escalate missing information promptly.



Month-End and Year-End



· Complete monthly, quarterly and annual bookkeeping files.

· Reconcile all material balance sheet accounts.

· Review payroll, GST, superannuation and PAYG liabilities.

· Prepare accruals, prepayments and other adjusting journals.

· Review accounts payable and accounts receivable cut-off.

· Reconcile fixed assets, inventory and cost of goods sold where applicable.

· Prepare year-end workpapers and supporting schedules.

· Ensure client files are ready for financial statement and income tax return preparation.



Financial Reporting



· Prepare Profit and Loss Statements and Balance Sheets.

· Prepare cash flow and management reports where required.

· Compare results with prior periods, budgets or forecasts.

· Identify unusual movements, negative balances and potential accounting errors.

· Provide clear internal explanations and supporting schedules to the Client Manager.



Tax Return Experience – Highly Regarded, but not essential



Experience preparing Australian income tax returns or tax workpapers is not essential but will be a strong advantage.



Relevant experience may include:

· Individual and sole trader tax returns.

· Company tax returns.

· Trust tax returns and distribution workpapers.

· Partnership tax returns.

· Rental property schedules.

· Depreciation and capital allowance schedules.

· Tax reconciliation workpapers.

· Xero Tax, MYOB Practice, HandiTax or BGL.



Essential Experience and Skills



Applicants must have:

· At least five years of recent Australian public practice bookkeeping experience.

· Experience managing bookkeeping for multiple Australian clients.

· Advanced practical experience using Xero.

· Strong practical experience using MYOB.

· Strong practical experience using QuickBooks Online.

· Experience preparing BAS and IAS workpapers.

· Strong knowledge of Australian GST and account coding.

· Demonstrated experience reviewing and correcting GST codes.

· Strong Australian payroll, STP and superannuation experience.

· Advanced reconciliation and problem-solving skills.

· Experience preparing month-end and year-end workpapers.

· Excellent written and spoken English.

· Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

· The ability to work independently and manage multiple deadlines.

· High standards of confidentiality, integrity and professional conduct.

· Ability to use AI tools



Experience limited to internal bookkeeping for one Australian business may not satisfy the public practice experience requirement.



Qualifications



The following qualifications are highly regarded:

· Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or Commerce.

· Diploma or recognised qualification in Accounting or Bookkeeping.

· CPA, Chartered Accountant or equivalent studies.

· Xero Advisor Certification.

· MYOB or QuickBooks certification.



Software



You must be confident using:



· Xero

· MYOB

· QuickBooks Online



Independent Contractor Arrangement



This is an independent contractor opportunity and not an employee position.



The contractor will:



· Provide services remotely from the Philippines.

· Provide their own computer, secure workspace, internet and backup power arrangements.

· Be responsible for their own business registration, taxation, invoicing and insurance obligations.

· Issue a valid monthly contractor invoice.



The contractor will ordinarily provide services Monday to Friday and maintain regular overlap with Australian business hours.



The parties will agree on a daily core collaboration window for meetings, questions and internal communication. Outside that window, the contractor may arrange their own working schedule, provided all deadlines and service requirements are met.



Timesheets and Work Records



The contractor must complete a daily timesheet recording:



· Date.

· Client or entity.

· Task performed.

· Time spent.

· Work completed.

· Outstanding issues and next steps.



Timesheets are used for client costing, workflow management, capacity planning and supporting the contractor’s invoice. They are not intended to operate as employee attendance records.

Remote Work Requirements



Applicants must have:



· A reliable computer or laptop.

· Stable high-speed internet.

· Backup internet.

· A quiet and secure home office.

· A suitable headset for online meetings.

· The ability to use multi-factor authentication and secure password systems.

· A strong commitment to privacy, confidentiality and data security.



How to Apply



Please submit:

· Your current resume.

· A brief cover letter of your Australian public practice experience.

· Details of your Xero, MYOB and QuickBooks Online experience.

· Details of your BAS, IAS and Australian payroll experience.

· Details of any Australian tax returns you have prepared.

· Your expected monthly contractor fee in Philippine pesos.

· Your earliest available commencement date.

· Confirmation of your internet.

· Confirmation that you can issue invoices as an independent contractor.



Pay: Php70,000.00 - Php80,000.00 per month

description:

title: Part-Time Shopify Web Designer / Developer
description:
Baie Botanique is a UK vegan skincare and mineral suncare brand. We are looking for a capable, reliable part-time Shopify Web Designer / Developer who can take a practical brief—such as “I want this section to look or behave like this”—and implement the solution without the founder having to work out the technical steps first.



This is a hands-on implementation and troubleshooting role. You should be comfortable working independently within an established Shopify store while keeping the brand presentation polished and consistent.



Responsibilities



• Build and edit Shopify pages and sections, including work in PageFly.

• Build or adapt custom Shopify sections and templates using Liquid, HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

• Plan and implement Shopify theme upgrades or migrations using a duplicate/staging theme. Preserve required apps, tracking, settings, content and custom functionality; test the new theme thoroughly; and maintain a safe rollback route before publication.

• Implement layout, styling and functionality changes using HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

• Fix spacing, alignment, typography, responsive-layout and mobile-display issues.

• Configure and troubleshoot Shopify apps, including upsells, sticky add-to-cart behaviour and related customer-experience features.

• Build and improve landing pages and product-page sections.

• Identify practical UX and conversion-rate improvements and implement approved changes.

• Take hands-on responsibility for diagnosing and fixing Shopify website-speed and performance issues—not simply producing an audit. Use tools such as Google PageSpeed Insights and Lighthouse to identify problems caused by themes, apps, scripts, images, fonts and page-builder content; implement approved fixes safely; and record measurable before-and-after results. Clearly escalate anything that genuinely requires an app provider or more specialised development.

• Test work carefully across desktop and mobile before marking it complete.

• Diagnose conflicts between themes, page builders, custom code and third-party apps.

• Keep a clear record of changes and explain what was changed, why and how it was tested.

• Follow tasks through to a verified result rather than stopping after the first attempted fix.



Examples of the work



Recent tasks have included PageFly edits, sticky add-to-cart behaviour, synchronising product variants between page elements, Selleasy upsell layout changes, mobile optimisation, CSS spacing and styling fixes, app configuration, promotional landing pages and general Shopify troubleshooting. Future projects may include moving the store to an updated theme and developing custom sections or functionality.



Essential experience



• Strong practical Shopify experience.

• Confident PageFly experience.

• Strong HTML and CSS, practical JavaScript, and working knowledge of Shopify Liquid and Online Store 2.0 theme architecture.

• Proven experience upgrading, migrating or substantially customising Shopify themes without disrupting live-store functionality.

• Experience configuring and resolving issues with Shopify apps.

• Proven hands-on experience fixing Shopify performance and page-speed issues, with an understanding of Core Web Vitals. You must be able to show changes you personally implemented and the measurable results.

• Good responsive-design judgement and attention to mobile usability.

• A good eye for polished e-commerce design, UX and conversion.

• Clear written English, careful testing and dependable follow-through.

• Ability to work from outcomes and briefs rather than requiring detailed technical instructions for every task.



Hours and pay



This is a part-time role with 5 guaranteed hours per week initially. Some weeks may require 10 or more hours when larger pages, launches or technical projects are underway. Additional hours will be agreed in advance.



Pay is US$7 per hour initially. Some weekday availability and overlap with UK working hours is required.



To apply, please answer the following:



1. Please share links to two or three Shopify stores or pages you personally built or substantially edited, and explain exactly what you did.

2. Describe your experience with PageFly, Shopify Liquid, HTML/CSS, JavaScript and Shopify app configuration. Include an example of a theme upgrade, migration or substantial theme customisation you personally completed, how you protected the live store, and what you tested before launch.

3. Give a specific example of a Shopify speed or performance problem you diagnosed and improved. What caused it, what did you change, which tools did you use, and what were the measurable before-and-after results?

4. If a sticky add-to-cart bar did not stay synchronised with the main product variant selector, how would you investigate the problem?

5. What hours are you available, what UK-hours overlap can you offer, and when could you start?



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a short paid practical assessment.

We're looking for an experienced Construction Estimator to join our team and take ownership of pricing and quoting across a mix of commercial, industrial, and residential projects. • Reliable internet connection and a suitable home office setup



Nice to Have



• Experience working with Australian builders, contractors, or construction companies

What We Offer



• Competitive salary based on experience

title: Operations Coordinator (Client Support + Admin + Systems) - UK Hours, Part-Time to Full-Time
description:
KSTN Digital is a UK marketing-technology consultancy. We build patient acquisition systems for dental clinics - websites, CRMs, chatbots, automations, content and ads - plus selected e-commerce work. Small team (founder plus three), fast-moving and systems-heavy.



THE ROLE



We need a generalist who can run things. Someone who learns how a business actually works, takes the loose ends off the founder's plate, and keeps every loop closed without being chased.



Four things matter most.



1. Client coordination. Our clients are UK dental clinics and an e-commerce brand. You run their content approvals end to end (send the work, chase the decision, log the feedback, brief our designer), get client staff set up and actually using our systems, sort their access and logins, and follow up until things are done. You speak to clients directly, in writing and on the phone, with the founder in the loop.



2. Admin that keeps money moving. Invoice schedule and drafting, payment chasing, supplier and adviser follow-ups, account admin, password manager.



3. Keeping the record true. We run on Notion, Airtable, Slack and Google Workspace. You keep the picture accurate every day - what is done, what is waiting on whom, what happens next - so the founder does not have to hold it in his head.



4. Improving the machine. Processes get documented, gaps get closed, and things that keep going wrong get fixed at the root rather than chased every week.



You do not need to have used our exact tools. You do need to have built or run something for a team before, in any tool, and to be quick at picking up new ones. You will have a Claude seat and we expect you to use AI to move faster.



As the role grows: CRM checks in Airtable, client reporting, outbound work (lead lists,
 sequences, reply triage, demo booking), warm patient calls, and support across the founder's other ventures. Authority grows with trust, and we write the progression down.



HOURS



Part-time to start: 4 hours a day, Monday to Friday, in a fixed window inside UK business hours - normally 12pm to 4pm UK (7pm to 11pm Manila). Full-time is 9am to 5pm UK. The UK-hours requirement is not negotiable; you will be talking to UK clients.



PAY AND PROGRESSION



$500 per month part-time, rising to $1,500 per month on moving to full-time. We review at 4 weeks, and the move to full-time can happen as early as month one or two. 13th month pay, pro-rated while part-time. Performance bonus tied to agreed outcomes. Training budget for certification in the tools we use. We hire on capability and trajectory, not years - early-career candidates are welcome if you can show us the work.



MUST HAVE



Excellent written English. Evidence of a system or process you built or ran for a team - any tool, screenshots or a portfolio link. Comfortable on the phone with a clear, friendly manner. Reliable internet with a backup connection and backup power. ID Proof 80+, Timeproof, camera on for interviews. Able to commit to the fixed UK window now, and to full-time later.



NICE TO HAVE



Notion, Airtable, Xero, Slack, Google Workspace admin, Shopify, Klaviyo. Dental, healthcare or agency experience.



HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip this are not read)



1. Start your message with the word LATTICE, then link or describe a system you built or ran for a team - what was in it, and what problem it solved.

2. Write the exact message you would send to a clinic manager who has twice ignored our request for their Instagram login, and our designer cannot post without it. Just the message - no explanation.

3. A client
s to say a discount code is not working on their online store. You have access to the store. What are the first three things you check, and what do you send back to them?

4. Tell us about a process or system you fixed that people still use today - what was broken, and what did you change?

5. A client says on WhatsApp that a video needs fixes, but our task tracker shows it approved. What do you do, in order? Three to five sentences.



Shortlisted candidates do a 15-minute video call, then a paid 2 to 3 day trial on realistic tasks.

title: Outbound Sales Development Manager (SDR Manager) – U.S. B2B Security Services

We are looking for an experienced *Outbound Sales Development Manager / SDR Manager* to build, manage and continuously improve our outbound sales development team.



This is not an administrative sales-manager position.



You will be responsible for building a high-performance outbound sales operation that generates qualified appointments and recurring sales opportunities for our senior security consultants.

Because we target many industries, the ability to rapidly research new markets and develop prospecting strategies is extremely important.

Our SDRs primarily contact businesses through outbound cold calling and follow-up.



The SDR's responsibility is to identify the appropriate decision maker, understand the prospect's potential security needs, qualify the opportunity and schedule a meeting with one of our Senior Security Consultants.



The Senior Security Consultant conducts the detailed discovery call, determines scope, prepares the security proposal and works toward closing the account.



We primarily target recurring contracts for security guards, mobile patrols and security towers, while also pursuing temporary security assignments and RFP opportunities.

* Tasks

* Custom fields

* Follow-up workflows

* Sales reporting

* Agent performance



Prior GoHighLevel experience is strongly preferred.



What We Are Looking For



You should have:



* 3+ years of outbound B2B sales experience

* Experience selling to U.S. businesses

* Strong spoken English

* Strong written English

* Experience recruiting sales representatives

* Experience conducting call QA and coaching

* Experience creating scripts and objection-handling frameworks

* Strong CRM discipline

* Experience managing sales KPIs

* Strong prospect-research skills

* Experience building outbound pipelines from scratch

* Strong leadership and accountability skills



BPO, call-center management, outsourced sales management, security services, property-management sales or other B2B service experience is highly desirable.



How Performance Will Be Measured



We measure performance using real business outcomes, including:



* SDR productivity

* Qualified conversations

* Qualified appointments held

* Appointment show rates

* Qualified opportunities created

* Pipeline generated

* Security guard hours generated

* Monthly recurring revenue generated

* Proposal opportunities

* Closed accounts

* Call quality

* CRM accuracy

* SDR improvement

* Recruiting and retention



Application Requirements



Please submit:



1. Your resume.

2. A 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining your experience managing outbound sales teams.

3. The largest number of SDRs or sales representatives you have directly managed.

4. The industries you have sold into.

5. The CRMs you have used.

6. Your experience with GoHighLevel.

7. Your experience recruiting sales representatives.

8. Your typical daily outbound-call expectations for an SDR.

9. The KPIs you believe an outbound SDR team should be measured on.

10. A brief explanation of how you would coach an SDR who is making enough calls but not booking qualified appointments.



Applicants who successfully complete the initial interview process may be asked to complete a *paid practical sales-management assessment* involving prospect research, call review, coaching and CRM/pipeline strategy.



We are looking for a manager who can build a department—not someone who simply monitors one.

title: Corporate Compliance & Company Administration Officer
description:
We are hiring a detail-oriented professional to manage company formation and renewals, bank compliance packs, supplier agreement and invoice checks, and day-to-day corporate administration. You will work closely with internal finance, operations, and leadership teams and keep deadlines tight.



ROLE OVERVIEW



You will own the lifecycle of our companies (new formations and annual renewals), respond to bank and KYC/compliance requests on time, check that supplier invoices match signed agreements, and handle structured administrative work. Accuracy, confidentiality, and follow-through matter more than flashy titles.





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Company formation and renewals

- Manage incorporation of new companies and the full renewal cycle of existing entities (filings, permits, statutory records, officer/shareholder updates).

- Maintain a compliance calendar for filings, local permits, registered office, and other statutory deadlines (and equivalent requirements if we operate in other jurisdictions).

- Prepare and track board/shareholder resolutions, secretary’s certificates, appointment/resignation documents, and statutory registers.

- Coordinate with external counsel, incorporation agents, accountants, and government portals as needed.



Bank and regulatory compliance

- Review compliance and KYC requests from banks and other institutions.

- Gather, check, and package the required documents (corporate papers, IDs, resolutions, beneficial ownership, proof of address, financials, etc.).

- Draft clear replies and submit complete packs before the deadline.

- Follow up until confirmation of receipt / account status is closed.

- Flag inconsistencies (names, dates, officers, ownership) before anything is sent out.



Supplier agreements and invoice audit

- Review supplier and vendor agreements and keep a simple register of key terms (rates, scope, payment terms, validity, notice periods).

- Audit incoming invoices against the signed agreement and approved POs.

- Query mismatches (wrong rates, extra line items, expired contracts, missing attachments) and escalate before payment.

- Support contract renewals, amendments, and version control of signed files.



Administration and internal coordination

- Handle ad-hoc administrative tasks: document compilation, filing (digital and physical if required), tracking lists, templates, and status reports.

- Liaise with finance, operations, legal, and management so everyone has the latest company and vendor documents.

- Maintain organized shared folders, naming conventions, and access control for confidential files.

- Prepare simple trackers and weekly status updates on open formations, renewals, bank requests, and invoice exceptions.

- Support onboarding of new entities (bank account opening packs, tax/registration follow-ups, officer KYC).

- Other related duties as assigned.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



Must-have

- Filipino citizen, based in the Philippines (or able to work PH hours).

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Experience in company secretarial / corporate compliance / legal operations / finance admin / BPO corporate services — ideally involving company registration, renewals, bank KYC packs, or contract-to-invoice checking.

- High attention to detail; comfortable working to hard deadlines.

- Confident using Google Workspace and/or Microsoft 365 (Docs/Word, Sheets/Excel, Drive/SharePoint,
).

- Able to handle confidential information with discretion.

- Self-starter who still knows when to escalate.



Nice to have

- Familiarity with secretary’s certificates, board resolutions, beneficial ownership forms, and bank account opening checklists.

- Experience chasing vendors or AP teams on invoice discrepancies.

- e-signature tools (DocuSign, Adobe Sign) and a ticketing or tracker tool (Asana, ClickUp, Monday, Jira, or similar).

Experience level

We will consider candidates with 2+ years in a similar function. Strong 1-year candidates with proven filing and bank-pack experience are welcome to apply.





How you will work

- Own your tracker: nothing should miss a deadline because it sat in

title: Merchant Support Officer (Technical)
description:
We are hiring a technical Merchant Support Officer to help merchants integrate our payment APIs and to resolve live transaction issues. You will be the first technical point of contact over live chat and
, and you will work closely with engineering, product, and operations.

title: Social Media Coordinator
description:
Knightwing Media is hiring a Social Media Coordinator to help manage our growing roster of client social accounts.



We create photo, video, and social content for a wide variety of brands, and we’re looking for someone who genuinely understands social media. Not just someone who can schedule a post, but someone who knows what good content looks like, catches when something feels off, and can help make sure every brand we manage feels intentional and consistent.



What You’ll Be Doing



You’ll help manage the day-to-day organization and quality control of our clients’ social media content.



This includes:



Managing and maintaining multiple client social media calendars

Organizing content so posts are scheduled strategically and consistently

Reviewing captions before they are sent to clients or published

Quality checking social media videos before they go live

Making sure videos feel polished, engaging, and appropriate for the individual brand

Catching editing mistakes, spelling errors, awkward cuts, caption issues, branding inconsistencies, or anything that simply doesn’t feel right

Communicating revision notes to our editing team when changes are needed

Helping make sure content is formatted properly for Instagram,
, Reels, and other social platforms

Keeping track of client approvals, requested changes, and upcoming content

Understanding each client's individual voice so their social media never feels copy-and-paste

Staying aware of current social trends, editing styles, hooks, formats, and platform changes

We’re Looking for Someone Who...



Lives and breathes social media.



You should understand what makes someone stop scrolling, what makes a Reel feel current, when an edit feels dated, when text on screen is too much, when a hook isn't strong enough, and when a piece of content simply needs another pass.



You should also be:



Extremely organized

Detail-oriented

Comfortable managing multiple brands at once

Able to give clear, constructive creative feedback

Familiar with Instagram and
, especially short-form video

Comfortable learning different brand voices

Able to work independently and keep projects moving

Strong with spelling, grammar, and written communication

Comfortable working with social scheduling and approval platforms



Experience with social media management, content creation, video editing, marketing, or a creative agency is a major plus.



About Knightwing Media



Knightwing Media is a photo, video, and creative media company working with brands across a variety of industries. Our content ranges from real estate and hospitality to local businesses, lifestyle brands, commercial clients, and more.



Because our clients are so different, one of the most important parts of this role is understanding that every brand should feel like its own brand.



We aren't looking for someone to slap the same trending audio, caption formula, and editing style onto every account.



We want someone who can look at a piece of content and ask:



Does this actually feel like this client?



If you're naturally the person noticing why one Reel works and another doesn't, saving ideas on Instagram, watching trends evolve, and obsessing over the little details that make content feel polished, we'd love to hear from you.

title: UGC Content Creator — Luxury Travel Brand
description:
UGC Content Creator — Luxury Travel Brand

Part-time to Full-time · Remote · 20–40 hours/week · $5/hour + performance bonuses

Immediate start · Brand launch imminent

 

 

ABOUT THE BRAND

 

We are a luxury travel content brand in the final days before launch. The founder has deep travel experience, a strong personal brand, and a full content library ready to go. We are looking for one exceptional person to help us launch and grow — someone who shows up, pays attention, and takes ownership.

 

Platforms: Instagram (primary), TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube

Content style: Luxury travel, smart travel strategies, real hotel reviews, personal stories

Stage: Imminent launch — sprint mode starts now.

 

 

THE ROLE

 

This is not a task-execution role. We need a creative partner who thinks ahead, catches things others miss, and brings real expertise to the work. You will be producing content, managing platforms, building pitch decks for brand partnerships, and automating workflows using AI.

 

The founder handles filming, brand decisions, approvals, and deal negotiations. You handle everything else — and you handle it well the first time.

 

Hours: 20–40 hours per week. Sprint capacity required immediately — the brand is launching now.

Schedule: Flexible — but morning and evening EST availability is required.

Rate: $5 USD per hour to start.

Launch bonus: Significant performance bonus tied to successful brand launch. This is real — not a talking point.

Growth: Ongoing raises and performance bonuses based on results. This role grows with the brand. The right person grows with it.

Tools provided: Google Workspace, Canva Pro, CapCut — all at no cost to you.

Start: Immediate.

 

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

 

1 — UGC Content Creation & Editing

- Edit raw footage into polished Reels — strong hooks, tight pacing, on-brand captions, trending audio.

- Design branded carousels and static graphics from approved copy. On-brand, elevated, never generic.

- Quick turnaround is non-negotiable. Deliver on time, every time.

- When something doesn't look right or match the brief — say so before you produce it, not after.

 

2 — Content Operations

- Write platform-specific captions for IG, TikTok, Pinterest, and YouTube in the creator's voice.

- Build and maintain content briefs, hashtag banks, and keyword lists.

- Schedule and publish content across all platforms.

- Build lead magnet PDFs tied to comment keyword triggers.

- Submit weekly content ideas in a standard format.

 

3 — Brand Partnerships & Pitch Decks

- Research hotel, resort, and brand partnership opportunities.

- Build polished pitch decks for outreach to US-based brands and properties.

- Manage outreach, follow-ups, and partnership pipeline tracking.

- Manage brand presence on UGC platforms — Billo, JoinBrands, 
.

 

4 — AI Automation & Workflow

- Use agentic AI tools to automate content scheduling, posting workflows, and repetitive tasks.

- This goes beyond using ChatGPT to write captions — you know how to build and run automated workflows.

- Document your AI processes so they can be repeated and improved.

 

5 — Social Media Management

- Monitor, respond, and engage across all platforms in the creator's voice.

- Track weekly performance metrics and flag what is working and what is not.

- Stay current on platform trends, algorithm changes, and trending audio.

 

 

WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

 

REQUIRED — Extensive UGC experience. You have created UGC content for real brands, worked on UGC platforms, and have a portfolio that proves it. Not just social media management — actual UGC deliverables. No UGC experience means no consideration.

 

REQUIRED — US-based client experience. You have worked with US-based clients and understand the market, the platforms, and the pace.

 

REQUIRED — Pitch deck creation. You have built pitch decks for brand partnerships or business development. You can create a polished, compelling deck from scratch.

 

REQUIRED — Agentic AI fluency. You use AI to build automated workflows, not just to write captions. You can show us specifically how you use it.

 

- Attention to detail — you follow direction the first time. You catch inconsistencies before they become problems. You compare information and flag when something doesn't add up.

- Proactive communication — you push back when something doesn't seem right. You update before you are asked. You never go quiet.

- Quick turnaround — when something needs to go out, it goes out. Launch sprint ready.

- Urban / hip hop cultural fluency — you genuinely live in this space. You know what audio is trending before it peaks. You understand the cultural nuances that make content feel authentic versus forced.

- Deep understanding of the travel industry — you don't need to have traveled everywhere but you need to understand the space. You know the difference between luxury and budget travel, you consume travel content, and you understand why someone chooses one brand over another.

- EST morning and evening availability — flexible schedule but responsive during key windows.

 

 

COMPENSATION & GROWTH

 

Starting rate: $5 USD per hour

Hours: 20–40 per week. Sprint capacity required immediately.

Launch bonus: Significant performance bonus tied to successful brand launch. Specifics discussed at offer stage.

Performance bonuses: Ongoing bonuses based on results — content performance, partnership deals closed, workflow improvements.

Raises: Regular rate reviews based on performance. This role is designed to grow.

Tools: Google Workspace, Canva Pro, CapCut — provided at no cost.

 

 

HOW TO APPLY

 

We read every application carefully. A generic application will not be considered.

 

Your application must include:

 

1. Introduction

Who you are, what you do best, and why this role is the right fit right now. Specific — not generic.

 

2. UGC Experience — REQUIRED

Tell us specifically what UGC work you have done, which brands you worked with, and what the deliverables were. No UGC experience means no consideration — do not skip this.

 

3. US Client Experience — REQUIRED

Which US-based clients have you worked with and what did you produce for them?

 

4. Pitch Deck Experience — REQUIRED

Have you built pitch decks for brand partnerships or business development? Tell us what they were for and share an example if possible.

 

5. AI Automation

Tell us specifically how you use agentic AI to automate workflows. Which tools, which processes, what results. "I use ChatGPT to write captions" is not an answer.

 

6. Portfolio

Show us your Reel editing work, carousel designs, pitch decks, and any automated workflows you have built. Links or attachments — no portfolio, no consideration.

 

7. The brand question

In 2–3 sentences: based on what you know from this posting, what do you think is the single biggest content opportunity for a luxury travel brand right now?

 

8. Availability

Confirm you are available to start immediately and that you have morning and evening EST availability. Tell us specifically when you are typically online.

 

9. Subject line — REQUIRED

Your application subject line must read exactly: "Luxury Travel Brand — UGC VA Application". Applications without this exact subject line will not be reviewed. This is your first attention-to-detail test.

 

 

GREEN FLAGS — We want to see these:

- Your UGC portfolio is strong and specific — real brands, real deliverables, real results.

- You have worked with US-based clients and your work reflects an understanding of the US market.

- You describe your AI automation workflows in specific, technical terms — not vague generalities.

- You reference the travel industry or luxury travel content in your application.

- You catch something in this posting and mention it — a question, an inconsistency, a detail worth flagging.

- You go beyond what we asked for and add something that shows your thinking.

 

RED FLAGS — These will disqualify your application:

- No UGC experience or portfolio.

- No US client experience.

- You have never built a pitch deck.

- "I use AI to help with my work" with no specifics.

- Generic opener with no reference to this brand or this role.

- You took 24+ hours to respond during the application process.

- You need to be asked multiple times before addressing feedback.

 

 

We are building something real in the luxury travel space.

We need someone who catches things others miss — and says so.

If that's you — we want to hear from you.

title: Land Comps Specialist (Vacant Land Pricing Analyst)
description:
Peakridge Property Group is a U.S.-based land investment company that buys and sells vacant land across multiple states. Our business is built on disciplined pricing, accurate research, and fast execution. Every purchase decision we make is based on real data, not assumptions.



We are currently looking for a Land Comps Specialist (Vacant Land Pricing Analyst) to support our acquisitions process. This role is responsible for researching vacant land properties, analyzing comparable sales, and helping determine realistic offer prices based on actual market conditions.



This is not a sales role. It is a research and analysis role. You will spend most of your time reviewing data, pulling comps, working in spreadsheets, and documenting pricing logic clearly so decisions can be made quickly and confidently.



This position is best suited for someone who enjoys detailed research, working with numbers, and following structured systems.



What you’ll be responsible for:



Reviewing vacant land parcels that our team is evaluating for purchase



Researching recent comparable land sales in the same county or nearby areas



Analyzing acreage, access, location, pricing trends, and market activity



Calculating price-per-acre and identifying conservative value ranges



Flagging potential risks or inconsistencies in data



Recording comps, notes, and pricing logic clearly in spreadsheets or CRM



Supporting the acquisitions team with accurate, well-documented pricing analysis



What we are looking for:



Previous experience with real estate research, land comps, or property analysis



Strong attention to detail and ability to work consistently



Comfortable using spreadsheets and online research tools



Ability to follow pricing rules and avoid speculation or emotional valuation



Reliable computer and internet connection



Familiarity with land platforms such as LandPortal is a big plus, but not required



Why you’ll like this role:



Clear expectations and structured workflows



No cold calling, no selling, and no customer service work



Focused research tasks with minimal distractions



Long-term opportunity with a growing U.S.-based company



Performance-based bonuses tied directly to closed deals



Opportunity to grow into a more senior pricing or analytical role over time



Compensation:



$4 per hour



$100 bonus for every deal that successfully closes



SKILLS TEST (REQUIRED TO APPLY)



Please complete all of the following tests. Applications without completed tests will not be reviewed.



Test 1 – Pricing & Logic

In your own words, explain how you would determine a fair offer price for a vacant land property. Include what data points you would look for and how you would use comparable sales to arrive at a number.



Test 2 – Writing & Clarity

Rewrite the sentence below so it is clear, professional, and easy to understand:

“I look land price and maybe good but need check more to see if buyer want it.”



Test 3 – Research Ability

Using Google, find the county assessor or property appraiser website for Gila County, Arizona.

Paste the link and briefly explain what information on that site would be useful when pricing vacant land.



Test 4 – Attention to Detail

Two vacant lots recently sold in the same county:



Lot A: 2.1 acres sold for $29,400



Lot B: 3.4 acres sold for $44,200



Calculate the approximate price per acre for each lot and explain which one would be more relevant when pricing a 2.5-acre parcel, and why.



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit:



Your resume



Your completed skills test answers



Include “Land Comps VA 2026” in the subject line of your application so we know you read the entire description.

title: Freight Broker Operations Support Specialist – U.S. Trucking & Logistics
description:
Modern Transit is looking for an experienced, highly organized Freight Broker Operations Support Specialist to join our growing U.S. transportation team.



This position will work directly with our freight brokerage operations team to help manage shipments from pickup through delivery. We are looking for someone who understands that great logistics operations require communication, urgency, accuracy, and follow-through.



This is more than a traditional virtual assistant position. You will become part of the daily operation of Modern Transit and help ensure our customers, carriers, and internal team receive excellent support.



What You'll Be Doing



• Conducting carrier check calls and monitoring shipments from pickup through delivery

• Communicating with drivers and carriers regarding shipment status, ETAs, delays, and exceptions

• Updating shipment statuses and notes within our Transportation Management System (TMS)

• Assisting with DAT load posting and carrier sourcing when needed

• Confirming pickup and delivery appointments

• Verifying that carriers are on-site for scheduled pickups and deliveries

• Providing proactive shipment updates to the Modern Transit operations team

• Identifying potential late pickups or deliveries before they become service failures

• Requesting and organizing PODs, BOLs, rate confirmations, and other shipment documents

• Assisting with detention, layovers, TONUs, and other shipment exceptions

• Building and updating loads within our systems

• Maintaining accurate records using Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets

• Supporting freight brokers and account managers with daily operational tasks

• Escalating urgent shipment issues to management when necessary

• Helping maintain organized, accurate, and professional communication throughout the shipment lifecycle



Who We're Looking For



Previous experience supporting a U.S.-based freight brokerage, trucking company, 3PL, dispatch operation, or logistics company is strongly preferred.



The ideal candidate has experience with some combination of DAT, TMS platforms, carrier communication, load tracking, freight brokerage operations, dispatching, Excel, Google Sheets, and U.S. trucking terminology.



We're especially interested in someone who can think instead of simply follow instructions.



If a driver hasn't moved in several hours, we want you to notice.



If an appointment is approaching and the truck isn't close enough, we want you to recognize the risk.



If a carrier stops responding, we want you to escalate the situation.



If something doesn't look right in the TMS, we want you to ask questions.



What Success Looks Like



A successful Operations Support Specialist helps our freight brokers spend less time chasing routine shipment information and more time serving customers, sourcing capacity, negotiating freight, and growing the business.



You'll be expected to communicate proactively, maintain accurate information, follow established processes, and take ownership of your responsibilities.



Skills We're Looking For



Strong written and spoken English is required. Candidates should also have excellent attention to detail, professional communication skills, good judgment, time management, computer proficiency, and the ability to work with multiple shipments and systems simultaneously.



Because you'll support U.S. transportation operations, candidates must also be comfortable working U.S. business hours.



Who We Are



Modern Transit is a growing transportation organization focused on providing dependable and responsive logistics solutions.



Our culture is built around faith, integrity, service, accountability, growth, and treating people the right way.



We're building a team for the long term. We're looking for people who want more than a temporary online job—we want individuals who are interested in developing their skills, taking on greater responsibility, and growing alongside Modern Transit.



How to Apply



Please include the following with your application:



A brief introduction about yourself.

Your experience working with U.S. freight brokers, trucking companies, 3PLs, or dispatch operations.

The TMS platforms, load boards, or transportation software you've previously used.

Your experience communicating directly with U.S. truck drivers and carriers.

Your Excel / Google Sheets experience.

Your availability to work U.S. Central Time.

Your expected monthly salary in USD.

A short example of a difficult transportation issue you handled and how you resolved it.



At the very end of your application, include the words “OWN THE LOAD.”



Applications that do not include this phrase may not be considered.
