title: Research, Sourcing & Executive Assistant (Part-Time, Long-Term)
description:
Research, Sourcing & Executive Assistant

Part-Time | Approximately 10 Hours/Week | Long-Term



ABOUT THE ROLE



A small investment and acquisition firm is seeking a highly organized, proactive Virtual Assistant.



This is a hybrid role combining:



• Business research and acquisition sourcing

• CRM and follow-up management

• Executive assistant support

• Task tracking and accountability



This role is not designed for someone who simply waits for assignments and completes them. The successful candidate will help ensure that important tasks, leads, commitments, and follow-ups actually get completed.



A major part of the role is maintaining follow-through. If an important task, lead, commitment, or follow-up remains outstanding, the assistant should notice it, raise it again, and continue tracking it until it is completed, deliberately postponed, delegated, or no longer relevant.



RESPONSIBILITIES



1. BUSINESS RESEARCH & SOURCING



• Research companies that fit specific acquisition criteria

• Build and maintain targeted company and lead lists

• Identify company owners and key decision makers

• Find and verify contact information

• Research industries, companies, intermediaries, and potential capital relationships

• Document research and sources clearly

• Enter and maintain information in HubSpot

• Organize and clean data in Google Sheets/Excel

• Conduct research independently from written criteria rather than requiring step-by-step instructions



2. CRM, OUTREACH & FOLLOW-UP



• Maintain accurate records in HubSpot

• Track outreach and follow-up tasks

• Ensure active relationships and leads have a clear next action

• Identify overdue or stale follow-ups

• Maintain waiting and follow-up lists

• Flag unanswered outreach and relationships that need attention

• Prompt the principal when a call,
, response, or decision is needed

• Help prevent opportunities and relationships from falling through the cracks



3. EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT & ACCOUNTABILITY SUPPORT



• Maintain and organize task lists and priorities

• Turn
s, conversations, meetings, and requests into clear action items

• Track commitments, deadlines, and outstanding decisions

• Provide reminders for important tasks

• Follow up again when something remains incomplete

• Surface overdue, forgotten, or blocked items instead of letting them disappear

• Help distinguish urgent tasks from items that can wait

• Prepare simple meeting agendas, notes, and follow-up lists

• Assist with scheduling and calendar coordination when needed

• Organize documents and information

• Handle other administrative projects as needed



The successful candidate should be comfortable being professionally persistent.



If an important task has been raised but remains incomplete, the expectation is not to assume it has been abandoned. Continue bringing it forward until a clear decision is made about what should happen next.



APPROXIMATE WEEKLY TIME ALLOCATION



This will vary depending on priorities, but a typical 10-hour week may look approximately like:



4 hours — Business research, acquisition sourcing, list building, and contact research



2 hours — HubSpot updates, outreach tracking, and follow-up management



2 hours — Executive assistant support, task tracking, reminders, and accountability



1 hour — Scheduling, document organization, meeting preparation, and other administrative work



1 hour — Weekly review, cleanup, priority identification, and communication



These are guidelines rather than fixed quotas. Some weeks may require significantly more sourcing; others may require more follow-up or executive-assistant support.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



• Excellent written English

• Strong internet and business research skills

• Very high attention to detail

• Organized and dependable

• Comfortable following detailed written instructions

• Able to work independently

• Proactive rather than waiting for every next instruction

• Persistent about follow-up without needing constant supervision

• Good judgment about when to remind, escalate, ask a question, or continue independently

• Comfortable maintaining multiple open tasks and relationships

• Strong Google Sheets or Excel skills

• CRM experience preferred; HubSpot experience is a plus

• Google Workspace experience

• Previous VA, Executive Assistant, research, lead-generation, or sourcing experience is helpful



Candidates do not need to know everything on day one. Accuracy, initiative, reliability, judgment, ability to learn, and follow-through are more important than having every specific skill already.



SCHEDULE & COMPENSATION



Approximately 10 hours per week initially.





This is intended to be a long-term working relationship. Responsibilities and hours may grow over time for the right person.



HOW TO APPLY



Please do not send only a generic cover letter.



In the application:



1. Briefly explain why this specific combination of research, sourcing, follow-up, and executive-assistant work is a good fit.



2. Give one specific example of research, sourcing, lead generation, or list-building work previously performed.



3. Give one specific example of how a manager, executive, client, or team was kept organized and how unfinished work was followed up on.



4. List the CRM, spreadsheet, task-management, and Google Workspace tools previously used.



5. Provide desired monthly compensation for approximately 10 hours per week.



6. Answer this question:



On Monday, an important business owner still needs to be contacted. On Wednesday, the task remains incomplete. What would you do next?



7. Research question:



Assume the firm is looking for privately owned U.S. companies in a specific industry with approximately $2 million to $10 million in revenue.



Briefly explain how you would:

• Find companies that might fit

• Determine whether they are privately owned

• Identify the likely owner or decision maker

• Find and verify contact information

• Document your sources and confidence level



Please describe your process step by step, including the websites, databases, search methods, or tools you would use.



Please answer all questions directly. Following the application instructions is part of the evaluation process.

We’re looking for a motivated and experienced Architectural CAD Technician / Draftsman to help us create accurate and detailed drawings for our growing portfolio of residential and commercial lighting projects across the U.S. 



What You’ll Do 

1. CAD Drafting & Design 

Create accurate and detailed CAD drawings, layouts, site plans, and technical drawings based on project requirements, measurements, and design concepts. 

2. Lighting Plans & Documentation 

Develop lighting layouts, elevations, and other project documentation to support residential and commercial lighting installations. 

3. Drawing Revisions & Updates 

Review and revise drawings based on project changes, feedback, measurements, and specifications while maintaining accuracy and consistency. 

4. Project File Management 

Organize and maintain CAD files, drawings, project documentation, and revisions in an organized and accessible system. 

5. Quality & Accuracy 

Review drawings for accuracy, dimensions, completeness, and compliance with project requirements before submission. 

6. Collaboration 

Work closely with project managers, designers, and other team members to understand project requirements and deliver drawings on schedule. 



 Who You Are 

- 3+ years experience as a CAD Technician, Draftsman, Architectural Drafter, or similar role 

- Proficient in AutoCAD or similar CAD software

title: Full-Arch Phone Closer - US Dental Patients - $1,200-$1,600/mo + Bonus - Night Shift - 10 Apply Points
description:
FULL-ARCH PHONE CLOSER

GnA Consulting · The Conversion Lab · Remote



Salary. $1,200 to $1,600 per month, paid on the 1st and the 15th, every time. Plus $15 to $25 for every consultation that shows up and starts. Where you land in the band depends on what we hear in your recording, not on your resume. A closer who converts clears the top of it.



Schedule. 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM Philippine time, Monday to Friday. This is a night shift and your whole schedule inverts. If that doesn't work for your household, please don't apply.



Volume. 90 to 100 dials a shift: new inquiries, follow-ups and voi
s. New leads get a call inside 10 minutes. Consultations get booked inside 2 business days, because the longer the wait, the less likely the patient shows.



ABOUT THE WORK

We work with dental practices in the United States. You'll be the first human a patient talks to after they raise their hand about full-arch implant treatment.



These are not small decisions. Most of the people you call have struggled with their teeth for years. They're embarrassed. They're scared of the procedure. They've been quoted a number that frightened them. Some have already sat in another office and walked out.



Booking the appointment is half the job. The other half is making sure they actually walk in the door. Your job is to understand the person behind the inquiry, find what's really in the way, and help the ones who should move forward commit to showing up.



This is not a call center seat and it is not a script. We train frameworks, not lines. You'll have to listen, think and lead the conversation in real time.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Call new inquiries fast, and build trust on the first call

- Ask real discovery questions and find what's actually driving the inquiry

- Read emotional cues and change your approach when the person needs something different

- Handle fear, embarrassment and money without flinching and without pushing

- Talk about financing and monthly payments with confidence

- Book the consultation, then build enough commitment that they actually show

- Follow up by phone, text and
 with the people who aren't ready yet

- Keep clean CRM notes. Every call, every time.

- Sit in weekly call reviews and role-play, and put the coaching into the next call



WHAT WE'RE ACTUALLY HIRING FOR

Empathy. You can connect with what somebody is going through. You don't say "I'm sorry to hear that" and move to the next question.



Emotional intelligence. You know when to slow down, when to be quiet, when to reassure, and when to stop asking and start leading.



Critical thinking. You can take everything a patient just gave you, work out what's really in the way, and d
 what to do next without a script telling you.



WHAT WE REQUIRE

- Real time in a sales seat. You've handled objections and carried a number. High-ticket, healthcare or consultative selling is a plus.

- Near-native spoken English. Clear and neutral. We assess this from your recording, not your resume.

- A quiet workspace, a headset and a stable wired connection. Mobile data and pocket WiFi won't work for this role.

- Coachability. We record calls and review the hard ones together every week.



Dental experience is preferred and not required. We'd rather train someone with exceptional communication, empathy and judgment than hire someone who knows dental words.



THIS IS PROBABLY NOT FOR YOU IF

- You need to read a script word for word

- Talking about money makes you uncomfortable

- You go passive the moment someone objects

- You think the job is done when the appointment is booked



HOW TO APPLY

Four steps. Read all four. Applications that skip a step aren't reviewed.



STEP 1. Record ONE voice recording at 
. One take.

Vocaroo is free, needs no account, and works on a phone. Press record once and do the whole thing in a single take.



Part 1, about 15 seconds. Say your first name, the city you live in, and the last thing you sold. Just talk. Don't write it down first.



Part 2, the three patients below. Say "Scenario A" out loud, then respond. Pause two seconds. "Scenario B," respond. Pause. "Scenario C," respond.



The patient is on the line right now and it's your turn to speak. Don't describe what you would say. Say it, out loud, to them.



Scenario A. The patient says: "I cover my mouth when I laugh. I stopped going to my grandson's baseball games because the other parents talk to me and I don't want to open my mouth."



Scenario B. The patient says: "You people want $38,000. My brother went to Mexico and got his done for nine. Why would I pay four times that?"



Scenario C. The patient says: "Tomorrow morning is fine, book it. Honestly, I've cancelled on two other offices already, but this time I mean it."



Length. Two to three minutes total. Four at the absolute most.



No script and no AI. Your voice is the entire thing we're listening for. We can hear the difference and it's an automatic no. There are no perfect answers.



Before you send it: copy the Vocaroo link, open it in a private or incognito window, and make sure it plays. A link we can't open is the same as no application. Paste the working link on the first line of your application.



STEP 2. Answer this one question in writing. Be specific.

Tell us about a customer who said yes to you on the phone and then didn't show up, didn't pay, or went silent. What do you think you missed on that call?



STEP 3. Use 10 Apply Points on this application.



STEP 4. Start your application with the words SHOW UP, so we know you read to the end.



We reply to everyone who completes all four steps.

title: Operations Execution Coordinator
description:
Operations Execution Lead  

Compensation: $1,400/month  



Mission  

Turn priorities into finished results.  



SteelSafe operates self-storage properties across the United States. There is always work that needs to get done: property issues, vendors, purchases, projects, recurring operations, and problems that cross multiple people or systems.   



Your job is to own that execution.  



Some work you will do yourself. Some you will delegate to team members, boots on the ground, or vendors.

When leadership hands you an outcome, we should be able to forget about it until you come back with the finished result.  





Operating Rules  

Own the result. Do not pass problems.   

Assigning is not completing. Delegated work is still your responsibility.   

Asana is the system of record. If it is not in Asana, it does not exist.   

No proof = not done.   

Move fast. Small problems get expensive when they sit.   

No silent failures. Surface risks early with a recovery plan.   

Bring solutions. If leadership must d
, bring the options and your recommendation.   

Close loops. Nobody should have to ask, “Whatever happened with that?”   

Build better systems. The better you get, the less time the same work should require.   



What You Own

Drive property work from problem to verified completion.   



Examples:   

Get unavailable units back to Rent-Ready.   

Coordinate cleanouts.   

Get doors, locks, leaks, roofs, gates, cameras, fencing, weeds, trash, signs, electrical issues, and other property problems resolved.   

Coordinate vendors, quotes, scheduling, execution, and proof.

Do not report that a unit is stuck.   



Get it unstuck.  



2. BOTG & Vendor Management

Find and hire BOTG and vendors.

Get quotes.   

Follow up.   

Verify work.  

Correct poor work.  

Replace underperformers.   

Maintain backup options.  



 “I asked them” is not a result.

Build new operational processes.  

Complete one-off projects leadership assigns.

When a customer or company issue requires operational action, own the execution.  



Investigate the problem, determine what needs to happen, coordinate the people involved, and drive it through resolution.  



Leadership owns unusual policy, legal, financial, or strategic decisions.  



Once the decision is made, you own getting it done.

Projects do not stall.  

Rent-Ready units do not sit because nobody followed through.  

Vendors and BOTG are held accountable.  

Problems are surfaced before deadlines are missed.

Take ownership without reminders.  

Finish what you start.

Can take an unfamiliar project and figure it out.  

Follow up relentlessly.  

Make good decisions independently.  

Keep many moving pieces organized.  

Communicate problems early.  

Hold vendors and teammates accountable.  

Care about details and proof.  

Enjoy turning messy work into reliable systems.  



Own the result, not the clock. Do what it takes to get the job done. Then improve the system so the same result takes less time and effort next time.

title: Insurance Virtual Assistant – Non-Licensed Service Support
description:
Hawkguard Insurance Services is growing, and our service team is the foundation of our success. We are looking for a dependable, organized, and technology-savvy *Virtual Assistant* to support our insurance service and sales teams.



This is a *non-licensed insurance support position*. The role is focused on administrative work, client service support, data entry, carrier follow-up, and helping our licensed team members work more efficiently.



Do you enjoy working in an environment where no two days are exactly the same?



Are you a fast learner who enjoys technology, organization, and solving problems?



Do you take pride in completing tasks accurately and following through until the job is finished?



Most importantly, do you enjoy being part of a team that communicates well and works together toward a common goal?



If so, we would love to hear from you.



Who We Are



At HawkGuard Insurance Services, our mission is simple:



*Guard Life Like a Hawk.”*



We accomplish this by evaluating our clients' needs, educating them about their insurance options, and providing access to industry-leading insurance companies and products.



We focus just as much on the human side of insurance as we do on the policies themselves. At the end of the day, we put people ahead of products.



Our Virtual Assistant plays an important role behind the scenes by helping our licensed team provide an organized, efficient, and outstanding client experience.



Position Overview



The Insurance Virtual Assistant provides administrative support to our Personal Lines, Commercial Lines, Service, and Sales teams.



This position does *not* require an insurance license and does not involve recommending insurance coverage, advising clients regarding insurance products, binding coverage, or performing other activities that require an insurance license.



Instead, you will help our licensed team by gathering information, processing requests, maintaining accurate records, following up on outstanding items, and completing administrative tasks throughout the insurance process.



Job Responsibilities



Responsibilities may include:



* Assisting with personal and commercial insurance policy renewals.

* Gathering information and documents needed by licensed Account Managers and Producers.

* Processing administrative policy service requests.

* Assisting with billing-related questions and directing insurance-specific questions to licensed staff.

* Processing mortgage company and lienholder updates.

* Assisting with third-party requests.

* Requesting and gathering documents from clients.

* Sending applications, forms, policy documents, and other paperwork to clients.

* Following up with clients for signatures, applications, photos, documents, and underwriting requirements.

* Assisting with certificate of insurance requests under the direction of licensed staff.

* Entering information into insurance carrier websites and agency systems.

* Assisting licensed team members with the insurance quoting process by entering client and risk information into approved systems.

* Gathering information necessary for personal and commercial insurance quotes.

* Preparing quote information for review by a licensed Producer or Account Manager.

* Following up with insurance carriers regarding the status of applications, endorsements, inspections, and underwriting requirements.

* Downloading and organizing policy documents.

* Updating client records in our Agency Management System.

* Creating and updating tasks in our workflow management system.

* Maintaining agency spreadsheets, reports, and tracking systems.

* Monitoring outstanding tasks and following up when additional information is needed.

* Assisting the Sales Team with administrative and post-sale activities.

* Assisting the Service Team with day-to-day administrative requests.

* Maintaining accurate documentation of activities and communications.

* Helping ensure tasks are completed accurately and within established agency timelines.



 What This Position Does Not Do



Because this is a non-licensed position, the Virtual Assistant will not:



* Recommend insurance coverage or coverage limits.

* Provide insurance advice.

* Explain or interpret insurance coverage for clients.

* Negotiate insurance coverage.

* Sell or solicit insurance.

* Bind insurance coverage.

* Make coverage changes without authorization and direction from licensed agency personnel.



Insurance-related questions requiring a license will be referred to one of our licensed Producers or Account Managers.



 Professional Skills Desired



We are looking for someone who is extremely comfortable working on a computer and learning new systems.



The ideal candidate:



* Is highly proficient with computers and online applications.

* Is comfortable working with multiple programs and browser windows throughout the day.

* Has strong Microsoft Office and Google Workspace skills.

* Is comfortable working with Excel and spreadsheets.

* Types quickly and accurately.

* Learns new software and processes quickly.

* Communicates professionally in written and spoken English.

* Has excellent written communication skills.

* Is highly organized.

* Pays close attention to details.

* Can manage multiple tasks and priorities.

* Follows instructions and established procedures.

* Is comfortable working from checklists and workflows.

title: Remote Video Editor – Social Media & Events
description:
SipTales is a growing Australian mocktail and event-service business based in Sydney. We specialise in weddings, nikkahs, engagements, birthdays, corporate events, bridal showers and other celebrations.



We’re looking for a creative and reliable video editor based in the Philippines to help turn our event and social media footage into engaging short-form content.



The role will initially be freelance/gig-based, with approximately 2–3 videos per week. As our content output grows, there is potential for this to develop into consistent part-time work.



What You’ll Be Editing



The content will vary from video to video, but the main types will be:



1. Talking Head / Business Videos

Videos introducing new SipTales services, products and packages, or explaining different parts of the business.

Example:




==


==



2. Event Edits & Montages

Engaging or cinematic edits showcasing events we have served, including:

• Wedding mornings

• Nikkahs

• Engagements

• Birthdays

• Corporate events

• Bridal showers

• Other private events

Example:




==


==


==



3. BTS / Trend / Fun Content

More casual behind-the-scenes content, trending Reels/TikToks, team videos and other personality-driven content.

Example:




==


==


==



There will also be opportunities to work on other styles of content as SipTales grows.



What the Work Will Involve

You will generally be responsible for:

• Reviewing raw footage and selecting the best clips

• Cutting/chopping footage into engaging short-form videos

• Creating good pacing and maintaining viewer attention

• Colour correcting and colour grading footage

• Adding captions/subtitles

• Adding text animations and graphics where appropriate

• Adding sound effects and other audio effects

• Selecting and syncing music

• Adding transitions and video effects where they improve the edit

• Following reference videos and SipTales' existing editing style

• Making revisions based on feedback

• Returning the completed Premiere Pro / After Effects project files with each project



Most videos will be produced for platforms such as Instagram Reels and TikTok, so an understanding of short-form social content is important.



Creative Input



Some videos will come with fairly clear direction and references from us.



For others, we would love an editor who can bring their own creative ideas to the project.



If you think a different song, hook, transition, sound effect, editing concept or structure would make the video better, we are absolutely open to your suggestions.



We want someone who can follow direction when required but also has the creative judgement to create an edit rather than simply putting clips together.



Footage & Equipment Requirements



Most of our footage is filmed on a Sony ZV-E1, generally in 4K 60fps.

You will therefore need a computer capable of comfortably editing and exporting this footage.

Footage and project files will primarily be transferred through Google Drive.



Preferred Editing Software

We ideally want someone who works within the Adobe Creative Suite, particularly:

• Adobe Premiere Pro

• Adobe After Effects where required

Adobe is what we currently use internally, so this will make project collaboration and handover much easier.



Bonus Skills

These are not required, but are a big plus:

• Adobe Lightroom for editing photos

• Canva for graphics and Instagram carousels

• After Effects / motion graphics

• Experience editing event or wedding content

• Experience editing hospitality, food or beverage content

• Understanding current Instagram and TikTok trends

• Basic graphic design skills

• Ability to create engaging hooks and storytelling from raw footage



Turnaround Times



Turnaround time will depend on the type and complexity of each video.

A simple Reel may require a relatively quick turnaround, while a more involved event montage or effects-heavy video may have a longer deadline.

Deadlines will be agreed upon when each project is assigned.



Working Hours



There are no fixed working hours and you do not need to work Australian business hours.

You can work when it suits you as long as:

• Communication is reliable

• Agreed deadlines are met

• You are reasonably responsive when revisions or questions come up



English Requirements



You do not need perfect English.

Your English simply needs to be strong enough for clear back-and-forth communication, understanding briefs, discussing ideas, asking questions and making revisions based on feedback.



Pay



Pay is negotiable based on your experience, editing ability and portfolio quality.

We are open to either:

• Hourly rates, or

• A fixed rate per video/project

We can discuss which arrangement works best depending on the type of content and your preferred way of working.

As our content requirements grow, there is potential for this freelance role to develop into more consistent part-time work.



Paid Test Edit



After reviewing applications and portfolios, shortlisted applicants may be offered a paid test edit using footage supplied by SipTales.

This will allow us to see how you:

• Interpret our footage and brief

• Select clips

• Structure a video

• Handle pacing

• Colour grade footage

• Use music and sound design

• Create captions and effects

• Apply your own creative judgement



The test edit will be paid. We are not looking for applicants to complete free work.



Who We're Looking For



Ideally, you are someone who:

• Has a strong eye for pacing and storytelling

• Understands what makes short-form content engaging

• Can produce clean, modern and polished edits

• Doesn't unnecessarily over-edit videos

• Can follow reference videos and creative direction

• Is also comfortable contributing your own creative ideas

• Has good judgement when choosing music, clips and effects

• Can work independently once given a brief

• Communicates reliably

• Meets agreed deadlines

• Is receptive to feedback and revisions

• Takes pride in the quality of the final video

• Is interested in potentially working with SipTales long-term



How to Apply



Please send us:

1. A short introduction about yourself and your video editing experience.

2. Examples of videos you have edited that are similar to the three types of content shown above.

If you don't have directly comparable work, simply send us 2–5 examples of your best work.

3. The software you primarily edit with.

4. Your preferred pricing structure and expected rate – hourly, per video

5. Your general weekly availability.

6. Your usual turnaround time for a standard 30–60 second Reel/TikTok.



Important



You do not need to have edited mocktail content before.

We're much more interested in finding someone with a strong editing eye, good creative judgement and the ability to understand references and adapt to the SipTales style.

We're looking for someone we can build a good working relationship with rather than simply finding an editor for one project.

title: Part-Time Remote Operations Support Assistant
description:
About the company



We are a New Zealand property management company specialising in short-term, medium-term and long-term accommodation. We manage a growing portfolio of properties and use technology, detailed processes and a remote team to deliver excellent outcomes for property owners and guests.



We are looking for a highly organised, accurate and dependable Operations Support Assistant based in the Philippines. This is a varied part-time position combining property listing coordination, general administration, marketing support and revenue-management assistance.



This role would suit someone who enjoys structured work, follows processes carefully and can move confidently between detailed administrative tasks and basic data analysis. Experience in short-term rentals or property management is useful but not essential. Previous revenue-management experience in hospitality, travel, aviation, retail, e-commerce or another industry would be beneficial.



The role



You will help coordinate new property listings from onboarding through to launch, maintain accurate property and platform information, and support our Marketing Manager and revenue-management work.



You will receive training and access to the company’s documented processes and knowledge base. We need someone who can follow these closely, complete every step, identify missing or conflicting information and ask questions rather than make assumptions.



 Key responsibilities



* Property setup and onboarding



- Set up and update property records and listings across our property-management and booking platforms.

- Review onboarding information, property documents, photos and existing records thoroughly.

- Create, edit and quality-check listings for channels such as Airbnb, 
, Vrbo and the company’s direct-booking website.

- Maintain accurate listing titles, descriptions, amenities, sleeping arrangements, house rules, access information, parking details and photos.

- Check that listings are complete, consistent, live, bookable and correctly connected across systems.

- Update calendars, availability, restrictions and other listing settings according to approved processes.

- Create and maintain property information, recurring tasks and operational requirements in relevant systems.

- Track onboarding progress clearly, meet deadlines and notify the appropriate team member when each stage is complete.

- Raise discrepancies, missing information, platform errors or possible risks promptly rather than guessing.



*Revenue-management support



- Assist with setting up new properties in revenue-management systems such as Wheelhouse.

- Help compare similar properties and organise pricing-reference information.

- Monitor approved performance indicators such as occupancy, booking pace, ADR, RevPAR, revenue, open nights and market performance.

- Support weekly pickup analysis and routine revenue reviews using the company’s documented process.

- Help identify short booking gaps, minimum-stay restrictions, pricing or availability issues, and listings that require deeper review.

- Prepare clear summaries and recommendations for management review.

- Record approved actions, follow-up dates and results accurately.

- Never change pricing or revenue settings outside the approved process or without the required authorisation.



*Marketing and general administration



- Assist the Marketing Manager with research, data entry, contact-list maintenance, campaign administration and reporting.

- Help prepare and update listing content, website information, marketing assets and property information.

- Support competitor, market and property research.

- Organise files, databases, trackers and task lists so information is accurate and easy to find.

- Prepare first drafts, summaries and reports from supplied information.

- Complete other reasonable administrative tasks as priorities change.



What we are looking for:



* Essential



- Exceptional attention to detail and a strong commitment to accuracy.

- Proven experience in administration, virtual assistance, operations support or a similar role.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Confidence working with detailed checklists, standard operating procedures and knowledge bases.

- Ability to manage repetitive work accurately without skipping steps.

- Good judgement: you know when to proceed, when to double-check and when to escalate.

- Strong organisation, time management and follow-through.

- Comfortable learning several online platforms and switching between tasks.

- Working knowledge of spreadsheets, cloud documents, task-management tools and online databases.

- Able to work independently while communicating progress clearly with a remote team.

- Honest, dependable and comfortable receiving feedback and correcting mistakes quickly.



*Beneficial



- Revenue-management, pricing, yield-management or performance-analysis experience in any industry.

- Experience with short-term rentals, accommodation, hospitality, travel, aviation, retail or e-commerce.

- Experience creating or managing listings on Airbnb, 
 or Vrbo.

- Familiarity with OwnerRez, Guesty, Wheelhouse, Breezeway, Enso Connect, Rentals United, Asana, Notion or similar systems.

- Experience reviewing booking pace, occupancy, rates, restrictions, market demand or competitor information.

- Copywriting, content administration, digital marketing or lead-research experience.



* Remote-work requirements



You must have your own reliable remote-work setup, including:



- A suitable computer capable of running multiple browser-based systems.

- Reliable high-speed internet.

- A dependable backup internet option.

- A practical backup-power solution for outages.

- A quiet, professional workspace suitable for calls and focused work.

- A headset and working camera for online meetings.

- Reliable availability during the agreed working schedule, including any agreed overlap with the New Zealand team.



Shortlisted applicants may be asked to provide an internet-speed screenshot and explain their backup internet and power arrangements.





*What success looks like



- Listings and records are complete, accurate and launched on time.

- Checklists are followed fully, even when work is repetitive.

- Missing or conflicting information is identified before it becomes a problem.

- Trackers, files and systems stay current and organised.

- Revenue and marketing support is clear, accurate and useful.

- Managers receive concise progress updates and do not need to chase tasks.

- Approved changes are documented and followed up.



*How to apply



Please send:



1. Your CV.

2. A short introduction explaining why this role suits you.

3. Details of your relevant administration, listing, marketing or revenue-management experience.

4. The systems and platforms you have used.

5. Your current availability and preferred working hours.

6. Your internet speed and details of your backup internet and power setup.

7. Contact details for two professional referees.

title: Short-Form Content VA | Post 5-10 Clips/Day Across TikTok, IG, YouTube Shorts (Long-Term Role)
description:
Overview



I run multiple businesses and I'm launching a short-form content operation that turns long YouTube videos into viral clips posted across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts,
 Reels, and X.



You will run this system end to end using AI tools that do the heavy lifting. You do NOT need video editing skills. The software (QuickCut) automatically cuts long videos into short clips, and a scheduler (Content360) posts them to every platform in one click. Your job is to operate the machine daily, follow the playbook exactly, and report the numbers.



This is a volume and consistency role. The person who wins this job is the one who shows up every single day, posts on schedule without being reminded, and keeps a clean tracking sheet.



____________________________________________



What You'll Do Daily:



Research YouTube for high-performing videos in our niches using the free vidIQ extension (you'll look for "outlier" videos that beat a channel's average by 5x or more)



Paste those YouTube URLs into QuickCut to auto-generate short clips



Review the clips and queue the best ones in Content360 (5-10 posts per day per page, across all platforms)



Set up recurring "posts on repeat" schedules so content never stops



Maintain our source list of creators (80% creators who do NOT post Shorts, 20% big creators who do)



Send permission and outreach DMs to creators using my exact templates, and log every response



Monitor our creator network 
 servers for campaign rules, payment structures, and updates



Track views per creator, per platform, and per page in a weekly report, and flag top performers as deal candidates



Set up new social accounts when we launch a new page (simple name, AI-generated logo, simple bio, same handle on every platform)



---------------------------------------------



What I Provide



Full training videos and a written step-by-step playbook for every task

All software accounts (QuickCut, Content360, vidIQ)

Exact copy/paste templates for every DM and message

Clear daily targets and a weekly reporting template



---------------------------------------------------

Requirements



Strong written English (you will DM creators on my behalf)



Extremely consistent and reliable. Daily posting is the whole job



Comfortable with TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and 



Basic Google Sheets skills for tracking and reporting



Follows SOPs exactly, and asks questions instead of guessing



Stable internet and available to post on a daily schedule



Bonus (not required): experience running theme pages, clip channels, or social media scheduling tools

-----------------------------------------------------------------



KPIs You'll Be Measured On:



Posts published per day per account (target: 5-10 on niche pages, 3-5 on dedicated accounts)



Total weekly views across all pages



Number of qualified outlier videos sourced per week



Outreach DMs sent and reply rate



Weekly report delivered on time, every week



Pay and Growth



Starting rate depends on experience, with a raise after a successful 90-day review. Performance bonuses available tied to view milestones. This is a long-term role. As the operation scales to more pages and more creator deals, your responsibility and pay scale with it.



-------------------------------------------------------



How to Apply



Reply with:



The word "OUTLIER" as the first word of your application (so I know you read this)

2-3 sentences about any experience with social media posting, theme pages, or scheduling tools

Your answers to these two questions: (a) A creator's rules say dedicated account only, but our checklist says post to the niche page. What do you do? (b) You notice one creator's clips got 400K views this week, triple everyone else. What do you do with that information?

Your available hours (include your time zone) and your expected monthly rate

title: Land Pricing Analyst
description:
Summary

We're a high-volume land flipping business looking for a sharp Land Pricing Analyst to join our team. 



You'll be analyzing and pricing vacant land properties (mostly rural/desert parcels) using comparable sales and our established criteria. 



The work is process-driven and steady — ideal for someone who enjoys focused analytical work.



You don't need a real estate background — if you're analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable doing focused solo work, we'll teach you the rest.

What you'll do:



Analyze and price a high volume of vacant land properties

Select and evaluate comparable sales, adjusting for differences in size, access, utilities, terrain, and location

Cross-reference data from county records, GIS/parcel maps, and assessor sites

Follow a structured process for pricing and basic due diligence

Flag unusual or higher-risk properties for review rather than forcing a number

Keep clean, organized records of your work



Skills we're looking for:



Strong comp selection judgment — knowing which sales are truly comparable and which to discard

Sound adjustment reasoning — understanding that price per acre isn't linear and adjusting accordingly

Data fluency — fast and accurate with spreadsheets and pulling data from multiple sources

Consistency — applying the same logic the same way across high volume

Attention to detail — catching access issues, easements, flood zones, and landlocked parcels

Good judgment — knowing the limits of the analysis and when to escalate



Who you are:



Analytical and detail-oriented

Some technical or analytical background is a plus (data, finance, engineering, CS, or similar), but not required

Comfortable with focused, heads-down work for long stretches

Self-directed and reliable

Able to communicate clearly

Solid internet connection



This is high-volume work, so consistency and accuracy both matter. If you take pride in clean, careful analysis, you'll fit in well here.



Please submit a short voice sample why you would be a good fit for this job.

title: Anti-Fraud Operations Specialist
description:
Role Overview



The Anti-Fraud Operations Specialist is responsible for protecting our users, platform, and brand from phishing, scams, fake domains, impersonation attempts, and other fraud-related threats.



The successful candidate will be responsible for monitoring alerts, investigating suspicious activity, documenting findings, submitting abuse and takedown requests, and following established Anti-Fraud SOPs and escalation procedures.



The role requires strong attention to detail, disciplined documentation, sound judgment, and the ability to work carefully with sensitive fraud and security-related cases.



Key Responsibilities

- Monitor and review phishing, scam, impersonation, and other fraud-related alerts and reports.

- Investigate suspicious websites, domains, URLs, links, wallet addresses, and reported fraud cases.

- Submit abuse reports, phishing reports, and takedown requests to relevant platforms, registrars, hosting providers, or other third parties.

- Maintain accurate case trackers, phishing watchlists, investigation records, evidence, and case outcomes.

- Follow established Anti-Fraud SOPs, investigation procedures, and escalation guidelines consistently.

- Act quickly on confirmed or suspected phishing and impersonation cases and escalate high-risk cases when required.

- Coordinate clearly with Support, Security, and other relevant teams to ensure cases are handled appropriately.

- Prepare clear investigation notes, case summaries, status updates, and reports on fraud cases handled.





Candidate Profile

- 2 years of experience handling fraud-related alerts and reports.

- Highly detail-oriented and able to identify suspicious patterns, inconsistencies, and fraud indicators.

- Reliable and disciplined in maintaining trackers, documentation, evidence, and follow-up records.

- Able to follow SOPs and escalation procedures carefully without skipping required steps.

- Comfortable working with links, websites, forms, reports, spreadsheets, and repetitive investigation tasks.

- Able to investigate information thoroughly and make sound assessments based on available evidence.

- Organized and capable of managing multiple cases while maintaining accuracy and timely follow-ups.

- Able to communicate and coordinate clearly with different internal teams.

- Comfortable handling sensitive fraud and security-related information with discretion and appropriate urgency.



Preferred Qualifications

- Previous experience in fraud operations, trust and safety, risk operations, security operations, abuse operations, brand protection, or a related field.

- Experience investigating phishing, scams, impersonation, fake domains, malicious URLs, or other forms of online abuse.

- Familiarity with domain registrations, WHOIS/RDAP information, hosting providers, registrars, social platforms, or common abuse-reporting processes.

- Experience submitting abuse reports or takedown requests to registrars, hosting providers, social media platforms, search engines, or other third parties.

- Familiarity with cryptocurrency or blockchain-related fraud investigations, including reviewing wallet addresses or transaction-related information, is an advantage.

- Experience working with case-management tools, spreadsheets, trackers, ticketing systems, or internal investigation platforms.

- Basic understanding of cybersecurity concepts related to phishing, social engineering, malicious domains, and account impersonation is an advantage.



Success in This Role

Success in this role means that fraud-related cases are identified quickly, investigated carefully, documented accurately, escalated appropriately, and followed through to resolution.



The Anti-Fraud Operations Specialist should be someone the organization can rely on to consistently execute established processes, maintain accurate records, recognize suspicious activity, and respond promptly when users or the brand is at risk.



Only shortlisted candidates and has experience in the role will be contacted

title: Human Resource Supervisor
description:
Role Purpose

The HR Supervisor is responsible for building and maintaining an effective workforce by ensuring the company attracts, develops, engages, and retains the right people while maintaining compliance, accountability, and strong organizational culture.



The role exists to ensure that Human Resources contributes directly to business performance by improving employee productivity, strengthening leadership capability, reducing people-related risk, supporting employee development, and creating systems that enable the company to grow sustainably.



This role is responsible for driving workforce effectiveness, organizational performance and culture through people, processes, and accountability.



CORE OUTCOMES (PRIMARY KPIs)

The HR Supervisor will be evaluated on their ability to consistently deliver the following outcomes:

1. Positions Filled Within Target Timeframes

• Vacancies are filled efficiently with qualified candidates.

• Recruitment pipeline remains active and effective.

2. Employee Retention & Stability

• Voluntary turnover remains within acceptable targets.

• New hires successfully complete probation periods.

3. Workforce Compliance & HR Administration

• Personnel records remain accurate and up to date.

• Payroll inputs are accurate and submitted on time.

• HR documentation remains compliant and audit-ready.

4. Employee Performance & Accountability

• Performance reviews are completed on schedule.

• Supervisors actively manage performance.

• Performance issues are addressed promptly.

5. Employee Engagement & Workplace Culture

• Employee concerns are addressed professionally.

• Employee engagement initiatives are implemented.

• Positive workplace culture is strengthened.

6. Training & Employee Development

• Training plans are kept current and implemented.

• Employee development activities are coordinated.

• Skills gaps are identified and addressed.

7. HR Systems & Process Improvement

• HR processes are documented and improved.

• Policies remain current and effective.

• Administrative efficiency improves over time.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Recruitment & Talent Acquisition

• Manage the end-to-end recruitment process.

• Develop and maintain talent pipelines.

• Coordinate interviews and candidate assessments.

• Conduct reference and background checks.

• Prepare offers and onboarding documentation.

• Monitor recruitment effectiveness and time-to-fill metrics.



Onboarding & Employee Integration

• Coordinate onboarding activities.

• Conduct employee orientation.

• Ensure all required employment documentation is completed.

• Monitor probationary employees.

• Support successful integration of new hires.



Employee Relations & Culture

• Serve as the primary point of contact for employee concerns.

• Support conflict resolution and workplace investigations.

• Promote fairness, consistency, and professionalism.

• Coordinate employee engagement initiatives.

• Conduct exit interviews and identify trends.



Performance Management

• Coordinate performance review processes.

• Support supervisors in setting expectations and managing performance.

• Facilitate Performance Improvement Plans where required.

• Monitor completion of performance evaluations.

• Assist management in succession and development planning.



Training & Development

• Identify training needs across departments.

• Coordinate internal and external training programs.

• Maintain training records.

• Support employee growth and career development initiatives.

• Assist with leadership development activities.

HR Administration & Compliance

• Maintain accurate employee records.

• Ensure personnel files remain complete and current.

• Manage leave tracking and attendance records.

• Coordinate payroll inputs and statutory deductions.

• Prepare HR reports and management information.

• Ensure compliance with labour laws and company policies.



Policy & Process Development

• Develop and update HR policies and procedures.

• Maintain employee handbook content.

• Improve HR systems and workflows.

• Create documentation and standard operating procedures where needed.

• Ensure consistency in policy application across the company.



Leadership Support

• Provide HR guidance to supervisors and managers.

• Assist leadership with workforce planning decisions.

• Identify people-related risks and opportunities.

• Provide HR metrics and recommendations to management.

• Support organizational change initiatives.



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

The HR Supervisor is measured on outcomes, not activity.

Success is demonstrated through:

• Reduced turnover.

• Stronger employee performance.

• Faster recruitment.

• Improved compliance.

• Better employee engagement.

• Accurate HR administration.

• Improved workforce capability.



The role is expected to proactively identify issues, recommend solutions, and drive continuous improvement.



QUALIFICATIONS

• Degree or Diploma in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, or related field.

• Minimum 3 years experience in Human Resources.

• Working knowledge of Guyana labour laws and HR best practices.

• Experience supporting recruitment, employee relations, and performance management activities.

• Strong administrative and organizational skills.



CORE COMPETENCIES

1. Employee Relations & Conflict Resolution

2. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition

3. Performance Management

4. Communication & Influence

5. Leadership & Coaching

6. Organization & Attention to Detail

7. Problem Solving & Decision Making

8. HR Compliance & Confidentiality

9. Process Improvement

10. Business & Commercial Awareness

title: Senior Accountant
description:

About RNB Capital



RNB Capital is an accounting and advisory firm focused on helping growing companies build the financial infrastructure necessary to support better decisions, stronger governance, access to capital, and long-term enterprise value.

The Role



We are seeking a strong Senior Accountant who combines solid technical accounting skills with curiosity, analytical thinking, professional judgment, and the ability to consistently meet deadlines.



This is not a bookkeeping-only position.



The Senior Accountant will be responsible for preparing and analyzing accounting and financial reporting work across client engagements, including monthly financial infrastructure engagements and financial statement review engagements. Team members may also participate in internal audit, internal control, and risk-related engagements. Prior internal audit experience is helpful but is not required; RNB provides structured methodologies, training, and tools for this work.



We are looking for someone who does more than complete assigned tasks. The right person should be able to understand the objective of the work, identify when something does not make sense, investigate discrepancies, ask thoughtful questions, manage priorities effectively, meet deadlines, and produce work that is ready for technical review.



This role is designed for an experienced individual contributor. It is not a management position, although strong performance can create opportunities for increased responsibility as the firm grows.



Key Responsibilities

-Accounting & Financial Infrastructure

-Prepare and maintain accurate accrual-basis accounting records.

-Perform monthly and period-end close procedures.

-Prepare account reconciliations and supporting schedules.

-Analyze balance sheet and income statement accounts for unusual activity, inconsistencies, or errors.

-Assist with cleanup and reconstruction of incomplete or inaccurate accounting records.

-Maintain organized supporting documentation and financial records.

-Assist with the development and maintenance of client financial infrastructure, including close procedures, accounting policies, schedules, controls, and documentation.

-Prepare financial statements and supporting schedules in accordance with U.S. GAAP, as applicable.

-Identify accounting issues requiring additional research or escalation.

-Assist with management reporting, variance analysis, trend analysis, and other financial insights.

-Support the maintenance of organized, stakeholder-ready financial information and virtual data rooms.

-Plan and prioritize work to meet engagement deadlines and communicate proactively when risks to timing arise.

-Financial Statement Reviews

-Prepare workpapers and supporting documentation for financial statement review engagements.

-Perform analytical procedures and investigate significant or unexpected fluctuations.

-Prepare financial statements and related disclosures.

-Assist with financial reporting for companies participating in private and public capital markets.

-Evaluate financial information for internal consistency and agreement with underlying accounting records.

-Assist with technical accounting research and documentation.

-Respond to review comments thoroughly and thoughtfully.

-Maintain clear documentation demonstrating the work performed, evidence obtained, conclusions reached, and resolution of identified issues.

-Complete assigned work within established timelines and raise potential delays early enough to support appropriate resolution.



Experience with SSARS financial statement reviews, U.S. GAAP financial reporting, SaaS or technology companies, or capital-markets companies is strongly preferred.



Internal Audit, Controls & Risk

-Participate in internal audit, internal control, and risk assessment engagements as assigned.

-Perform procedures in accordance with RNB's established methodologies, work programs, training, and engagement instructions.

-Obtain and evaluate supporting documentation and other evidence.

-Document procedures performed, evidence reviewed, observations, and conclusions in engagement workpapers.

-Identify inconsistencies, control gaps, or other matters requiring additional investigation or escalation.

-Apply professional skepticism and critical thinking when evaluating information provided by clients.

-Work collaboratively with engagement managers and reviewers to resolve questions and review comments.



Prior internal audit experience is not required. Candidates should, however, be comfortable learning and working across accounting, financial reporting, internal controls, and risk engagements rather than limiting themselves to traditional accounting work.



What Strong Performance Looks Like



A successful Senior Accountant at RNB Capital does not simply complete a checklist.



You are expected to:



-Understand why a procedure is being performed.

-Recognize when financial information or supporting evidence does not make sense.

-Investigate discrepancies rather than passing them forward.

-Connect information across the general ledger, reconciliations, financial statements, disclosures, workpapers, and supporting documentation.

-Ask thoughtful questions when information is incomplete or inconsistent.

-Research unfamiliar issues before immediately escalating them.

-Document your reasoning clearly enough that another professional can understand what you did and why.

-Take ownership of assignments through completion and meet agreed-upon deadlines.

-Plan your work, manage competing priorities, and communicate promptly when a deadline may be at risk.

-Incorporate feedback and avoid repeatedly making the same mistakes.

-Remain open to learning and working across accounting, reporting, controls, internal audit, and risk disciplines.

-Use technology and AI responsibly while independently verifying the accuracy and appropriateness of all work produced.



Because careful reading and following instructions are important in this role, when the application form asks what the piano warm-up is on page 47 of my lesson theory book, enter: When the Saints Go Marching In.



Quality is measured not simply by whether the work was completed, but by whether the work demonstrates accuracy, judgment, critical thinking, professional ownership, and reliable execution within deadlines.



Our People Standard



We use a simple framework to evaluate whether someone is positioned to succeed in their role:



-Gets It - You understand the role, the objectives behind your work, how your responsibilities connect to the broader engagement, and the level of quality expected.



-Wants It - You genuinely want the responsibility that comes with the role. You are willing to learn, improve, take ownership, and contribute to what the firm is building.



-Can Do It - You have the technical ability, judgment, capacity, discipline, time-management skills, and reliability necessary to perform the role consistently and meet deadlines.



Our Core Values



-Curiosity - You ask thoughtful questions, investigate inconsistencies, seek to understand the business behind the numbers, and continue learning.



-Clarity - You communicate clearly, document your work so others can understand it, raise issues early, and distinguish facts from assumptions.



-Accountability - You take ownership of your responsibilities, meet commitments and deadlines, follow through, and address mistakes rather than waiting for someone else to solve them.



-Trustworthiness - You are dependable, honest, careful with confidential information, and consistent in doing what you say you will do.



-Objectivity - You evaluate information based on evidence, maintain professional skepticism, challenge unsupported conclusions when necessary, and remain willing to change your conclusion when the facts support it.



Qualifications



Required



-Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a closely related field.

-Approximately 3-6+ years of progressive accounting experience or equivalent demonstrated capability.

-Strong understanding of accrual accounting and financial statement preparation.

-Strong account reconciliation and financial analysis skills.

-Experience working with general ledgers, supporting schedules, and month-end or year-end close processes.

-Ability to identify unusual transactions, inconsistencies, and accounting errors.

-Strong written documentation and communication skills.

-Demonstrated ability to work independently while accepting review and coaching.

-Strong attention to detail without losing sight of the broader financial picture.

-Ability and willingness to learn new methodologies and work across accounting, financial reporting, internal audit, controls, and risk engagements.

-Ability to manage multiple assignments, prioritize effectively, and consistently meet deadlines in a professional services environment.



Strongly Preferred

-Experience preparing or supporting SSARS financial statement review engagements.

-Experience with SaaS, technology, or other growth-stage companies.

-Working knowledge of U.S. GAAP.

-Experience preparing financial statements and disclosures.

-Experience with capital raises, investor reporting, SEC reporting environments, or other capital-markets work.

-Internal audit, internal controls, risk assessment, or similar assurance/advisory experience is a plus but is not required.

-Experience with Xero and/or QuickBooks Online.

-CPA or CPA-track candidates are welcome, but certification is not required.



Who This Role Is Not For



-This position will likely not be a good fit for someone whose experience is primarily transactional bookkeeping or who prefers highly prescriptive work where every step is provided in advance.

-It is also not a role for someone who wants to work exclusively within one narrow area of accounting. RNB operates across accounting, financial reporting, capital markets, internal controls, internal audit, and risk, and team members should be intellectually curious and willing to develop across disciplines.

-Our team members are expected to exercise judgment, research questions, identify problems, understand the purpose behind their work, and manage their responsibilities to meet deadlines.

-You will receive direction, review, training, and support - but you will also be expected to think and deliver reliably.



Application Process

Candidates selected to continue in the process will be invited to complete a paid practical accounting assessment. Candidates who successfully complete the assessment may then be invited to interview with RNB Capital.

Growing companies also need disciplined close processes, reliable data, controls, reporting, documentation, governance, risk oversight, and financial information that can withstand scrutiny from management, investors, lenders, auditors, regulators, and other stakeholders.

title: Resale Listing & Inventory VA — Product Research and Crosslist
description:
I’m looking for one reliable, detail-oriented person to help organize and list my resale inventory. The first project is roughly 120 items: clothing and streetwear, collectibles, vinyl records, CDs and a few other products.



I already have product photos in Google Drive and a spreadsheet with draft names, asking prices and research. I need someone to go through the actual photos, verify the information, correct mistakes and turn it into accurate listing drafts. You’ll need to do real research rather than copy the existing sheet or accept an AI answer without checking it.



The work includes:

- Matching photos to the right item and catching duplicate groups.

- Reading labels, barcodes and style numbers to confirm the exact product, size, color and edition.

- Comparing prices on eBay, Mercari, Grailed, Poshmark and Depop as appropriate, with links and a clear distinction between sold prices and asking prices.

- Writing clear titles and descriptions, organizing listing photos, and preparing Crosslist or marketplace drafts with the correct categories and item specifics.

- Keeping the spreadsheet updated and giving me a short, specific list of anything you need from me.



Some items are signed or special editions, so small details matter. Don’t guess condition, authenticity, missing parts or which edition something is. If a photo or confirmation is needed, flag it clearly and keep working on the other items.



You should have hands-on resale listing experience, be comfortable with Google Sheets and Drive, and write clear English. Crosslist experience and familiarity with streetwear, collectibles or records are helpful. AI tools are fine, but you are responsible for checking the work and providing evidence.



We’ll start with a small paid five-item trial, with the rate agreed before work begins. You’ll return the completed sheet and drafts for an accuracy review, make any corrections, and then continue with the full project if it’s a good fit. Nothing should be published until I approve it. I’m looking for an individual I can work with directly, rather than an agency.



If the first project goes well, there may also be ongoing work with inventory updates, order tracking and general resale administration. Hours and compensation will be agreed based on the project and your experience.



When applying, please send:

1. A brief explanation of your relevant experience and the platforms you’ve used.

2. One or two listing examples you personally created, with any private information removed.

3. How you verify a product and choose a price when exact sold comparisons are hard to find.

4. Your hourly rate or project quote, weekly availability, and when you can start.



Please tailor your reply to this project. I care more about careful, accurate work and clear communication than a generic list of VA skills.

title: Remote Personal Trainer — Live Gym Coaching & Accountability
description:

We can begin with a paid introductory session at an agreed rate and continue if it’s a good fit. Compensation is negotiable based on experience and the level of live support. I’m hiring an individual trainer to work with directly.

title: Direct Response Video Editor (Meta Ads) - $3,000/mo + uncapped bonus
description:
I started this brand while working full time and scaled it to 7 figures almost entirely on static ads, doing the creative myself. In July I quit and went all in on it. Revenue was up 80 percent in my first month full time.



We are now building our video ad library close to from scratch. Not iterating on someone else's winners. Setting the baseline for the brand.



I already have two editors. I am adding someone who raises the standard of how we work, not someone who waits for tasks.



What will you be doing?



- Editing B-roll driven video ads for Meta, mostly 90 seconds to 2 minutes

- 5 concepts a week, 3 hook variations each

- Sourcing and generating your own B-roll from the brief

- Working from real performance data. You are in the ad account, you see what wins and what dies

- Static ads when needed. Not the main job, but a real plus if you can do them





What am I looking for?



- Experience editing direct response video ads

- You can source, cut and deliver a 90 second B-roll ad in a day

- You are obsessed with ads. You study them, you save them, you have opinions on why one worked and another died. You can name ads running right now that you think are great and tell me why

- You keep up with where ads are going right now. Song ads, AI animation, whatever is working this month, and you bring it to me rather than waiting to be told

- You read performance data and act on it. You look at what an ad did, work out why, and your next version reflects it

- You communicate clearly and honestly about what is done and what is not

- You take blunt feedback and come back with a better version



Big plus if you can generate B-roll with AI, do AI animation, or write your own direct response angles and scripts.



The one thing I cannot teach is caring about this. The people who get good at performance creative are the ones who are in ad libraries for fun, who notice a hook in the wild and work out why it stopped them, who are annoyed when an ad of theirs loses and want to know exactly why. If that is you, the rest can be built.



Experience level matters less to me than hunger and speed. If you are early but obsessed with getting better, apply.





Compensation



Base up to $3,000 USD per month, depending on experience.



Plus 4% of the ad spend on the ads you build. You are paid your base or your bonus, whichever is higher that month, and the bonus is uncapped. The better your ads perform, the more spend they take, and the more you earn. Your incentive and mine point the same way.





What will you get working with me?



- Direct access. No manager, no ticket queue. You work with me, in the ad account, on the strategy

- Real input. If you have a better angle, we test it. This is something you help build, not something you clock into

- Tools that remove the grunt work. 

- Funded learning. Tools, courses, subscriptions. If it makes you better, I pay for it





Do not apply if



- You are stacking this on top of other clients

- You need four days to produce one video

- You need everything spelled out twice





How to apply?



Send me:

1. Three video ads you have edited, with one line each on what the brief was

2. Your typical turnaround for a 90 second B-roll ad

3. Whether you have generated B-roll with AI and which tools you use

4. Your expected monthly rate in USD



Applications without example ads will not be reviewed.



Shortlisted people do a short call with me, then a paid test project if we're a good fit. A 90 second B-roll ad from a script I provide, 24 hour turnaround, paid whether or not you get the role.

title: HIGH-TICKET SALES CLOSER — REMOTE | BASE + UNCAPPED COMMISSION
description:

You’ll be speaking with qualified leads who are already interested in our coaching program. Your job is to lead the sales call, understand what they actually need, handle objections, follow up when necessary, and close.



Our current offer is $2,500.



COMPENSATION



This position includes base pay + uncapped commission.



Base Pay: $2.50/hour for scheduled sales calls, follow-ups, and assigned sales activities.



Commission: 10% of collected revenue from clients you personally close.



Our current offer is approximately $2,500, meaning:



A $2,500 paid-in-full client = $250 commission.



If a client chooses a payment plan, commission is paid as each payment is successfully collected.



There is no cap on commission. The more you close, the more you earn.



This will begin as a part-time position, with hours based on sales-call volume and follow-up needs. There is opportunity for increased hours as the business grows.



This position is best suited for someone who already knows how to sell and is confident in their ability to convert qualified prospects.



WHO I’M LOOKING FOR

• Excellent spoken English clear, confident, natural, and conversational

• Proven experience personally closing high-ticket offers online

• Experience selling coaching, consulting, education, agency services, or similar offers

• Experience selling offers in the $2,000–$5,000+ range

• Strong discovery and objection-handling skills

• Experience conducting sales calls over Zoom or Google Meet

• Confidence selling to U.S.-based prospects

• Ability to follow a sales framework without sounding robotic or scripted

• Strong follow-up skills

• Ability to think quickly and lead a sales conversation without being pushy



I care about results, not impressive job titles.



TO APPLY, ANSWER ALL OF THESE QUESTIONS:



1. What high-ticket offers have you personally sold?



Include the offer, price point, industry, and type of customer.



2. What were your numbers in your most recent closing role?



Average sales calls per week:

Close rate:

Average deal size:

Average monthly revenue personally closed:

Best month in sales:

Tell me what the offer was, the price, and your role in the sale.



4. A prospect tells you:



“I really want to do this and it sounds like exactly what I need, but $2,500 is a lot of money. I need to think about it.”



What do you say next?



Write exactly what you would say on the call.



5. Tell me about a sale you almost lost but ended up closing.



What was the objection, and how did you handle it?



6. Are you comfortable with $2.50/hour base pay + 10% uncapped commission on collected revenue?



INTERVIEW PROCESS



If your application looks like a strong fit, you’ll be invited to a live interview.



This will NOT just be a typical interview where I ask generic questions about your résumé.



Come prepared to sell.



During part of the interview, we will treat it like a real sales call.



I’ll play the prospect.



You’ll be the closer.



I’ll give you the same questions, hesitation, resistance, and objections you could encounter on an actual call.



I want to see how you:



• Lead the conversation

• Ask discovery questions

• Listen and uncover the real problem

• Communicate value

• Handle objections

• Think on your feet

• Ask for the sale

• Close



I’m not looking for someone who can simply memorize a sales script.



I’m looking for someone who can actually sell.

title: Social Media Video Editor — Summer & World Cup Recap + Instagram Photo Dump
description:
I’m looking for a creative editor to turn my photos and videos from summer 2026 into something memorable for TikTok and Instagram. I went to the World Cup, and I want that to be a big part of the recap alongside the other moments from my summer.



I want something that feels personal, fun and well put together, with strong pacing, music and a sense of the actual experience. You should be comfortable going through a collection of footage, finding the best moments and suggesting a creative direction. I don’t want to have to pick every clip or tell you where every cut goes.



There are two parts to this project:



1. A vertical summer recap video for TikTok and Instagram Reels. Help choose the clips, build an engaging opening, edit to the music and mix in natural sound where it adds to the story. Handle color correction, sound levels and any tasteful text or transitions. Propose the length and approach after reviewing the footage.



2. An Instagram photo dump / carousel. Help select and order the strongest photos and any short clips, choose a good cover, and make light edits and crops so the post feels cohesive while still looking natural. Suggest a few short caption options. We’ll agree on the final number of slides after reviewing the material.



I’m looking for someone who understands travel, sports, lifestyle and personal recap content. Please bring ideas and show me a few references before committing to the full edit. The World Cup should be a highlight, but the final result should tell the story of my summer.



The workflow would be: review the material, suggest a direction and shortlist, agree on the scope and price, create a first draft, then make agreed revisions. Please specify how many revision rounds your quote includes. I’ll share the footage privately with the selected editor; there is no need to create an unpaid custom sample to apply.



Deliverables should include the finished vertical video, a clean version without added music so platform audio can be added where appropriate, ordered carousel files, and the editable project file with any asset or plugin requirements explained. Use my footage or properly licensed assets, and explain any music restrictions for posting to both platforms. Don’t post or use my material in your portfolio without permission.



Please apply with:

- Two or three relevant edits you personally made, ideally travel, sports, event or personal recap videos. Explain your role if they were team projects.

- An example of a photo carousel you curated or your approach to choosing and sequencing one.

- A brief idea for how you’d approach a summer recap featuring the World Cup.

- Your editing software, availability, estimated turnaround and project price or price range. Tell me what footage volume, video length and revisions that price assumes.



I’m looking for an individual I can collaborate with directly. Strong taste, storytelling and clear communication matter more to me than flashy effects. If we work well together, there could be more personal content projects in the future.
