title: Marketing Director
description:
About Starbond



Starbond is a growing direct-to-consumer brand specializing in high-quality adhesives and related products. We sell through Shopify, Amazon, and other e-commerce and B2B channels.



We are building a more disciplined, data-driven Marketing function and are looking for a Marketing Director who can turn customer insight, strong execution, and sound unit economics into profitable, scalable growth.



About the Role



The Marketing Director will own the design, performance, and continuous improvement of Starbond’s Marketing function. This leader will establish the strategy, team structure, systems, decision rights, reporting, and cross-functional cadence required to drive profitable growth.



This is not a high-level advisory role. Starbond is still developing its marketing infrastructure, so the Marketing Director must be comfortable moving between strategy and execution. You must be able to personally calculate, validate, and explain the numbers behind marketing performance—not rely solely on dashboards, agencies, or reports prepared by others.



You will oversee DTC growth across paid acquisition, retention, lifecycle marketing, content, SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), social media, conversion rate optimization, brand, and agency performance.



Key Responsibilities



Marketing Strategy and Leadership

Set annual and quarterly Marketing strategies, priorities, resource plans, and measurable outcomes.

Build a scalable Marketing operating model with clear workflows, decision rights, quality standards, and accountability.

Assess and improve the team’s structure, capabilities, tools, data, agencies, and cross-functional handoffs.

Develop capable leaders and owners beneath the role so execution does not depend on constant intervention.

Set team KPIs, coaching cadences, performance standards, succession plans, and corrective actions.

Provide the CEO with concise, financially grounded updates on results, risks, constraints, and recommended decisions.



Profitable DTC Growth

Own integrated DTC growth across Meta Ads, Google Ads, Shopify, email, SEO, AEO, social media, content, CRO, and other relevant channels.

Establish acceptable acquisition thresholds by product, channel, campaign, customer segment, and cohort.

Determine when to scale, restructure, reduce, or discontinue marketing investments.

Connect marketing plans with inventory, operational capacity, product readiness, and financial objectives.

Ensure marketing decisions prioritize profitable growth—not revenue or ROAS alone.



Marketing Analytics and Unit Economics

Personally calculate and validate CAC, LTV, LTV:CAC, CAC payback, MER, ROAS, gross margin, contribution margin, conversion rates, retention, cohort performance, and other funnel metrics.

Audit formulas, source data, assumptions, attribution methods, and agency reports for accuracy.

Identify incorrect calculations, inconsistent definitions, unsupported assumptions, and material data gaps.

Translate findings into specific decisions involving budgets, channels, campaigns, offers, creative, landing pages, retention, and resource allocation.

Ensure all material recommendations are financially grounded, traceable to source data, and ready for executive decision-making.



Agency and Channel Management

Manage agencies supporting paid media, lifecycle marketing, SEO/AEO, content, creative, and related functions.

Define agency scopes, KPIs, service-level expectations, reporting requirements, ownership, and escalation paths.

Independently validate agency recommendations and hold partners accountable for results and deadlines.

Address underperformance promptly through documented corrective actions.

Ensure Starbond retains ownership and access to advertising accounts, data, dashboards, creative files, documentation, and intellectual property.



Brand, Customer Insight, and Execution

Own customer insight, positioning, messaging architecture, and brand standards.

Govern creative testing, content production, lifecycle campaigns, landing pages, attribution, and conversion optimization.

Ensure campaigns and product launches have clear briefs, readiness checks, QA processes, measurement plans, and post-launch learning reviews.

Remain close enough to execution to inspect work, resolve critical blockers, and improve quality when needed.



Cross-Functional Leadership

Build a consistent planning cadence across Marketing, Product/R&D, Amazon, Sales, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, Web Development, HR, and the CEO.

Anticipate inventory, capacity, staffing, technical, and operational constraints before they affect launches or marketing commitments.

Surface risks and difficult issues early, supported by evidence, tradeoffs, and a clear recommendation.

Challenge assumptions constructively and redirect resources when customer or financial evidence supports a different decision.



What We’re Looking For

Proven experience leading a DTC or e-commerce Marketing function with accountability for profitable growth.

Strong hands-on knowledge of paid acquisition, retention, lifecycle marketing, CRO, content, SEO, and brand strategy.

Advanced understanding of unit economics, including CAC, LTV, CAC payback, MER, gross margin, contribution margin, retention, and cohort analysis.

Ability to independently recreate, audit, and explain marketing calculations using underlying source data.

Experience managing internal Marketing teams and developing accountable leaders.

Strong experience managing marketing agencies and holding them accountable to defined KPIs, deadlines, and commercial expectations.

Ability to connect marketing performance with profitability, customer quality, retention, inventory, and operational capacity.

Experience building processes and systems within a growing or developing Marketing organization.

Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to clearly present evidence, financial impact, tradeoffs, and recommendations.

Willingness to challenge weak assumptions, confront underperformance, and make difficult decisions.

Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where strategy and hands-on execution are both required.



Tools and Platforms

Experience with several of the following is expected:

Shopify

Meta Ads Manager

Google Ads

Google Analytics 4

Google Search Console

 and lifecycle marketing platforms

Amazon reporting

Looker, Power BI, or similar business intelligence tools

Google Workspace

ClickUp or similar project-management platforms

Agency reporting and attribution systems



What Success Looks Like

Marketing generates profitable DTC revenue and contribution-margin growth.

CAC and CAC payback remain within approved thresholds by channel, product, and cohort.

At least 90% of committed strategic milestones are delivered or formally replanned.

Agencies consistently meet deadlines and receive timely performance reviews and corrective actions.

Core unit-economics and funnel calculations are accurate, consistent, and traceable to source data.

The Marketing function has clear ownership, capable leaders, reliable reporting, and a scalable operating cadence.

Risks, performance misses, and resource constraints are communicated early with recommended actions.



This Role May Not Be the Right Fit If You

Prefer to operate only as a strategist or advisor.

Depend entirely on analysts, agencies, or dashboards to explain marketing performance.

Present revenue or ROAS as proof of success without considering margin, retention, or customer quality.

Avoid challenging agencies, team members, or leadership when the evidence supports a different decision.

Are uncomfortable entering the details, auditing calculations, or personally unblocking critical work.

Require a fully developed marketing infrastructure before you can perform effectively.



How to Apply

Please submit your resume and briefly answer the following questions:

Describe a DTC or e-commerce business you helped grow and the results you personally influenced.

Explain how you calculate CAC, LTV, CAC payback, and contribution margin. Include an example of how these metrics influenced a budget or channel decision.

Share an example of a marketing report, dashboard, or agency recommendation you found to be inaccurate. How did you validate the data, and what did you change?

Describe your experience building or restructuring a Marketing team or operating model.

Share an example of how you held an underperforming agency or team accountable.

List the advertising, analytics, e-commerce, lifecycle marketing, and business intelligence platforms you have used.





We are looking for a Marketing Director who can build the function, develop strong owners, confront difficult issues, and stay close enough to the numbers and execution to drive measurable, profitable growth.

What you’ll be responsible for

Setting up and managing campaigns: Building and managing manual TikTok website campaigns and GMV Max campaigns for TikTok Shop, with clear objectives and agreed budgets.

Monitoring performance and spend: Reviewing results, managing budget pacing, identifying underperformance and making informed decisions about testing, optimisation and scaling.

Contributing to creative strategy: Analysing hooks, messaging, offers and video formats, then giving our content team specific feedback and new testing ideas.

Working with creator and affiliate content: Coordinating with our Shop team to identify promising videos, arrange the necessary ad permissions and communicate what content we need next.

Checking tracking and commercial performance: Investigating reporting issues and evaluating results against the brand’s targets, rather than treating platform-reported revenue as the whole picture.

Communicating with clients and the team: Providing clear updates on performance, explaining what’s changed and recommending the next actions, with timely responses during agreed working hours.

Who we’re looking for



You’ll have proven experience managing TikTok advertising accounts, with examples showing the budgets you’ve handled, the results achieved and your contribution.



You should be comfortable analysing spend, revenue, cost per purchase, conversion rate and ROAS, while understanding how product margins, discounts and creator commission affect a brand’s ability to spend profitably.



We’re particularly interested in someone who can connect the numbers to the creative. For example, when results decline, you should be able to explain what you’d investigate and what evidence would support your next decision.



Excellent written and spoken English is essential. You’ll need to communicate confidently with clients and colleagues, take ownership of your accounts and flag concerns before they become bigger problems.



Experience with Spark Ads, affiliate content and UK or US e-commerce accounts would be an advantage. You won’t be responsible for running the entire affiliate programme, but you’ll need to collaborate closely with the people who do.



You should also be confident using AI and other tools to support analysis, research and reporting, while applying your own judgement and checking the output.



How to apply



Please use “TikTok Paid Ads Specialist” as your application subject and include:



A short video introduction covering your experience with manual TikTok campaigns and GMV Max, the markets you’ve worked in and the monthly budgets you’ve managed.

One or two campaign examples showing the timeframe, spend, results and what you personally did to improve performance. Please separate website campaign results from GMV Max results and redact confidential information.

Your availability, the UK hours you can cover, your earliest start date and your expected monthly salary or hourly rate.



Please also answer: Tell us about an underperforming TikTok campaign you worked on. What did you investigate, what did you change, and what happened afterwards?

title: Virtual Administrative Assistant – Client & Phone Support
description:
Part-Time | 20–25 Hours Per Week | Long-Term Opportunity



We are a growing U.S.-based association and event management company looking for an exceptional Virtual Administrative Assistant to join our team.



This is not just a behind-the-scenes administrative position.



You will regularly communicate directly with our clients, members, event attendees, vendors, and other contacts by phone,
, and online chat. Because of this, exceptional spoken and written English, strong phone presence, professionalism, and the ability to communicate naturally and confidently are essential to this role.



We're looking for someone who doesn't simply wait for the next assignment. We want someone who takes ownership, anticipates what needs to happen next, asks good questions, follows through, and helps move work forward.

We work hard, care deeply about our clients, and operate as a close-knit team. We're looking for an individual who wants to become part of that team and grow with us long-term.



PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING

1. Application Requirements

To be considered, please submit:

A cover letter

Your resume

A 1–2 minute video completing the prompts below



In your video, please answer these three questions:

Introduce yourself and tell us briefly about your experience supporting clients or customers by phone.

Imagine you are answering the phone for one of our association clients. A member calls and says, "Hi, I received an
 about an upcoming meeting, but I'm not really sure what it's about or whether I need to attend." How would you respond?

Please apply only if you can consistently work these hours.



3. How to Apply

Please apply only through this job posting.

Use the subject line:

Your Rockstar Virtual Admin: Ready to Take Charge of Assignments So You Can Focus on What You Do Best

As part of your application, review our company core values below and tell us:

Which core value resonates with you most, and why?



4. Individuals Only

We are looking for an individual who wants to become a long-term member of our team.

Please do not apply on behalf of an agency, VA company, staffing company, or team.

We want to work directly with the person who will be performing the role.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You may be a great fit if you're the type of person who:

Communicates naturally, clearly, confidently, and professionally in English

Is extremely comfortable speaking with people by phone

Can understand and communicate effectively with a wide variety of U.S.-based callers

Can confidently handle a conversation without relying entirely on a script

Understands natural conversational and professional business English

Writes clear, polished, professional
s

Provides warm and exceptional customer service

Pays close attention to details and catches things others might miss

Takes ownership instead of waiting to be told every next step

Anticipates needs and proactively follows up

Enjoys figuring things out and solving problems

Can manage multiple clients, priorities, systems, and deadlines

Is comfortable asking questions when clarification is truly needed but will first use available resources to find an answer

Wants to learn, grow, take on more responsibility, and become an important part of a team



QUALIFICATIONS

Exceptional spoken and written English communication

Excellent phone presence and confidence handling inbound and outbound calls

Previous experience providing customer service or administrative support by phone

Strong customer service skills

Excellent organizational, multitasking, and administrative skills

High attention to detail and accuracy

Strong follow-through and personal accountability

Ability to work independently while also collaborating closely with a team

Ability to prioritize competing responsibilities and deadlines

PC proficiency, including Microsoft Office

Comfortable learning and working within multiple technology platforms

Passion and drive to learn new skills and take on new challenges

Strong work ethic, positive attitude, professionalism, and willingness to assist others



Experience with the following is preferred but not required:

ClickUp

Zoho

Constant Contact

Canva

Zoom

ChatGPT

Claude



RESPONSIBILITIES

Phone & Customer Support

Regularly answer incoming phone calls on behalf of multiple association and event clients

Provide warm, professional, and helpful customer service to members, attendees, vendors, and other callers

Make outbound phone calls to members regarding upcoming meetings, events, registrations, and other association needs

Take accurate messages and ensure appropriate follow-up

Research answers when possible rather than simply passing questions to another team member

Communicate clearly and confidently while representing our clients and company professionally

Manage membership, event, and general customer service inquiries by phone,
, and online chat

Administrative Support

Take ownership of assigned administrative tasks and follow them through to completion

Proactively identify next steps, outstanding details, and necessary follow-up

Create reports and complete accurate data entry for the company and our clients

Assist with membership billing for client organizations

Maintain and clean client
 and membership lists

Research information needed for company and client projects

Perform data cleanup for events and conferences, ensuring accuracy of attendee, member, and registration records

Assist with other administrative responsibilities as needed



HOW WE WORK

We aren't looking for someone who simply checks boxes.

We value people who take ownership.

That means:

If you see a missing detail, you investigate it.

If something doesn't make sense, you ask.

If a deadline is approaching, you don't wait for someone to remind you.

If a customer needs help, you work to find the answer.

If you make a mistake, you own it and help fix it.

If you see a better way to do something, you speak up.

You'll have support and training from our team, but over time, our goal is for you to truly own your responsibilities and become someone the team can count on.



OUR CORE VALUES

1. Fanatical attention to details and deadlines, and takes ownership of tasks and projects

2. Continually exceeding expectations and hungry for achievement

3. Innovative and resourceful problem-solving by staying curious, relentless, and unstoppable

4. Team player: fun, humble, and authentic

5. Anticipate needs, understand long-term objectives, and act with the clients’ success in mind

6. Exhibits professionalism in all things

7. Honors the value of reputation of individual and company



ONE LAST THING

Skills matter, but who you are and how you work matter just as much to us.

We're looking for someone who wants more than a temporary freelance assignment. We want someone who enjoys being part of a team, takes pride in doing excellent work, cares about the people they're helping, and wants the opportunity to grow alongside us.

If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Paralegal
description:
Texas-based plaintiff-side personal injury firm seeking an experienced Litigation Paralegal. This is a fully remote position for a candidate who can independently manage a case from the moment a lawsuit is filed through trial preparation, with no training period required.



What We're Looking For



We are hiring specifically for post-filing litigation work — from petition through trial. This is not a pre-suit or intake-focused role, and we are not seeking anyone who needs to be trained on the fundamentals of personal injury litigation.



Minimum Qualifications



At least 3 years of demonstrated plaintiff-side personal injury litigation experience

Working knowledge of litigation from petition through trial

Working knowledge of Texas civil procedure and Texas law as it applies to personal injury litigation

Direct, hands-on experience with case management software

Experience managing a high-volume active caseload of filed litigation matters



Duties and Responsibilities



Draft original petitions and initiate new lawsuits

Draft and file amended petitions

Draft discovery requests, including interrogatories, requests for production, and requests for admission

Draft responses to discovery requests received from opposing counsel

Complete Defendant's Written Discovery Questionnaires (DWQs)

Identify appropriate expert witnesses for each case

Prepare and file designation of experts

Prepare initial disclosures

Prepare for and coordinate depositions, including scheduling, exhibit preparation, and logistics with opposing counsel, court reporters, and clients

Track and manage all case deadlines

Communicate directly with clients, opposing counsel, and insurance adjusters as needed



Schedule



This is a fully remote position. Candidates must be resourceful and capable of ensuring physical tasks get done even while working remotely — for example, coordinating with in-office staff to have documents printed, organized, or delivered, or arranging third-party legal support services to handle physical trial preparation, exhibit production, or courier needs. The ability to problem-solve and make these things happen without being physically present is essential. Candidates must be available and reachable approximately 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Central Time, Monday through Friday. Some scheduling flexibility is available for the right candidate.



International applicants: this schedule is fixed to Central Time (United States), not your local time zone. If you are located in the Philippines, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Central Time falls at approximately 10:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. Philippine time, meaning this would be an overnight shift for you. Please confirm you understand this before applying and that you are able and willing to work these hours on your local clock.



Compensation



Salary is commensurate with experience. Please include your minimum compensation requirement with your application.



To Apply



Please include the following with your application:



Number of years of plaintiff-side litigation experience?



Confirmation that you can independently handle litigation work from petition through trial preparation.



Your typical caseload volume and whether managed solo or as part of a team?



Your minimum hourly rate or salary requirement?



Confirmation that you are able to begin work without a training period?



A description of a time you had to ensure a physical task (printing, filing, document delivery, etc.) got completed without being on-site, and how you made it happen?



Confirmation that you are able to work 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Central Time, Monday through Friday. If you are applying from outside the United States, please confirm you understand what this means in your local time zone and that you are able and willing to work those hours.

title: Operations Manager for US Performance Marketing Agency
description:
ABOUT US



Nexus Partner is a performance marketing agency serving auto detailing businesses across North America. We run Meta and Google ads for our clients, work every lead through our own sales team and AI booking bot, and book jobs directly onto our clients' calendars. We only get paid when our clients get paid, which means we win when they win.



We have 40 active clients and we're scaling aggressively over the next 12 months. Our team is remote and spread across the Philippines and Latin America.



WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS



Our current Operations Manager is transitioning out in approximately six months on his own timeline. He told us early so we could hire and train his successor properly. That means you will not be walking into a mess or figuring things out alone. You will have a four month overlap with him to learn the systems, the clients, and the team before you take full ownership.



Right now, our two founders are pulled into daily operations that should not require them. Your job is to take that off their plate permanently so they can focus on media buying, creative, and growth.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



Team management (about 40% of the role)

You will manage our remote team: text setters in the Philippines, dialers in Latin America, and new hires joining over the next several months including a creative editor and an automation engineer. You run the daily rhythm, hold people accountable, coach underperformers, and tell us honestly when someone needs to go.



Systems and process (about 30%)

You own our SOPs, our task management system, and our operational documentation. When something breaks twice, you build the process that stops it breaking a third time. You run our weekly business review and report the numbers that matter to the founders.



Client operations (about 20%)

You own new client onboarding end to end: GoHighLevel subaccount setup, integrations, and getting them live. You handle day to day client communication over Slack and text. Founders step in only for strategy conversations and escalations.



Whatever else needs owning (about 10%)

Small team, fast growth. Some months this is running a hiring process. Some months it's untangling a reporting problem. You are comfortable with that.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



30 days: You know our systems, our clients, and our team. You've identified the three biggest operational gaps and told us what you'd do about them.

90 days: You're running onboarding without us. The team reports to you, not to the founders. Our SOPs are documented and actually followed.

6 months: You own operations completely. The founders have not been pulled into a daily fire in weeks.



REQUIREMENTS



5+ years remote work experience, with at least 3 of those at a US-based agency, SaaS company, or similar

You have managed remote teams directly. Not coordinated with them. Managed them, including performance conversations and terminations.

Direct experience managing Filipino team members

You build systems, you don't just execute them. You can point to a process you designed that outlived your time at that company.

Excellent written English. This role writes constantly.

Strong on video calls with both US-based leadership and your own team

At least 4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern business hours

Stable internet (25+ Mbps), reliable computer, and backup power



STRONGLY PREFERRED



Experience at a performance marketing, lead generation, or home services agency

GoHighLevel experience, or fluency with a comparable agency CRM stack

You have managed 5 or more direct reports

You've worked somewhere that grew 3x or more in a year and you know what scaling breaks



WHAT WILL DISQUALIFY YOU



You describe yourself as an assistant rather than an operator

You want a role where someone hands you a task list

You can't give specific numbers from your past roles (team size, retention rate, client count)

You're currently holding another full-time role

You skip the application instructions below



COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS



$2,000/month USD base, up to $2,800 for exceptional experience

Monthly performance bonus up to $300, tied to team KPIs we set together

Quarterly retention bonus of $500

13th month bonus

Annual review with a base raise for strong performance

Paid twice monthly via Wise



HOW TO APPLY



Send the following:



A Loom video, under 5 minutes, answering two questions: what is the hardest team situation you've managed and how did you handle it, and what is a system you built that was still running after you left? Talk to us like an operator, not a candidate.

OUR PROCESS

title: Design Manager — Canadian Property Developer, Remote
description:
We are a property developer in Nova Scotia, Canada. We design, build small and midsize buildings like condo / apartments.  



The problem, in plain terms. Our design process has no manager. Drawings go out without a revision mark, so a supplier prices the wrong set and a trade builds from the fourth version. Permit submissions come back with comments an internal check would have caught. Engineers, the municipality and suppliers find gaps in a package before we do. Changes get made on an old base. Decisions live only inside drawings, so six versions in, nobody can say why the building looks the way it does. Questions from our architects and our consultants sit unanswered because nobody owns the log. Our founder and chief of staff have carried this between them. It has cost us in rework, in permit time and in people. We are hiring the person who has run this properly before and will install it here.



WHAT YOU OWN



1. Drawing issue and revision control. A drawing register, revision marks and clouds, issue status, superseded-set control and a transmittal log, so at any moment we know which set is current and who holds it.



2. Stage gates with checklists. Concept approval, design development, permit submission, stamp readiness, issue for construction. Each has a checklist, a review and a sign-off, and nothing passes without them.



3. Design QA and coordination review. Completeness and clash checks across architectural, structural, civil, mechanical and electrical, schedules and shop drawings, before anything leaves us.



4. Consultant and engineering coordination. Scope and brief each engineer and consultant, hold an information-required schedule and an RFI log, run comment rounds, track stamps and sign-offs.



5. Authority approvals. Submission packages, a comment-response log, conditions tracking and resubmission control, across several municipalities.



6. Design change control. Every change after issue, from the owner, from site or from an engineer, is logged, impact-assessed, approved and re-issued under revision. Including ours.



7. The design brief and the standards library. Unit and room templates, site constraints and the cost target, confirmed complete before drawing starts, with our planning and pre-construction leads.



8. Design programme and resource planning. Deliverables per project against permit and construction dates, ETAs, weekly allocation and check windows for the design team.



9. Cost and buildability at every gate. Pre-construction and construction in the room when a concept is approved, so cost is a design input, not a discovery.



10. Construction-phase design support. A site query and RFI log, as-built deviations handled, red-marked sets and revised stamped plans issued under control, inside an agreed answer window.



11. The design team and its standards. Weekly allocation, reviews, feedback given privately, mentoring; title blocks, sheet numbering, naming, LOD definitions and model standards.



12. The project design record. Decision register, review minutes and actions, drawing register, RFI and approvals logs, in one place per project.



WHO YOU COORDINATE



In-house architects, and outside structural, civil, mechanical and electrical engineers, surveyors, geotechnical and architectural consultants. The mix changes per project. You run whichever mix a project has.



HOW HANDS-ON



This is a small team, so you produce some of it: concept sketches, redlines, templates and sheet setup, checking. What that cannot do is displace the management. When a production task and a coordination task collide in a week, coordination wins, and you plan the week so they rarely collide.



TECHNOLOGY



We run the company on software we write ourselves and we are adding AI throughout how we design, coordinate and record. You do not need to be a programmer. You do need to be the person who picks up a new tool in a week, is already using AI in design or coordination work, and can say what it changed and where it was wrong. Someone who waits to be trained will not keep up here, and we say that plainly because it matters more than most items on this page.



WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE AFTER TWELVE MONTHS



- Every set that leaves us carries a revision, and every recipient is in the transmittal log.

- Every project passes each gate with a checklist signed before the next stage starts.

- No completeness gap is found first by an engineer, a supplier or a municipality.

- Every change after issue is in the change log with its impact before it is drawn.

- Every project has a decision register that explains the building.

- Permit and handover dates are met.

- Questions from the design team and consultants are answered within one business day, or logged as an assumption they can proceed on.



WHAT WE NEED YOU TO HAVE DONE



- At least five years in design management, design coordination, or document and BIM coordination at a developer, general contractor, design-build firm or multi-disciplinary consultancy, on residential or similar buildings.

- You have personally kept a drawing register and a transmittal log, run gate checklists, run consultant comment rounds to stamp, and run municipal comment rounds to approval. You can describe each in your own words in an interview.

- You have run change control with impact assessment on live projects.

- You have held a line with people who did not report to you, sending work back and holding dates, and given hard feedback privately to people who did.

- An architecture, architectural technology or engineering background. Revit literacy: you read and check models and set up sheet and model standards.

- Already using AI tools in your work, and fast at adopting new ones.

- Remote-experienced, with a working overlap into the Atlantic Canada business day.



Useful, not required: Canadian codes (NBC Part 9) or municipal processes; having sat on the developer side of a brief; multi-unit wood-frame.



NOT A FIT



Revisions kept in the file name. "The engineer handles that." A permit comment log you cannot describe. Management described as assigning tasks and chasing status. A studio background with no consultants or authorities in it. Waiting to be trained on tools. If you build parametric tools rather than run design processes, see our Computational Designer posting.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your reply with the word DATUM. Applications without it are not read.



Answer these four. Short is fine. Specific is essential.



1. Your drawing control system on your last project: how sets were numbered and issued, how a revision was marked, how you knew who held which set, and what the log looked like.



2. A submission that came back with municipal comments, or a stamp that was withheld. How you ran it to approval: who did what, how you tracked it, and what you changed so it did not recur.



3. A change that arrived after issue, from the owner, from site or from an engineer. Where it was logged, who assessed the impact, who approved it, how it was re-issued.



4. One thing you changed in how you work in the last year because of a new tool, AI or otherwise. What it replaced, and one thing it got wrong.



OUR PROCESS, AND HOW FAST



We read replies the same day. Shortlisted candidates get a paid work sample on a real project of ours, about half a day, paid whether or not we proceed. Then one call with our founder. Then an offer. We aim to make an offer within a week of your application.

title: Ebay Lister
description:
1. Upload — drag/drop photos into  our ai website 

2. Review photo grouping — the AI clusters photos into per-item groups automatically. The VA checks the "Group Review" screen and fixes any mis-groupings (drag photos between groups, merge/split groups, reorder/rotate) before moving on.

3. Generate listings — click Create Listings; the AI writes title, description, category, condition, and item specifics for each group.

4. Review every listing before it publishes (this is the core of the job) — each listing lands in a "Ready to Publish" queue with editable fields (SKU, title, price, condition, category, description) and confidence badges per field. Low-confidence fields need a closer look:

   - Comp the item to get an accurate price

   - Confirm the AI-read SKU sticker number is correct.

   - Check flagged prices ("high variance in sold data — verify").

   - Fix category errors before publishing (bad categories cause the eBay publish to fail).

   - Resolve duplicate-listing warnings: publish as new, add +1 quantity to the existing listing, or go view the existing one.

   - Double-check anything flagged as a box/contents mismatch — the system rebuilds the listing around the real item when the box label doesn't match what's photographed, so title/price/category/condition all need re-verification, and leftover box-only photos may need removing.

6. Publish — approve individually or in bulk ("Publish All"); items can also be discarded instead.

7. Check the Daily QA Report — auto-generated each night (also runnable on demand), logged to Google Sheets. Flags "Missed" items (SKU seen but never published) and "Skipped" items (gaps in the SKU sequence — a box/item that was never listed at all). Mark issues resolved once fixed.



Skills needed: attention to detail, comfortable working a review queue in a web dashboard, enough eBay familiarity to judge whether a price/category/condition looks right. No coding required.

We are looking for someone who is organized, intelligent, proactive, comfortable with construction terminology and business operations, and capable of taking information that may initially be unorganized and turning it into clear systems, documents, and processes.



What You'll Do



Your primary responsibility will be helping our Owner/CEO stay organized, focused, and ahead of the many responsibilities involved in operating a growing construction company.



Responsibilities will include:



* Monitor, organize, and triage

* Identify
s requiring immediate attention or follow-up

Construction / Architecture / Design Experience

* Interior design firm

* Engineering firm

Accounting & Bookkeeping

Experience with any of the following would be particularly valuable:



* QuickBooks Online

* Construction/job-cost accounting

* Accounts payable and accounts receivable

* Vendor invoices

* Client billing

* Job costing

* Budget tracking

* Financial spreadsheets

* Reconciliations and reporting



Accounting will not necessarily be the primary responsibility of this position, but someone who understands numbers and financial workflows will have a major advantage.



Technology



You should be highly comfortable learning and working with technology.



We currently use systems including:



* Microsoft 365 / Outlook

* Excel

* Word

* Teams

* QuickBooks Online

* Buildertrend

* Bluebeam

* DocuSign

* CompanyCam

* AI tools including Claude and ChatGPT



Experience with Buildertrend or other construction management software is especially valuable.



We actively use AI and are looking for someone who is excited about learning how to use AI to improve productivity, documentation, research, and business processes.



The Person We're Looking For



The right person is someone who:



* Is extremely organized

* Communicates professionally in written and spoken English

* Pays close attention to details

* Takes ownership instead of waiting for constant instructions

* Is comfortable asking questions when something isn't clear

* Can anticipate what needs to happen next

* Follows through until something is completed

* Can handle confidential business and financial information

* Enjoys creating order from incomplete or unorganized information

* Can communicate professionally with executives, employees, clients, architects, designers, vendors, and subcontractors

* Is comfortable working directly with a busy business owner

* Wants to become a trusted long-term member of a company rather than simply completing assigned tasks



We value judgment and initiative more than simply completing a checklist.



If you see an
 that hasn't been answered, a commitment that hasn't been followed up on, a calendar conflict, or a business process that isn't documented, we want you to notice it and help solve it.



Work Schedule



This is intended to become a long-term, full-time position.



Because you will work directly with our leadership team in Colorado, we need meaningful overlap with our U.S. business hours. We understand that this requires an adjusted schedule for someone working from the Philippines and want to establish a schedule that works well for both sides.



How to Apply



Please do NOT send us a generic application.



Start your application with the words:



BUILD YOUR LEGACY

3. Describe your experience managing an executive's
 and calendar.

Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.



About Lost Creek Construction



We are a growing luxury custom home builder and renovation company that values craftsmanship, professionalism, accountability, relationships, and continuous improvement.



Our goal isn't simply to hire someone overseas to complete tasks.



We're looking for someone who can become a trusted extension of our leadership team, learn how our company operates, and grow with us over the long term.



Build your Legacy. Live your Dream.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
About Us

We run one of the fastest-growing pet brands online. DTC. Performance-focused. High volume. We're obsessed with one thing: creative that converts.



We're hiring an A-player Creative Strategist to help us push past our next revenue milestone. This is a role for someone who lives and breathes paid creative, not someone looking for a comfortable seat.



Compensation

We offer a very important compensation for this role, dependent on experience, with performance incentives. Strong performers should expect significant upside tied to creative wins and scaling.



A quick note before anything else:

We have a few questions for you below. Based on your answers, we'll d
 if we move forward. We prioritize hard-working people who are responsive and value real human communication. We do not appreciate AI-generated or automated responses to these questions, we want to hear from you, not from a chatbot.



The Role

You'll own the ideation, research, and scripting behind our Meta ad creative. You're the brain behind the brief. You hand off scripts and direction to our editors and designers, and you obsess over what's working, what isn't, and why.



What You'll Actually Do (Week to Week)



Ship multiple creative briefs per week, a mix of fresh concepts and iterations on winners

Write the actual scripts for video ads (this isn't a "concepting only" role, you're writing)

Hand off polished briefs to editors and designers with clear direction, references, and visuals where helpful

Run weekly market research, what's happening in the pet space, in DTC, and culturally that we can hook into

Run weekly competitor research using spy tools, you should already live in these tools

Develop a clear thesis and hypothesis for every test, we don't ship creative just to ship creative

Analyze creative performance, read the metrics, understand what they mean, translate that into the next round of iterations

Spot iteration opportunities fast, when something's working, you know how to milk it before it fatigues

Stay on top of trends, hooks, formats, angles, cultural moments

Static ad concepting as well, we're mostly video but statics are part of the mix

Collaborate closely with the broader creative team



What We Need From You (Non-Negotiables)



Minimum 2+ years of proven creative strategy experience in ecom DTC (this is a hard requirement, agency-only or B2B experience won't cut it here)

Proven ability to write video ad scripts that convert on Meta

Comfortable working independently and shipping high volume without hand-holding

Strong English

Available full-time, fully and exclusively focused on this role

Hungry, motivated, and obsessed with the craft



You are NOT a fit if:



You apply with a generic message

You've never worked on performance creative in ecom DTC before

You can't back up your experience with real examples

You need constant hand-holding to ship



Tools You Should Already Know



Spy tools (Foreplay, Pipiads, Atria/Brandsearch, or similar)

AI tools for ideation, research, and scripting workflows

AI image/avatar generation tools to bring briefs to life

Meta Ads Manager, comfortable reading and interpreting creative performance data

Working knowledge of what video editors and designers can and can't do, so your briefs are realistic and executable



The Hiring Process:



Application Review: We review your answers below.

Paid Project Trial: Real brief, real deliverable. If it's good, an interview follows.

One-Month Paid Trial: Weekly output with feedback.

Long-Term Offer: For those who consistently deliver.



ONE MORE THING.

We get a lot of applications. Most of them are copy-paste. Vague. Useless.

If yours looks like that, we won't even open it.



To apply, your message must follow this exact structure:



Full Name:

Age:

City:

Years of experience in creative strategy (minimum 2 years required):

Which market(s) have you worked in, in detail (niche, region, brand type):

Walk us through your process, step by step, from brief to shipped ad:

Tools you actively use (spy tools, AI tools, Ads Manager, etc.):

Who was your mentor, or who shaped how you approach creative strategy?

On average, how much time do you spend actively working per day/week on this kind of role?

Link to past work / briefs / scripts (real ad work, not general portfolios):

One sentence: why should we pick you over everyone else?

Outside of work, what's your favourite way to spend your free time?



If your message doesn't follow this structure exactly, it gets ignored.



We're not harsh. We're just focused.

The right person will love this.

3. The environment must be 100% consistent. Same stage, lighting, audience, logos and color throughout.

title: Australian Bookkeeper | Medical Imaging | Full-Time Remote
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are an Australian medical imaging business looking for an experienced, reliable bookkeeper based in the Philippines. You will keep our books accurate and up to date, follow through on outstanding items, and give management a clear picture of cash flow and financial performance.



This is a full-time, remote opportunity: 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday, with overlap during Melbourne business hours. Exact working hours will be agreed with the successful applicant.



PAY

PHP 50,000-65,000 per month, depending on relevant Australian bookkeeping experience and capability.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Record and correctly categorise transactions; reconcile bank accounts, credit cards and payment settlements.

- Manage accounts payable: check supplier invoices, identify duplicates, reconcile supplier statements and prepare payment schedules for approval.

- Manage accounts receivable: allocate receipts, reconcile invoices and credits, maintain an accurate aged debtors report and follow up overdue accounts professionally.

- Reconcile revenue and billing-system reports with accounting records, investigate discrepancies and coordinate with the administration team to resolve them.

- Support payroll preparation, timesheet checks and payroll reconciliations, with management review and approval.

- Complete month-end reconciliations and prepare profit and loss, balance sheet, cash-flow and outstanding receivables/payables summaries.

- Prepare supporting schedules and records for GST/BAS and year-end work, working with our Australian accountant and escalating uncertain treatment for review.

- Keep supporting documents organised, maintain a clear audit trail and improve recurring bookkeeping checklists and processes.

- Handle confidential business and patient-related billing information carefully, using approved systems and access controls.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- At least 3 years of hands-on bookkeeping experience, including at least 1 year supporting Australian businesses.

- Ability to manage the bookkeeping cycle, investigate discrepancies and finish reconciliations independently.

- Strong cloud accounting software skills. Xero experience is preferred; please also tell us about any MYOB or QuickBooks experience.

- Practical knowledge of Australian GST coding, BAS preparation support and payroll processes.

- Confident Excel or Google Sheets skills, including lookups, pivot tables and reconciling data from different systems.

- Clear written and spoken English, good judgement, attention to detail and dependable follow-through.

- Reliable computer and internet, a private workspace, and availability for 40 hours per week.



HELPFUL, BUT NOT ESSENTIAL

Experience with medical practices, diagnostic imaging, healthcare billing, Medicare or insurer remittances; working across multiple locations or entities; and relevant bookkeeping/accounting qualifications or Xero certification.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with your CV and a short response covering:

1. Your Australian bookkeeping experience, accounting systems used and the work you personally owned.

2. An example of a reconciliation discrepancy you found and how you resolved it.

3. Your experience with accounts receivable follow-up, month-end reporting and payroll support.

4. Your available working hours in Philippine time, earliest start date and expected monthly salary in PHP.



Please use the subject line: Australian Healthcare Bookkeeper.

Please do not include confidential records from previous employers or clients.

title: Client Experience & Operations Specialist (Hospitality / Home Services)
description:
Client Experience & Operations Specialist (Hospitality / Home Services)**

Location: 100% Remote (Philippines)

Shift: Permanent Night Shift (Mon–Fri, 40 hrs/week | 11:00 PM – 7:00 AM Manila Time)

Total Package: PHP 52,300 / month



---

ABOUT WINSLOW PACIFIC



Winslow Pacific runs the back office for trade contractors across Vancouver Island, British Columbia. From roofers to plumbers, we answer their calls, book their appointments, and keep their schedules organized so they can stay focused on their work.



We are a registered Canadian company looking for a warm, articulate professional who treats customer service like an art form—not a script to read.



---

THE ROLE & THE MINDSET



This is not a traditional call center role, and we do not use call scripts or flowcharts.



To every caller, you are not an agent at an outsourced provider - you are sitting right in that contractor’s local front office. 



When a homeowner’s hot water heater fails or a pump breaks, you are the calm, competent colleague on the phone who puts them at ease, checks their account in real time, and handles their issue.



Your day-to-day responsibilities:



Handle inbound calls: Light-to-moderate volume (20 to 30 calls a day). Quality, genuine connection, and accurate details matter infinitely more than handle times.



Coordinate scheduling: Book appointments, manage calendars, confirm timelines, and follow up on callbacks.



Seamless handoffs: You don't "take a message" like an answering service - you take full ownership of the call and pass actionable details directly to the clients (the business owners).



Use quiet hours productively: Master our clients' services, get familiar with Vancouver Island geography, and assist with executive administrative work as assigned by the CEO.



WHO WILL THRIVE HERE



Hospitality, Hotel, or Concierge Background: You treat phone conversations like high-end guest care. You listen actively, reassure stressed callers, and speak naturally without relying on a script.



Natural North American English: You speak with natural phrasing, warmth, and confidence. You naturally avoid formal BPO habits (e.g., no "Sir/Ma'am," no "kindly," and no "please be advised").



In-House Mindset: You naturally use internal phrasing ("I'll pass this directly to Tom," "Let me pull you up in our system," "We can definitely help with that").



Meticulous Detail & Follow-Through: An unpassed detail can cost a contractor thousands of dollars. You track every detail, follow through on every promise, and stay organized.



Software: Prior experience navigating Jobber is a huge advantage and will move your application to the top.



WORK SHIFT & SCHEDULE



Hours: Monday to Friday, 11:00 PM – 7:00 AM Manila Time (8:00 AM – 4:00 PM Pacific Time).

Status: 40 hours/week, permanent night shift.



REQUIREMENTS



Modern, capable computer/laptop & reliable wired headset

Quiet, dedicated workspace free from background noise

High-speed internet with a backup power/internet plan

Working webcam (used for team and client check-ins)

Exclusive commitment: Full-time, dedicated focus during shift hours. No other paid work during your scheduled shift.



COMPENSATION & BENEFITS



Monthly Package: PHP 52,300



Base Pay: PHP 42,200

title: Ecommerce Customer Service Quality Assurance Analyst (Shopify)
description:
RED | Ecommerce Customer Service Quality Assurance Analyst (Shopify)



PLEASE READ THIS ENTIRE JOB POST BEFORE APPLYING



We are a fast-growing 7-figure DTC eCommerce brand looking for an exceptional Customer Service Quality Assurance Analyst to join our team.



This isn't just another QA job.



We're looking for someone who is highly detail-oriented, analytical, proactive, and genuinely committed to maintaining a high standard of customer service across the entire team.



You will play an important role in ensuring that our Customer Service Representatives are:



• Providing accurate, professional, and empathetic support

• Following company SOPs and processes correctly

• Reporting their working hours and productivity accurately

• Meeting productivity expectations

• Handling customers according to our quality standards

• Continuously improving based on feedback



This role is ideal for someone who naturally notices details, asks questions when something doesn't look right, and takes pride in making sure things are done correctly.



We value accuracy, judgment, consistency, work ethic, and the ability to learn quickly just as much as experience.



IMPORTANT



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career with us, not simply complete a few hours of ticket checking each day.



This role will initially be approximately 4–6 hours per day, with the potential to increase to 8 hours per day as the team grows.



As our Customer Service team continues to expand, the importance and scope of this position will also grow.



The right person may eventually take on additional responsibilities related to:



• QA systems and processes

• Team performance analysis

• SOP improvement

• Quality reporting

• CSR coaching and feedback

• Productivity monitoring

• Identifying recurring customer service issues

• Helping establish and maintain higher team-wide standards



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the company and take ownership of the role.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We're looking for someone who:



• Has previous Customer Service QA, Quality Analyst, or Customer Support QA experience.

• Has a strong understanding of what excellent customer service looks like.

• Has excellent written English with strong grammar, spelling, and communication skills.

• Is extremely detail-oriented and able to spot small errors others may overlook.

• Learns quickly and can memorize and understand detailed SOPs.

• Is able to apply SOPs consistently when reviewing customer interactions.

• Can identify when a CSR follows a process correctly and when they do not.

• Can distinguish between a simple mistake, a training issue, and a serious quality or compliance issue.

• Is analytical and comfortable reviewing large amounts of customer service data.

• Is proactive and takes initiative instead of waiting to be told what to look for.

• Can work independently with minimal supervision.

• Is resourceful and knows how to investigate discrepancies before escalating them.

• Is comfortable checking whether reported hours and productivity accurately reflect actual work completed.

• Is objective and fair when evaluating team members.

• Accepts feedback professionally and applies it immediately.

• Is adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where processes continue to change.

• Is willing to unlearn habits from previous companies and fully adopt our workflows, SOPs, and standards.

• Takes pride in accuracy and consistency rather than simply completing an audit.

• Is looking for a long-term opportunity rather than just another VA job.



We believe skills can be taught.



Strong attention to detail, good judgment, integrity, and a high standard of work are much harder to teach.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



Experience in the following is strongly preferred:



• Customer Service Quality Assurance

• Quality Analyst / QA Analyst

• Ecommerce Customer Service

• Shopify

• Subscription-based businesses

• Loop Subscriptions

• Checkout Champ

• Richpanel

• Front

• Commslayer

• Similar helpdesk or customer support platforms

• Productivity or time-tracking systems



Experience with ecommerce operations is a major plus.



If you haven't used every system listed above, that's okay.



We provide training for the right candidate.



What matters most is your ability to learn our systems quickly and accurately apply our SOPs.



RESPONSIBILITIES



You'll be responsible for reviewing and auditing customer service operations to ensure our team consistently meets company standards.



CUSTOMER SERVICE QUALITY



• Review customer service tickets and conversations for accuracy, professionalism, empathy, and overall quality.

• Evaluate whether CSRs are following the correct SOPs.

• Check whether responses provide customers with accurate information.

• Identify incorrect, incomplete, misleading, or unnecessary responses.

• Evaluate whether CSRs are properly resolving customer concerns rather than simply responding to them.

• Identify recurring quality issues and patterns across individual CSRs and the team.

• Provide clear and actionable feedback when quality issues are identified.



SOP COMPLIANCE



• Ensure CSRs are following current company SOPs and workflows.

• Identify cases where CSRs are using outdated or incorrect processes.

• Quickly learn and retain new SOPs as processes change.

• Maintain a strong understanding of company policies so you can accurately assess whether tickets are being handled correctly.

• Flag unclear, outdated, or conflicting SOPs when identified.



PRODUCTIVITY AND WORK VERIFICATION



• Review CSR-reported working hours and productivity.

• Verify that reported hours are consistent with actual work completed.

• Review
 and ticket counts and identify potential discrepancies.

• Monitor productivity trends and identify unusual or inconsistent activity.

• Flag discrepancies for further review when necessary.

• Help ensure that productivity reporting is accurate and reliable.



REPORTING AND TEAM IMPROVEMENT



• Maintain accurate QA records and reports.

• Track recurring errors and quality issues.

• Identify trends that may require additional training or SOP improvements.

• Communicate important findings to management.

• Help establish and maintain consistent quality standards across the CS team.

• Recommend improvements when you identify recurring problems or inefficiencies.



The goal is not simply to find mistakes.



The goal is to understand why the mistake happened, identify patterns, and help prevent the same mistake from happening again.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



A successful QA Analyst will be someone who can quickly determine:



Was this handled correctly?



Did the CSR follow the SOP?



Was the customer given accurate information?



Was the issue actually resolved?



Was the response professional and appropriate?



Does the reported productivity match the work completed?



Is this an isolated mistake or part of a larger pattern?



You should be able to make these judgments accurately, consistently, and independently.



COMPENSATION AND GROWTH



• Starting rate: $4 USD/hour

• Initial schedule: approximately 4–6 hours per day

• Hours may increase to 8 hours per day as the Customer Service team grows

• Performance bonuses and additional incentives are available.

• High-performing team members will have opportunities for increased compensation and additional responsibilities.

• Compensation will increase as you demonstrate consistent efficiency, accuracy, reliability, and ownership of the role.



The starting rate is only the starting point.



We are willing to invest more in someone who proves they can become a highly efficient and trusted member of our operations team.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the company, not simply fill available hours.



REQUIREMENTS



• At least 18 years old.

• Previous experience in Customer Service QA, Quality Assurance, Quality Analysis, or a similar role.

• Strong understanding of customer service quality standards.

• Fluent in written English.

• Strong grammar and communication skills.

• Excellent attention to detail.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Able to learn and retain detailed SOPs quickly.

• Reliable computer and internet connection.

• Able to work independently.

• Comfortable reviewing repetitive information while maintaining a high level of accuracy.

• Honest and objective when evaluating other team members.

• Eager to learn and continuously improve.

• Able to commit to the required working hours.



HOW TO APPLY



To confirm you've read this entire job post, please:



1. Include the word RED at the beginning of your application title.



2. Include your
 address and resume with your application.



3. Answer the following questions:



• Tell us about your previous experience in Customer Service Quality Assurance or a similar QA role. What were you responsible for?



• How do you determine whether a customer service response is high quality?



• Tell us about a time you identified a recurring mistake or problem among a customer service team. What did you do about it?



• How do you approach reviewing a large number of customer service tickets while maintaining accuracy and consistency?



• Tell us about a time you had to learn a new SOP or process very quickly. How did you make sure you understood and remembered it correctly?



• If you notice that a CSR's reported productivity or working hours don't appear to match the work completed, how would you investigate it?



• What would you do if a CSR consistently follows an old process that conflicts with the company's current SOP?



• How do you give feedback when you identify a serious quality issue in someone's work?



• What do you believe is the difference between a good CSR and an exceptional CSR?



• What motivates you to do great work?



We carefully review every application.



Thoughtful answers matter much more than generic responses or simply having years of experience.



We are looking for someone who can demonstrate strong judgment, attention to detail, fast learning, integrity, and a genuine commitment to quality.



Selected applicants will be contacted for the next stage of the hiring process.

title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
# Senior Graphic Designer for UK Health Brand (Amazon Listings, Packaging, Dielines) – Full Time, Long Term



**Salary:** $1,200 to $1,800 USD per month depending on experience, paid twice monthly. 13th month pay included. Reviewed after 6 months.

**Hours:** Full time, 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday, 3pm to 12 midnight Manila time. Our team is split between the UK and Barbados, so this shift gives you a full overlap with the UK afternoon and the Barbados morning, which is when briefs, feedback and approvals happen. Night differential is built into the salary range. Some flexibility on start time once you're settled in.

**Type:** Long term, direct hire. We are not an agency, you'd be working with us directly.



## About us



We're Venture Healthcare, a UK based company that makes regulated consumer health products. Our main brand is Hydra-Neb (a mesh nebuliser and sterile saline range) and we also run Resp-Ease and Venbase Wound Wash. We sell on Amazon US and UK, our own Shopify stores, and we're currently expanding into Walmart and physical retail.



The team is small and spread across the UK, the Caribbean and Asia. You'd report directly to the CMO and work alongside our existing designers, our PPC team and product development. We move quickly, we don't do layers of approval, and good work gets noticed.



## What you'll actually be doing



Your work splits into three areas.



Amazon design. Main images, secondary listing images, A+ content and Brand Store pages across our US and UK listings. You'll be building full image sets for new launches and refreshing existing ones based on what the data tells us is converting.



Product packaging. Designing boxes, labels, inserts and outer cartons for new products as we grow the range and move into Walmart and physical retail. This includes working with our product development team on regulatory panels, barcodes and required symbols so packaging is right the first time.



Artwork to dielines. A big part of the role is taking our brand artwork and laying it out accurately on supplier dielines. That means setting up print ready files with correct bleed, safe zones, spot colours, varnish and cutter layers, checking spelling and claims against the brief, and producing files a factory in China or the UK can print from with no back and forth. If you've never had a printer send a file back to you because it was wrong, we'd like to hear from you.



Because we sell regulated health products, accuracy matters more than flair. Claims have to be worded exactly as briefed, product details have to be correct, and layouts have to pass Amazon's image requirements first time. If you like clean, precise work with a clear commercial purpose, you'll enjoy it here.



## Who we're looking for



You have at least 4 years of professional graphic design experience, with at least 2 of those working on Amazon or ecommerce brands. You've built full Amazon listing image sets and A+ content before and you understand what converts on a mobile screen. You're strong in Figma and the Adobe suite (Photoshop and Illustrator at minimum, After Effects is a bonus) and you can use Canva when speed matters. You can take a one page brief and run with it without needing every detail spelled out, and you're comfortable pushing back with a better idea when you have one.



Your written English is clear and confident. We communicate mostly on Slack and 
 and you'll be expected to update tasks, ask questions early and flag problems before they become problems.



Bonus points if you've worked with regulated categories (health, supplements, medical devices, cosmetics), if you can do basic product retouching and mockups, or if you've done any packaging dielines.



## What we offer



A stable full time role with a growing company, paid on time every time. Genuine ownership of the creative output across several brands. Paid Philippine public holidays and 15 days paid leave per year after probation. Software and tools covered. A direct line to the decision maker so your work actually ships.



## How to apply



Send us the following in your application. Applications that skip any of these will not be read.



1. A link to your portfolio with at least three Amazon listing image sets or A+ pages you personally designed. Tell us which ones were yours if it was team work.

2. A short paragraph about the most commercially successful piece of creative you've made and what made it work.

3. Your expected monthly salary in USD and your earliest start date.

4. Put the word "saline" as the first word of your application so we know you've read this far.



We'll shortlist within a week, then do a short paid test task and a video call. Looking forward to seeing your work.

title: Project/Account Manager
description:
Project / Account Manager



Full-Time Remote-First Healthcare IT

Philippines hours

Salary:  $1600 to $2400 per month depending on skill or experience



The challenge



We are not short of ideas. The vCIO comes out of a client meeting with a good

one most weeks, and leadership has no shortage of direction. What we are short

of is the person in the middle - the one who takes that idea, works out whether it

will actually survive contact with a live service desk, and then makes it happen.

You can see the gap in the symptoms. A go-live lands and the service desk hears

about it on the morning. A plan gets agreed that was never achievable with the

people available that week. A project reaches ninety percent and stops, because

the last ten percent is tedious and nobody is chasing it any more.

None of that is a competence problem. It is a missing job. We are fixing it by

organizing into bands - small, named teams of four looking after a defined group

of healthcare facility clients - and putting one person in charge of each.



The role



You run a band: two service-desk technicians, a cloud automation engineer, and

a technical account manager. One set of clients, one relationship, one plan

covering both halves of what we do for them.

The work starts when a brief lands on you. Someone else has had the idea; your

first job is to read it properly and say what is wrong with it. What has been

assumed. What nobody has costed. Which week this genuinely cannot

happen in. That judgment, made early and said out loud, is worth more to us

than anything else in the role - and it is the part that cannot be delegated to

a process.

Then you land it. You break it into something the band can actually work from,

you protect the reactive capacity before you commit the rest, and you stay on it

until it is finished - including the unglamorous end, when the client has stopped

asking and the interesting part is over.

You are also the escalation gate. Nothing leaves the band for a senior engineer

without you approving it, and when you decline you send it back with what to try

next rather than just a no.

One more thing worth being upfront about. We are an IT support company for

healthcare facilities becoming a company that also builds automation and AI

into how those facilities run. Our clients are all mid-crossing, and the support

load has not dropped while it happens. Holding both agendas so neither one

quietly starves the other is the hardest judgment call in the job, and you will

make it every week.



What you will actually do



- Pressure-test the brief: Read what you are given, find what is missing, and go

back with the questions before a plan exists rather than after

- Run the band: Daily huddle, sprint planning from real availability rather than

optimism, and a one-to-one with each of your four people on a four-week

cycle

- Hold the escalation gate: Approve or decline every escalation before it

reaches Central Services, and decline with guidance so it teaches

- Protect the balance: Reserve reactive capacity first, then commit the

automation and project work to what is genuinely left

- Own the client rhythm: A weekly touchpoint with every client, a proper

monthly meeting, quarterly NPS with the detractors worked personally

- Chase the bad score: Any poor CSAT gets a personal follow-up the same day -

silence after a bad score is how clients leave

- Land the guarantee: The 90-day guarantee tracked per new client from day

one, not remembered at day 89

- Tell the truth about capacity. Report the band's real position monthly,

including when it is full

- Assess your people: A quarterly capability review on each band member,

feeding the Head of Client Experience's decisions about who moves where



Who we are looking for



You have an instinct for what is about to go wrong, and you trust it. Someone

hands you a plan and within a minute you can feel the bit that has been glossed

over - and you say so, early, even when it is unwelcome. You would rather have

the awkward conversation in week one than the apology in week six.



And you finish. An open loop genuinely bothers you. Whether that shows up as

being the person who will not let something go until it is done, or the person the

team comes to when they are stuck and who quietly clears the road for them, we

want both kinds and we are not fussy about which one you are.



What we are not looking for is the person who wants to come up with it in the

first place.



YOU WILL NEED

• Managed service or IT delivery background - understands ticket flow

• Client-facing confidence with non- technical stakeholders

• Comfortable holding a gate and saying no

• Organized to the point of being boring about it

• Works Philippines hours aligned to US Eastern, to 18:30 ET at the latest

• Healthcare or regulated- industry exposure

• Halo PSA experience

• Has managed an offshore team before

• Understands automation delivery well enough to plan it

• Already holding Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) - we fund it either way



CERTIFICATION WE FUND BONUS POINTS FOR

• Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) - Required

We pay for the training, the first exam sitting and the time to take it. A resit after a

failed attempt is self-funded. You do not need any of these on day one.



What this role is not



- It is not a strategy seat. The direction comes from the vCIO and from

leadership. If what you want is the blank page and the big idea, you will find

this frustrating within a month, and we would rather you knew that now.

- It is not a technical seat. You will not be fixing tickets. You coordinate the

people who do, and consult your TAM on anything where the technical

judgment is not yours to make. A well-organized non-technical person beats a

technician trying to be organized.

- It is not an open-ended role. There are SOPS, a cadence, a scorecard and a

defined set of clients. You will improve all of it, but you are inheriting a system

rather than designing one from nothing.

- You will not start with everything. Managed service clients first. Dev-engaged

clients transfer once you are settled, because expecting anyone to run a

development team to our standards from week one is not realistic.



What you will get



- A real team, not a matrix: Four people who report to you, one set Of clients, and the authority to run it. Not influence without control.

- Clear direction, then trust: Strategy comes from the vCIO and leadership. How it lands is yours. Documented processes, and a business that rewards thorough work.

- Purpose you can commit to: Every project you land contributes to eliminating repetitive IT tasks for 1 million healthcare workers by 2050.

- Both halves of the business: You will plan managed service delivery and automation builds in the same sprint. Few PM roles let you do both.

- A route to leading the function:  Head of Client Experience is the seat above this one, and Central Services Manager sits alongside it. Both are written down.



About ElasticlT



We are building a world where healthcare workers never wait for technology. We specialize in healthcare IT for healthcare facilities, providing managed services, automation and HIPAA-compliant solutions so medical and care professionals can focus on their residents rather than their systems.

Our North Star is simple and audacious: by 2050 we will eliminate repetitive IT tasks for 1 million healthcare workers. Our purpose is to deliver the impossible under pressure, so that organizations transform their perception of what is possible.



OUR VALUES

- SIMPLIFY THE OVERWHELMING: Cut through confusion with clarity and convert half-hour tasks into one-click wins

- RESCUE WHEN OTHERS PANIC: Respond when others would panic and deliver the impossible under pressure

- BUILD LASTING CAPABILITY: Create tools that spread like wildfire and teams that work without micromanaging

- PERSIST THROUGH CHAOS: Adapt when goalposts keep moving and turn disasters into relationships

- ENABLE HUMAN PURPOSE: Remove barriers so the focus can be on patients, not systems



"The band works when the client stops thinking about us. No chasing, no surprises, no wondering who to call. That is what good judgment and follow-through buy you, and it is worth more than any individual fix. "



Ready to apply?

READY TO APPLY?
