title: High-End Personal Brand Video Editor — YouTube + Instagram
description:
# High-End Personal Brand Video Editor — YouTube + Instagram Reels



## The Opportunity



I'm looking for an **exceptionally talented and ambitious video editor** to join me long-term in building a high-end personal brand in the business, mindset, performance, identity, and personal-development space.



This is NOT a generic video-editing position.



I'm looking for someone who understands how the world's strongest personal brands package ideas through:



**Storytelling. Psychology. Emotion. Pacing. Hooks. Typography. Personal B-roll. Sound design. Visual identity.**



Think of the quality, retention, storytelling, and attention to detail found in creators such as:



* Iman Gadzhi

* Alex Hormozi

* Nick Setting

* SooWei Goh



The objective isn't to copy these creators.



It's to understand **why their content works** and develop our own recognizable, premium visual identity.



I don't want unnecessary effects every two seconds.



I want content that feels:



**Premium. Clean. Modern. Powerful. Emotional. Intelligent. High-value.**



Most importantly, the ideas themselves must remain at the center.



---



# Before Applying — Study the Brand



Before applying, please take some time to understand the content we're building:



**YouTube:** Hugo Christiansen 







I strongly recommend watching some of my content before submitting your application.



I don't want someone who simply knows how to edit videos.



I want someone who understands **my ideas, personality, audience, communication style, and long-term vision** — and who can eventually translate all of that into a recognizable visual identity.



If you've already been following my content before seeing this job post, please mention it in your application.



---



# What We're Building



This isn't about hiring someone to "edit some videos."



I'm building a serious personal brand and content ecosystem with the intention of becoming a major player in the business, mindset, identity, performance, and personal-development industry.



I'm looking for someone with an **insane amount of grit**.



Someone ambitious.



Someone curious.



Someone who wants responsibility.



Someone who wants to become world-class at their craft.



Someone who gets excited about building something from the early stages and eventually being able to say:



**"I helped build that."**



I want the type of person I'd genuinely enjoy sitting down and having dinner with — someone who thinks differently, cares deeply about what they create, and has ambitions far beyond simply collecting a paycheck.



If you're looking for a comfortable freelance gig where you receive footage, edit it, send it back, and forget about it...



**This probably isn't for you.**



But if you want to become an integral part of an ambitious brand and grow as the company grows, keep reading.



---



# What You'll Be Editing



We plan to publish approximately:



## YouTube



**2+ long-form YouTube videos per week**



## Instagram



**Approximately 2 Reels per day**



Most Reels will initially come from long-form content, alongside occasional original short-form content.



One of your most important responsibilities will be watching long-form videos and **independently recognizing the moments that deserve to become short-form content.**



I don't want to provide every timestamp forever.



You should eventually be able to watch a video and think:



**"THAT is the Reel."**



And understand exactly why.



---



# This Is About More Than Editing



Technical editing ability is obviously important.



But I'm equally interested in your understanding of **human psychology and emotion.**



A great editor doesn't simply make a video look pretty.



A great editor understands:



**What makes someone stop scrolling?**



**What creates curiosity?**



**Where does tension need to build?**



**Where should we slow down?**



**What moment creates emotion?**



**What makes the viewer trust the creator?**



**What makes an idea memorable?**



**What makes the right viewer eventually want to work with us?**



Our audience consists primarily of **successful founders and entrepreneurs who have already achieved significant results but know there is another level of performance, identity, and personal transformation available to them.**



We're not trying to attract everybody.



We're trying to create content that resonates deeply with the **right people**.



Views matter.



But **qualified attention, trust, the right audience, and ultimately conversions matter more.**



---



# Your Responsibilities



## Long-Form YouTube



* Turn raw footage into polished, premium YouTube videos

* Remove unnecessary pauses, repetition, mistakes, and dead space

* Improve pacing and viewer retention

* Create emotional dynamics throughout the video

* Use my personal B-roll and brand assets where appropriate

* Add tasteful graphics, text, screenshots, diagrams, and visual explanations

* Use music and sound design intelligently

* Maintain a consistent premium visual identity

* Make complex ideas easier to understand visually

* Understand when NOT to add an effect

* Help make every video feel intentional



## Short-Form Content



You will watch long-form videos and independently identify the strongest short-form opportunities.



You'll then:



* Select powerful 30–90 second sections

* Identify or construct strong opening hooks

* Package ideas specifically for short-form consumption

* Reframe footage vertically

* Add premium captions and typography

* Use my personal B-roll for visual storytelling

* Create tasteful pattern interrupts

* Improve pacing and retention

* Use sound design intelligently

* Amplify emotion without making the content feel artificial



You must understand the difference between **cutting a clip** and **packaging an idea.**



---



# Personal B-Roll & Content Library



You will have access to an organized **content bank containing my personal B-roll, lifestyle footage, previous shoots, photos, screenshots, graphics, and other brand assets.**



When adding B-roll, I want you to primarily use **my own footage and brand assets — NOT generic stock footage from the internet.**



Part of your job will be learning this content library extremely well so that when I discuss a particular idea, emotion, experience, or story, you instinctively know which visual moments from my life can reinforce it.



Over time, we'll continuously expand this library with new footage from professional shoots, travel, business, lifestyle, and everyday life.



The goal is for the content to visually communicate **my world and my brand**, rather than looking like generic internet content.



---



# Data & Content Performance



Over time, I want you to become obsessed with understanding **why certain content performs better than other content.**



Not just:



**"This Reel got more views."**



But:



**Why?**



What was the topic?



What was the hook?



What emotion did it create?



What editing choices worked?



What type of person engaged with it?



Did it generate the right followers?



Did it generate qualified conversations?



Did it ultimately contribute to sales?



We'll analyze our content and continuously improve.



The objective isn't simply **maximum views**.



The objective is building a content machine that generates:



**Attention ? Emotion ? Trust ? Authority ? Qualified Audience ? Conversion**



If analyzing that sounds exciting to you, you'll probably enjoy working with us.



---



# The Person We're Looking For



Formal education does NOT matter to me.



I don't care whether you have a bachelor's degree.



I care about:



**Taste.

Grit.

Ambition.

Creativity.

Emotional intelligence.

Psychology.

Content judgment.

English comprehension.

Reliability.

Attention to detail.

Editing ability.

Speed.

Curiosity.

Coachability.**



Ideally, you've already spent **tens or hundreds of hours consuming YouTube content about business, entrepreneurship, personal development, psychology, performance, or high-level personal brands.**



If you've spent hundreds of hours studying creators, businesses, personal brands, storytelling, and psychology because you genuinely enjoy this world, that's a major advantage.



When someone references creators like Hormozi or Gadzhi, I don't want you completely unfamiliar with the world we're operating in.



You should understand internet culture.



You should understand personal brands.



You should understand why people watch.



And your English needs to be strong enough to understand nuanced conversations about business, psychology, identity, performance, and personal development.



---



# The Long-Term Vision



I'm specifically looking for someone who wants to build a **long-term relationship**.



This starts as a Video Editor position.



But for the right person, there is a real potential progression:



**Video Editor ? Senior Editor ? Content Strategist ? Head of Content / Creative Director**



I would love to eventually find someone capable of becoming much more than an editor.



Someone who understands the brand so deeply that they can help:



* Develop content concepts

* Analyze content and conversion performance

* Plan videos

* Identify winning topics

* Create storytelling frameworks

* Coordinate the content production process

* Direct other editors

* Work alongside videographers

* Shape the visual identity of the brand

* Identify gaps in our personal B-roll/content library

* Help determine what we should create next



As the brand grows, **your compensation and responsibility can grow with it.**



Although this position begins remotely, exceptional long-term team members may eventually have opportunities to work together in person — potentially joining shoots, projects, or team trips in places such as **Paris, Marbella, Dubai, and elsewhere.**



I want to build a small group of extremely capable, ambitious people who genuinely enjoy working together and want to build something significant.



---



# How to Apply



Read this carefully.



**Start your application with the word "OMEGA".**



If your application doesn't begin with OMEGA, I'll assume you didn't read the job description.



Then send me ONLY the following:



## 1. Your 3 Best Short-Form Edits



Send the **three best Reels/Shorts you've ever edited.**



Not 30.



Your three best.



## 2. Your Best Long-Form YouTube Edit



Send the **single best long-form YouTube video you've edited.**



## 3. Your Rate & Availability



Tell me:



* Your preferred hourly rate

* Your preferred monthly rate

* Approximately how many hours per week you can dedicate



## 4. Your Creative Taste



Name **three creators whose content/editing you admire** and briefly explain why.



## 5. Your Experience With This World



Tell me what business, entrepreneurship, psychology, performance, or personal-development content you personally consume.



I genuinely want to know.



## 6. Your Contribution



For every portfolio example, tell me what YOU personally did:



* Editing

* Clip selection

* Personal B-roll selection

* Motion graphics

* Captions

* Sound design

* Hook creation

* Storytelling

* Thumbnail/design



Don't claim an entire team's work as your own.



## 7. One Thing You Would Improve



After looking at my YouTube and Instagram, tell me **one thing you would immediately improve about my current content or editing.**



Don't tell me what you think I want to hear.



I want to understand **how you think creatively.**



---



# Selection Process



If I like your portfolio, I'll send you footage from one of my videos.



Before you even edit it, I may ask you to:



1. Find the three strongest potential Reels

2. Give me their timestamps

3. Create a potential hook/title for each

4. Explain WHY you selected them



This tests something I care deeply about:



**How you think.**



Final candidates may then receive a **paid editing test**.



You'll be evaluated on both technical execution and creative judgment.



---



# Compensation



I'm initially looking around the **$5–$7/hour range**, depending on skill, experience, speed, and portfolio.



I'm also open to fixed monthly arrangements.



If your rate is slightly outside this range but you believe you're exceptional, **apply anyway.**



If you become extremely valuable to the brand, I'm happy for your compensation to reflect that.



I'm not looking for the cheapest editor.



**I'm looking for someone currently undervalued who has the ambition to become world-class.**



If you're hungry, extremely ambitious, obsessed with improving your craft, and excited by the idea of helping build a brand from the ground up into something significant, I want to hear from you.



If you read this and thought:



**"This sounds exactly like me."**



Start your application with:



**OMEGA**

title: Scheduler / Staffing Coordinator
description:
Work Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM EST (that's 8:00 PM – 4:30 AM Philippine Time). This is a genuine night-shift commitment — please confirm you can sustain this schedule long-term before applying.



About You



You enjoy solving puzzles — a last-minute call-off is a challenge, not a crisis, and you stay level-headed while you fix it.



You have world-class written and spoken English. You'll be on the phone constantly with U.S. clients, families, and case managers — confident, clear, professional phone communication is non-negotiable, not a nice-to-have.



You have a sharp eye for detail and like things organized, accurate, and compliant — the kind of person who catches the error before it becomes a problem.



You're a natural completer who finishes what you start and doesn't let things slip.



You're a little competitive and like hitting targets — especially ones that contribute to team success.



You're willing and able to learn U.S. geography — specifically Delaware — well enough to make smart scheduling and routing decisions. We'll teach you; you bring the discipline to actually learn it.



About Us

We are a home care agency dedicated to compassionate, respectful, and professional service. We believe life is about living, not just existing — and that everyone deserves the dignity of care in the comfort of their own home. We deliver on that belief by providing the best care to clients in the communities we serve.







The Role

The Scheduling/Staffing Coordinator maximizes the efficiency and hours our caregivers deliver to our clients. You'll own the daily schedule: booking home visits for field staff, filling call-offs quickly, and keeping clients, caregivers, case managers, and office staff informed and coordinated. When schedules run smoothly, clients get consistent care and caregivers get reliable hours — you make that happen.



This is a high-caliber, well-compensated role. We're not looking for a generic VA — we're looking for someone who's genuinely excellent at this and will be paid accordingly.



Requirements



Minimum 5 years of scheduling/staffing coordination experience specifically within a home care agency (required) — this means coordinating field staff visiting clients in private homes, not assisted living facility scheduling and not generic staffing agency placement work



Hands-on experience with home care scheduling software (AlayaCare, WellSky, or similar) and managing multiple schedules simultaneously



Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)



Excellent spoken and written English — near-native fluency required; phone screening will specifically assess verbal communication



Willingness and ability to quickly learn U.S. geography, specifically the Delaware service area, as it's central to daily scheduling decisions



High attention to detail and the ability to multitask in a fast-paced, compliance-sensitive environment



Proactive, problem-solving mindset



Healthcare certification (RN, CNA, or similar) is a plus



Responsibilities



Ensure accurate and appropriate scheduling for clients and staff.



Manage calls from patients and field staff regarding scheduling issues.



Enter and maintain accurate information in the Home Care operating software (AlayaCare).



Communicate professionally with clients, family members, and staff.



Document and maintain schedule notations timely to ensure compliance.



Provide staffing coverage for call-offs and monitor clock-in/out accuracy of field staff.



Answer incoming calls promptly and pleasantly.



Relay information from referral sources, clients, family members, and case managers to appropriate personnel.



Document and report client or staff concerns.



Maintain accurate documentation in client and personnel files.



Adhere to company-wide and specific performance standards.



Collaborate with team members to identify opportunities to improve service delivery.



Identify and proactively address scheduling challenges and process improvements.







How to Apply (Read Carefully)



We use structured systems and automation heavily, so attention to detail matters — starting with your application.



Step 1: Apply through OnlineJobs.ph



Step 2: In your application message, mention this EXACT role: Scheduler



Applications that do not follow these instructions exactly will not be considered.

title: Marketing Operations Specialist
description:
Voyage Media is looking for a hands-on Marketing Operations & Automation Specialist to support the execution of our marketing campaigns, CRM, and marketing automation systems.



GoHighLevel (GHL) is at the center of our marketing operations, so hands-on GHL experience is strongly preferred. We will also consider candidates with strong experience in comparable CRM and marketing automation platforms who have the technical aptitude to learn GHL quickly.



The ideal candidate is technically inclined, detail-oriented, comfortable learning new systems, and able to take clearly defined requirements through implementation, testing, and completion.



Key Responsibilities

Marketing Automation & Campaign Execution

• Build, maintain, test, and troubleshoot workflows in GoHighLevel.

• Build and execute
, SMS, and multi-touch marketing campaigns.

• Configure workflow triggers, conditions, timing, actions, and audience criteria.

• Manage contacts, tags, custom fields, opportunities, pipelines, lists, and audience segments.

• Work with GHL forms, calendars, funnels, and other marketing components as needed.

• Perform pre-launch and post-launch QA to ensure campaigns and automations execute correctly.

• Monitor campaigns and troubleshoot unexpected results.



Zapier, CRM & Data

• Build, maintain, and troubleshoot Zapier automations connecting marketing and operational systems.

• Test integrations and verify that data is passing correctly between systems.

• Import, export, clean, organize, and update CRM and campaign data.

• Create and validate audience segments based on established business rules.

• Assist with data hygiene, reconciliation, and routine reporting.

• Document important processes and automation logic.



Marketing Operations Support

• Maintain campaign calendars, checklists, documentation, and project information.

• Support recurring campaigns, launches, webinars/events, and promotional activities.

• Produce routine campaign and marketing reports.

• Coordinate with internal team members and outside vendors as needed.

• Take ownership of recurring marketing processes and ensure they are completed accurately and on schedule.

What We're Looking For

• 2–4+ years of hands-on experience in marketing operations, CRM administration, marketing automation, digital marketing, or a related field.

• Hands-on GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

• Experience building and troubleshooting marketing automation workflows.

• Experience with Zapier or a comparable automation platform.

• Experience building and executing
 marketing campaigns.

• Strong understanding of CRM concepts, segmentation, and workflow logic.

• Strong spreadsheet skills and comfort working with structured data.

• Excellent attention to detail and commitment to quality assurance.

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

• Ability to investigate and troubleshoot problems independently.

• Comfortable learning unfamiliar software and technology.

• Organized, dependable, and able to manage multiple assignments and deadlines.

• Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar platforms as part of day-to-day work.



Strong Plus

Experience with any of the following is helpful but not required:

• Advanced GoHighLevel or Zapier automation

• HubSpot or Keap/Infusionsoft

• Airtable, Calendly, Stripe, GA4, Jira, or Meta/Facebook marketing tools

• APIs, webhooks, JSON, or other integration concepts

• Marketing reporting and dashboard tools

• AI-assisted coding for simple scripts, automation steps, or data transformations



The Person We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who is curious, dependable, and comfortable solving problems.



The right person checks their work, notices when something doesn't make sense, researches unfamiliar problems before escalating them, asks good questions, communicates clearly, and takes ownership of assignments through completion.

You do not need to be a software developer or marketing strategist. You do need to be comfortable working with technology and have the curiosity, attention to detail, and logical thinking necessary to become highly proficient with our systems.



Our goal is to find a dependable, hands-on marketing operations resource who can execute accurately, learn quickly, and solve problems.

title: Static Ads Designer
description:
Before you apply, read this carefully.



We run one of the fastest-growing pet brands online.

DTC. Performance-focused. High volume.

And we're looking for a Static Ads Designer who operates at a high level.



This is not for beginners.

If you don't know how to work on high-level, scroll-stopping design, don't apply. We're not here to train you. We're here to work with someone who already knows what they're doing.



A quick note before anything else:

We have a few questions for you below. Based on your answers, we'll d
 if we move forward. We prioritize hard-working people who are responsive and value real human communication. We do not appreciate AI-generated or automated responses to these questions, we want to hear from you, not from a chatbot.



What the job is:

You receive a brief. You deliver high-converting, scroll-stopping static ad designs for a DTC pet brand. Fast, consistent, on-brand.



What we need from you:



Strong visual design skills (composition, typography, color, hierarchy)

Proven experience designing static ads that actually perform, not just "look nice"

Comfortable working with both AI-generated visuals and hand-designed elements

Consistency. Speed. No excuses.

Available for weekly projects, long-term



You are NOT a fit if:



You're a beginner or self-taught with no real portfolio to show

You apply with a generic message

You've never designed ads meant to sell, only aesthetic content

You don't know how to work with AI tools in your design process



The Hiring Process:



Trial Task: One static ad from our brief. Short deadline. Paid. This filters out everyone who's not serious.

Paid Project Trial: Full ad set. If it's good, short interview follows.

One-Month Paid Trial: Weekly projects with feedback.

Long-Term Offer: For those who consistently deliver.



ONE MORE THING.

We get a lot of applications.

Most of them are copy-paste. Vague. Useless.

If yours looks like that, we won't even open it.



To apply, your message must follow this exact structure:



Full Name:

Age:

City:

Years of experience in static ad design:

Link to your portfolio (real ad work, not general graphic design):

One sentence: why should we pick you over everyone else?

If you were to take on a brand new brand with barely any social media presence, and had to build a modern visual identity for it from scratch, what would you do?

Do you prefer fully AI-generated images, or generating part of an image and self-designing the rest? Explain your reasoning.

Outside of work, what's your favourite way to spend your free time?



If your message doesn't follow this structure exactly, it gets ignored.



We're not harsh. We're just focused.

The right person will love this.

title: Creative Storyteller
description:
Creative Storyteller

Stories & Scripts



Also tagged as Scriptwriter, Screenwriter, Story Writer, Creative Writer, Content Writer

Vidsnax · Remote, Philippines-based team 



Can you take an idea and turn it into a story people finish?

We’re Vidsnax. We make short-form video that millions of people watch. Microdrama is the main thing

you’d write, short vertical episodes made entirely with AI. But we make plenty of other things too, and if

you can turn a loose idea into a story, we want to hear from you.



You write it, our artists turn it into footage. What you write on Monday can be a finished video by Friday.



T H E J O B

• Make up stories people can’t stop watching. Betrayals, secrets, revenge, reunions.

• Write the episodes. Short scripts, scene by scene.

• End every episode somewhere that makes the next one feel necessary.

• Open strong. The first 5 seconds d
 everything.

• Keep a season hanging together, with characters who grow and threads that pay off.

• Take an idea from anywhere in the studio and turn it into something we can make.



T H E S C O R E B O A R D

Did they finish it, and did they come back for the next one? Not how clever the writing is. Whether a

stranger stayed to the end and then wanted more.



W H A T W E N E E D

• You can tell a story fast. Something has to happen in 90 seconds. That’s the one thing we can’t

teach.

• You can turn an idea into a script. Someone hands you a rough concept and you come back with

something we could shoot.

• You love this stuff. K-dramas, teleseryes, anime, true crime, romance, and you know why some

hook you.

• Natural English dialogue that sounds like talking, not like writing.

• You take notes well. We rewrite a lot. It’s never personal.



Never written professionally? Doesn’t matter. Fanfic, Wattpad, short stories, a page you run. It just has to

be yours.



T H E T R I A L ( P A I D , O F C O U R S E )

We give you a character and a situation. You write a 90-second first episode, plus a line each on where

episodes 2 and 3 go. Does it make us want to know what happens next? Paid either way.



T H E D E T A I L S

Remote, working with a small team. Salary depends on experience, so tell us what you’re hoping for and

we’ll talk. This is a new role, so there’s a lot of room to grow.



T O A P P L Y

Send 3 stories you’ve written, any length, finished or not, plus a line each on what you were going for.

description:

This is a phone job first. You'll often be the first human voice someone hears when they're considering the trip of a lifetime — excited, maybe a little nervous about the cost, and d
 whether to trust us with their vacation. They need to hear someone clear, warm, and genuinely glad they called. If you love talking on the phone, sound energetic doing it, and can carry a real conversation instead of reading from a script, keep reading. If phone conversation isn't a strength, the rest of this role won't make up for it — please don't apply.



What You'll Do:

s using our templates, and follow up on anything left unanswered.

- Schedule traveler calls through Calendly, matching travelers to Trip Planners by destination specialty.

Requirements:

Register as an Independent Contractor with the Bureau of Internal Revenue in the Philippines.

Schedule:

How to Apply:



Upload and provide links to all of the following:

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Full-Time | Remote | $900 USD/month | 40 hours/week | Flexible hours



REQUIRED WRITTEN INTERVIEW — COMPLETE TO MOVE FORWARD





You must complete the written interview to move forward. Submit your resume as instructed below.



THE ONE-SENTENCE TEST



Can you reconcile a client's accounts every week, close their books in Xero on your own each month, split transactions the right way, code bank and credit card transfers so they never mess up income or expenses, and catch a mistake before anyone else sees it — without being reminded?



If yes, keep reading.



WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR A TYPICAL BOOKKEEPER



Little Ledgers wants a Bookkeeper who is very accurate, cares about details, and takes full ownership of the work.



Our clients use their books to make real decisions. This includes payroll, tax planning, and loans. "Close enough" is not good enough here.



This job is not for someone who:



• Lets bank feeds pile up without coding them

• Waits to be told which client needs help

• Needs reminders to hit monthly deadlines

• Says they know Xero but can't show real work splitting transactions and coding transfers

• Leaves reconciling items unresolved without saying anything

• Uses "someone will check it later" as an excuse for messy work



The right person closes a client's month, catches problems early, and hands off books a reviewer can trust.



ABOUT LITTLE LEDGERS



Little Ledgers is a boutique accounting firm. We offer bookkeeping, tax prep, tax strategy, and CFO-level advice. We are a Bronze Xero partner. Our clients trust us to keep their books accurate and ready for review, every month.



This job is about doing clean, accurate bookkeeping for a group of clients, weekly reconciliations and a monthly close for each one. That way, our tax and advisory work always has a solid base to stand on.



THE MISSION



Your mission is to become the bookkeeper that clients and reviewers never have to worry about. That means you:



• Reconcile each client's accounts every week

• Close books on time, every month, for every client you handle

• Categorize and split transactions correctly the first time

• Code bank and credit card transfers correctly so they never throw off income or expenses

• Reconcile bank and credit card accounts with no loose ends

• Flag anything unusual before it becomes a bigger problem

• Keep Xero clean, current, and ready for review

• Communicate clearly about what's done, what's pending, and what you need from others



WHAT WINNING LOOKS LIKE



You are doing well in this role when:



• Every client's accounts are reconciled every week, not left until month-end

• Every client's books close by our internal deadline, not the client's deadline

• Bank and credit card accounts reconcile to zero, every time

• Mistakes are rare, and you catch your own when they happen

• Split transactions and transfers between accounts are handled cleanly, with nothing duplicated or miscoded

• Reviewers spend their time making judgment calls, not fixing your work

• You chase down missing documents on your own, without being asked

• Payroll entries match up correctly with the general ledger

• You follow each client's coding rules and chart of accounts exactly

• Our tools (Xero, Karbon) stay accurate and up to date



YOUR FIRST 14 DAYS



In your first two weeks, you will:



• Learn our monthly close process, SOPs, and coding rules

• Get hands-on in Xero and Karbon with at least one live client

• Fully reconcile at least one client's books, including splits and transfers

• Learn how to match and split payroll entries in Gusto

• Show that you are accurate and don't need repeated corrections

• Ask clear, specific questions instead of vague ones

• Bring at least one practical recommendation for improving an existing process



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



MONTHLY BOOKKEEPING & RECONCILIATION



• Reconcile each client's bank, credit card, and loan accounts every week

• Categorize and split transactions correctly, using each client's chart of accounts

• Code bank and credit card transfers correctly so they never inflate income or expenses

• Close every client's books each month, with no exceptions

• Find and fix discrepancies before month-end close

• Keep clean, well-documented general ledgers in Xero

• Meet our internal deadlines before the client-facing ones



PAYROLL SUPPORT



• Match and split payroll entries in Gusto against the general ledger

• Flag payroll problems or missing entries right away

• You do not need prior Gusto experience — we will teach you. Prior experience is a bonus, not a requirement



CLIENT FILE MANAGEMENT



• Gather and organize bank statements, receipts, and other documents

• Follow up directly with clients when something is missing

• Keep client files complete and ready for review at all times



WORKFLOW & TOOLS



• Keep Karbon tasks, statuses, and notes accurate and current

• Follow our written SOPs for monthly close

• Point out process gaps or repeated problems to the reviewer

• Suggest practical improvements to existing processes on an ongoing basis, not just when asked



QUALITY & REVIEW READINESS



• Turn in books that need little to no correction from a reviewer

• Catch your own mistakes before you submit your work

• Take feedback seriously and apply it for good, not just once



THE STANDARD: ACCURACY WITH SPEED



This is a detail-first job. Speed matters, but never at the cost of accuracy.



You need to know how to:



• Spot problems before someone else points them out

• Ask clear questions when something is truly unclear

• Reconcile accounts with no loose ends

• Meet deadlines without a last-minute rush

• Finish tasks without needing a reminder



If a client's books can reasonably close this week, don't let them slide into next week.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



• At least 1 year of hands-on bookkeeping experience, ideally at an outsourced firm

• Hands-on skill in Xero (required), including splitting transactions and coding bank/credit card transfers correctly

• Solid understanding of double-entry bookkeeping, reconciliation, and month-end close

• Strong written English and clear communication

• High attention to detail, with no patience for unresolved discrepancies

• Ability to work on your own across several clients' books without losing accuracy

• Reliable high-speed internet, plus a backup for internet or power

• A dependable computer and a quiet, private place to work

• Willingness to complete reference checks



ADDITIONAL EXPERIENCE (NICE TO HAVE, NOT REQUIRED)



• Experience with Karbon or similar practice management software

• Experience with Gusto, including matching and splitting payroll entries (we will teach this — it's a bonus, not a requirement)

• Past experience working with U.S.-based accounting or bookkeeping clients

• Google Workspace



You don't need every item on this list. But Xero skills — especially splitting transactions and coding transfers — are required. Be ready to show us during the interview or a short test.



THIS ROLE IS FOR YOU IF YOU



• Take real pride in books that reconcile perfectly

• Notice the one transaction that looks off before anyone else does

• Like clear processes and written steps to follow

• Take full ownership of your client list

• Speak up before being asked

• Want to grow with a firm that's building real systems, not just doing data entry



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF YOU



• Let bank feeds or reconciliations pile up

• Need reminders to hit monthly deadlines

• Are okay turning in work you haven't double-checked

• Say you know a tool but can't explain what you've actually done in it

• Are juggling another full-time job or several other clients



HOURS AND PAY



• Full-time independent contractor role

• 40 hours a week, Monday–Friday, flexible hours

• $900 USD per month

• Finalists complete a one-week paid trial at $200

• Candidates from any country are welcome to apply



HOW TO APPLY: 



Submit your resume and complete the written application:







Your application must show clear examples of:



• What you have personally managed and reconciled in Xero (not just "used it"), including how you handle split transactions and bank/credit card transfers

• Any experience with Gusto, if you have it (not required)

• How you catch and fix your own mistakes before you submit work

• How you manage several clients' books at once without letting any fall behind

• Your weekly availability and preferred hours



Generic answers will not be enough. You may be asked to complete a short Xero test focused on splits and transfers.



We expect accuracy, ownership, and follow-through. If you take real pride in books that are clean, current, and correct — apply now.



Little Ledgers gives equal job opportunities to all qualified applicants, regardless of location, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status.

description:
Virtual Assistant: AI-Powered Local SEO Site Builder (Rank and Rent System)



Type: Part-time to start (10-20 hrs/week), full-time potential Pay: [$X/hr or $X per completed asset] Schedule: Flexible, with [X] hours overlapping US Eastern Time Company: Rank High Local (US-based digital marketing company)



About the Role



We build small, hyper-targeted local websites that rank in Google and get cited by AI search engines (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity), then lease those digital assets to local businesses. Most of the heavy lifting is done by an AI platform we created. Your job is to run the repeatable production process around it: set up accounts, deploy sites, create short videos, publish supporting content, and get everything verified with Google.



You will follow a documented step-by-step system with video training provided. You do not need to invent strategy. You need to execute the checklist accurately, every time, and keep clean records.



---------------------------------------------------------



What You Will Do (per asset, roughly 2-4 hours of hands-on work)



1. Purchase and log a local phone number (Twilio or Plivo) and select a placeholder business address for the target city.



2. Set up
 routing on a Cloudflare domain (catch-all
 address per project).



3. Enter the business data (name, address, phone,
) into Rockz.ai, run its keyword assistant, and select target keywords              using our scoring rules (high ad spend, zero organic competition).



4. Generate 3 website variants with different themes, review them for quality, and publish them to Amazon S3 with one click.



5. Create one short (1-2 minute) AI voiceover video per site using software (script, voice, music, and B-roll are all point and click), then upload each video to its own YouTube channel with AI-generated titles, descriptions, and tags.



6. Publish an AI-generated Reddit post per site (copy, paste in Markdown mode, post, save the link back).



7. Link everything together in the platform and redeploy so each site shows its video.



8. Verify each site in Google Search Console and submit sitemaps.



9. Create one Google Business Profile per asset using our exact process, then leave it untouched per our rules.



10. Build and publish a local micro directory site to a Cloudflare subdomain and verify it in Search Console.



11. Track every URL, keyword, account, and credential in our asset organizer spreadsheet, and report ranking wins with screenshots.



----------------------------------------------



You Are a Great Fit If You



Have strong written English and careful attention to detail (copy and paste accuracy matters here; one wrong phone number breaks an asset)



Have experience with any of: basic SEO, YouTube uploads, WordPress or website builders, Canva or simple video tools, data entry with spreadsheets



Can follow a video SOP exactly and flag anything that does not match the training instead of improvising



Are comfortable creating and managing multiple accounts (YouTube channels, Google Search Console properties, Cloudflare) and keeping logins organized



Communicate proactively: short daily updates, clear questions, screenshots when something looks off



Nice to Have (not required):

Familiarity with Google Business Profile, Google Search Console, or local SEO

Reddit experience

Twilio, Plivo, or any VoIP dashboard experience

Loom or screen-recording experience

Tools You Will Use (training provided for all)



YouTube Studio, Reddit, Google Search Console, Google Business Profile, Cloudflare, Twilio/Plivo, Google Sheets, Loom.



--------------------------------------------------



What Success Looks Like?



First 2 weeks: complete training videos, shadow one asset build, then complete your first solo asset with zero checklist misses



Month 1: 4-6 complete assets deployed, verified, and logged



Ongoing: 2-3 assets per week, accurate records, and ranking screenshots delivered without being asked



----------------------------------------------



How We Work?



Everything is documented. You get the full video course, our SOP checklist, and the asset tracker template on day one.



You will never handle company billing or payment credentials. Purchases (domains, phone numbers) are made on pre-approved accounts we provide, or requested through me.



Communication via [Slack/WhatsApp/Email], short async daily summary, weekly check-in call.



--------------------------------------------------



How to Apply?



Start your application with the word ROCKSTAR so I know you read this.



Tell me about a repeatable online process you have run before (posting, publishing, uploading, data entry) and how you kept it error-free.



Confirm your available hours per week and your time zone.



Bonus: include a link to anything you have published online (YouTube video, website, post).

title: Ecommerce Media Buyer (Meta Ads) - US Subscription Brand Portfolio (Full-Time)
description:
ABOUT US

We are a US-based e-commerce company operating a growing portfolio of subscription brands, launching 2 new brands every month. Our brands are organized into pods - small teams that each own up to 10 brands. This role joins a pod team.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Own all ad accounts for a pod of up to 10 subscription brands

- Manage campaign structure, budgets, and scaling decisions across brands

- Work with the creative team on a weekly test rotation

- Track new-member cost (NCPA) and payback per brand - these are your numbers

- Report performance weekly to the Pod Manager



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- You have scaled paid social on DTC/e-commerce stores (Meta required; $20K+/month management preferred)

- You think in cost-per-acquisition and payback, not ROAS vanity metrics

- Disciplined account hygiene: naming, structure, documented changes

- Decisive, organized, strong written English



WHAT WE OFFER

- $700-1,100/month depending on experience

- Full-time, long-term role with a fast-growing company (we plan to be at 100+ brands)

- Clear playbooks and SOPs - you will always know what good looks like

- 13th month pay



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the word LIME so we know you read this far.

2. Answer in 5 sentences or less: you take over an ad account spending $30K/month across 5 campaigns and costs are rising. What are the first 3 things you check, and why?

3. Include your relevant experience.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a PAID trial project before any interview. The trial is the interview.

title: Running Creator - Reels/Tik Tok Editor + Social Media Manager — Running Creator Brand
description:
I'm looking for a talented Short-Form Video Editor + Social Media Manager to help me grow my Instagram and tik tok as a running/fitness creator.



My goal is to build a large running-focused audience, grow my Instagram, eventually work with running/fitness brands, and develop a recognizable personal brand.



I am an active marathon runner and will provide plenty of raw footage from training, races, workouts, travel, and everyday life.



This is NOT simply a video editing job.



I want someone who understands Instagram Reels, storytelling, hooks, trends, retention, and creator growth.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Video Editing

Edit Instagram Reels from raw iPhone/camera footage

Create engaging 15–60 second short-form videos

Create strong hooks in the first 1–2 seconds

Add captions/subtitles

Add music and trending audio when appropriate

Add running pace, distance, workout and race information

Use B-roll, zooms, cuts, transitions and other editing techniques

Create different versions of strong concepts to test what performs best

Repurpose content for Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts

Content Strategy

Research successful running/fitness creators

Identify current Reels trends and formats

Come up with new content ideas

Create a weekly/monthly content calendar

Tell me what footage I should film

Develop recurring content series

Help improve hooks, storytelling and retention

Instagram Management

Write captions

Upload and schedule posts

Optimize Reels

Research relevant hashtags/keywords

Monitor comments and engagement

Track weekly/monthly analytics

Identify our best-performing content

Recommend changes based on analytics

THE TYPE OF CONTENT I WANT



Running content including:



Marathon training

Workout videos

Track workouts

Long runs

Race day

Marathon preparation

Running tips

Running gear/shoes

Training mistakes

Personal stories

Running lifestyle

Travel + running

Behind-the-scenes content

Progress toward marathon goals

Relatable/funny running content

Educational running content



I don't want every Reel to simply be "a guy running with music."



I want to build a personality-driven running brand.



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR



You should:



Have strong Instagram/TikTok Reels editing experience

Understand short-form storytelling

Understand what makes people stop scrolling

Have excellent attention to detail

Have strong English communication skills

Understand Western/American audiences

Be creative and proactive

Be comfortable giving me ideas and feedback

Understand Instagram analytics

Be able to recognize why a video performed well or poorly

Be reliable and meet deadlines



Experience working with fitness, running, sports, lifestyle or personal brands is a major plus.



REQUIRED



Please send:



Your portfolio

3–5 of your best Reels/short-form videos

At least one example of an account you helped grow

Starting followers → ending followers

How long you worked on the account

Screenshots of analytics/results if available

What editing software you use

How long it normally takes you to edit a 30–60 second Reel

Your hourly rate

Your availability

IMPORTANT



Please do NOT send a generic application.



Tell me specifically:



What makes a Reel go viral?



And:



If I gave you 20 raw videos of me training for a marathon, how would you turn that footage into 10 different Reels?



PAID TEST



Shortlisted candidates will be given a small paid editing test using my actual running footage.



I'm looking for someone who can become a long-term member of my content team, not just someone who can edit one video.



Potential for increased hours/pay based on performance and account growth.
